title: Multimodal CT-pathology imaging deep learning model for risk stratification in resected stage I lung adenocarcinoma
zh_title: CT-病理多模态深度学习用于I期肺腺癌术后风险分层
summary: 基于多中心1078例患者，融合术前CT与术后WSI的深度学习模型预测I期肺腺癌无病生存，优于单模态，并在验证队列中分层有效。
key_points: 多中心1078例，CT+WSI双模态
优于单模态，为独立预测因子
探索性评分系统整合临床病理因素
reason: 多中心含验证队列的预后预测，CT-病理多模态，命中偏好；外部验证细节有限
abstract: Lung adenocarcinoma is a highly heterogeneous disease, highlighting the need for more accurate prognosis prediction. We developed a multimodal deep learning model combining preoperative computed tomography (CT) and postoperative whole slide image (WSI) to predict the disease-free survival (DFS) of resected stage I lung adenocarcinoma. Based on a cohort of 1078 patients from multiple centers, our dual-information instance neural network achieved superior performance over unimodal approaches. The risk stratification defined by the model effectively distinguished DFS in both validation cohorts and served as an independent predictor, suggesting the complementary value of the model beyond clinicopathological factors. An exploratory scoring system integrating the model-derived risk stratification with key clinicopathological factors was developed, identifying patients with significantly different prognostic outcomes. Further analyses suggested that patients with high-risk stage IB disease or high scores might derive DFS benefit from adjuvant chemotherapy, warranting prospective validation. Beyond its predictive capacity, the model also provided morphological insights, identifying prognostically significant structures such as tertiary lymphoid structures and stroma barriers, while RNA-sequencing analysis revealed distinct oncogenic pathway activation and immunosuppressive tumor microenvironments in high-risk patients. By leveraging routinely acquired clinical images, this multimodal approach offers a practical tool for improving prognostic stratification, with potential implications for informing patient selection for adjuvant chemotherapy in resected stage I lung adenocarcinoma.
zh_abstract: 肺腺癌是一种高度异质性的疾病，因此需要更准确的预后预测。我们开发了一种多模态深度学习模型，结合术前计算机断层扫描（CT）和术后全切片图像（WSI），用于预测已切除的 I 期肺腺癌的无病生存期（DFS）。基于来自多个中心的 1078 例患者队列，我们的双信息实例神经网络（dual-information instance neural network）的表现优于单模态方法。该模型所定义的风险分层在两个验证队列中均能有效区分 DFS，并且是独立的预测因子，提示该模型在临床病理因素之外具有互补价值。我们还开发了一个探索性评分系统，将模型得出的风险分层与关键临床病理因素相结合，可识别出预后结局显著不同的患者。进一步分析提示，高风险 IB 期患者或高评分患者可能从辅助化疗中获得 DFS 获益，这有待前瞻性验证。除预测能力外，该模型还提供了形态学方面的见解，识别出具有预后意义的结构，如三级淋巴结构和间质屏障；同时 RNA 测序分析显示，高风险患者存在独特的致癌通路激活和免疫抑制性肿瘤微环境。通过利用常规获取的临床影像，这种多模态方法为改善预后分层提供了一种实用工具，并可能为已切除 I 期肺腺癌患者辅助化疗的选择提供参考。

title: Health-state instability and progression in longitudinal clinical records reveal heterogeneous ageing trajectories
zh_title: 纵向临床记录中的健康状态不稳定性揭示异质性衰老轨迹
summary: VitaFlux以下次就诊预测将就诊编码为潜在健康状态，在浙江人群队列17.9万人、444万次就诊上学习，预测不稳定性与1年、3年死亡率相关。
key_points: 预测不稳定性与1、3年死亡率相关
当前与预测状态提升多种结局预测
reason: 大规模纵向队列、患者级表征，含队列适应验证，上调
abstract: Longitudinal clinical records capture health changes, but most models reduce them to endpoint risks or single-time biological-age estimates. We developed VitaFlux, a representation-learning framework that uses next-visit forecasting to encode clinical encounters as latent health states. Applied to 178,970 individuals with 4,439,390 aligned visits from the Zhejiang Population Health Cohort, VitaFlux learned a reproducible representation organized by age-associated, disease-burden and multisystem physiological variation. Forecast instability measured predicted health-state change at the next visit and was associated with observed one- and three-year mortality. Continuous trajectory measures captured heterogeneous progression, while current and forecast states improved the prediction of multiple clinical outcomes compared with a comprehensive clinical baseline. After cohort-specific adaptation, future-state forecasting outperformed a no-change persistence baseline in two independent aging cohorts. VitaFlux provides a unified framework for representing health-state position, forecasting near-term dynamics and quantifying longer-term progression from longitudinal clinical records.
zh_abstract: 纵向临床记录捕捉了健康变化，但大多数模型将其简化为终点风险或单时间点的生物学年龄估计。我们开发了VitaFlux，一种表征学习框架，利用下一次就诊预测将临床就诊编码为潜在健康状态。将VitaFlux应用于浙江人群健康队列中178,970名个体、共4,439,390次对齐就诊，其学习到了一种可重复的表征，该表征按年龄相关、疾病负担和多系统生理变异进行组织。预测不稳定性衡量下一次就诊时预测的健康状态变化，并与观察到的1年和3年死亡率相关。连续轨迹指标捕捉了异质性的进展，而与综合临床基线相比，当前状态和预测状态改善了多种临床结局的预测。经队列特异性适配后，未来状态预测在两个独立的老龄化队列中优于无变化持续性基线。VitaFlux提供了一个统一框架，用于从纵向临床记录中表征健康状态位置、预测近期动态并量化长期进展。

title: Artificial intelligence model for pancreatic cancer risk prediction in patients with pancreatic cystic lesions
zh_title: 胰腺囊性病变患者胰腺癌风险预测AI模型
summary: 基于13年回顾性队列中8707例患者的23,398份CT/MRI报告与临床数据，XGBoost模型预测胰腺癌风险，AUC约0.94–0.96。
key_points: 多机构医疗系统回顾性队列
利用放射报告文本与临床数据
XGBoost表现最佳，AUC 0.944–0.960
reason: 样本较大的回顾性研究，外部验证未明，肿瘤预测加分
abstract: Pancreatic cystic lesions (PCLs) are prevalent and potential precursors of pancreatic cancer. Cancer risk assessment is a crucial step in PCL management, but the complexity and limited accuracy of existing approaches contribute to suboptimal patient care. We developed and validated an artificial intelligence (AI) model that uses radiology reports and clinical data to predict the future risk of pancreatic cancer in patients with PCLs. The model was developed and tested in a 13-year retrospective cohort comprising 23,398 abdominal CT/MRI examination reports from 8707 patients with PCLs across a multisite healthcare system. Of these, 430 (1.8%) corresponded to patients who later developed pancreatic cancer, defined as adenocarcinoma, invasive mucinous neoplasm, or high-grade dysplasia. Among the models evaluated, XGBoost achieved the highest performance, with AUCs of 0.960, 0.945, and 0.944 for predicting pancreatic cancer incidence at 1, 3, and 5 years after imaging, respectively. The model outperformed guideline-based risk stratification, with AUC improvements of 0.161 to 0.235 (P < 0.001). For examinations conducted within a year before cancer diagnosis, radiologists identified potential cancer in 51.5% of cases, while the AI model flagged 82.3%. These findings support the potential of AI to complement existing approaches for individualized pancreatic cancer risk stratification in patients with PCLs.
zh_abstract: 胰腺囊性病变（PCLs）较为常见，是胰腺癌的潜在前体。癌症风险评估是PCL管理中的关键步骤，但现有方法的复杂性和有限的准确性导致患者诊疗欠佳。我们开发并验证了一种人工智能（AI）模型，利用放射学报告和临床数据预测PCL患者未来发生胰腺癌的风险。该模型在一个为期13年的回顾性队列中开发和测试，该队列包含来自多中心医疗系统8707例PCL患者的23,398份腹部CT/MRI检查报告。其中430份（1.8%）对应后来发生胰腺癌（定义为腺癌、浸润性黏液性肿瘤或高级别异型增生）的患者。在所评估的模型中，XGBoost表现最佳，预测影像检查后1年、3年和5年胰腺癌发病的AUC分别为0.960、0.945和0.944。该模型优于基于指南的风险分层，AUC提高0.161至0.235（P < 0.001）。对于在癌症诊断前一年内进行的检查，放射科医生识别出潜在癌症的比例为51.5%，而AI模型标记出82.3%。这些结果支持AI可补充现有方法，用于PCL患者胰腺癌风险的个体化分层。

title: CTLink: A Text-Prompted Segmentation Model for Linking Radiology Report Findings to 3D Chest CT Scans
zh_title: CTLink：文本提示分割模型，将放射报告发现关联到3D胸部CT
summary: 提出文本提示的3D分割模型CTLink，并发布新标注数据集ReXGroundingCTv2，验证集上显著优于VoxTell。
key_points: 训练于4123例CT、9547个分割发现
新标注1134例、1895个发现
验证集命中率0.816，高于0.533
reason: 新增标注数据集并在挑战赛测试集取得最高成绩，视觉-语言方向；预印本
abstract: Radiology reports describe findings in text only, without visually marking them on the scan, so readers cannot directly see which abnormality each reported finding refers to. We introduce CTLink, a text-prompted 3D segmentation model that segments findings described in a chest CT report. CTLink was trained on 4123 noncontrast chest CT scans with 9547 segmented report findings, including ReXGroundingCTv2, a newly annotated dataset of 1134 scans and 1895 findings with every instance of each finding segmented. On the 200 ReXGroundingCT validation scans, CTLink achieved a hit rate of 0.816, an instance F1 score of 0.456, and a mean Dice score of 0.400, compared with 0.533, 0.175, and 0.234 for VoxTell, a publicly available text-prompted segmentation model (P < .001 for all). On the test set of the MICCAI 2026 ReXGrounding challenge, an ensemble of seven CTLink models achieved the highest hit rate (0.782) and instance F1 score (0.386) of all 48 participating teams. On 50 test scans segmented twice by independent radiologists, CTLink matched or exceeded inter-rater agreement. Diffuse non-focal findings remained the main limitation, partly because their extent is outlined inconsistently even between radiologists. The CTLink model weights are available at https://huggingface.co/rajpurkarlab/CTLink, and the dataset at https://huggingface.co/datasets/rajpurkarlab/ReXGroundingCT.
zh_abstract: 放射学报告仅以文字描述所见，而不在扫描图像上以视觉方式标注，因此读者无法直接看出每条报告所见对应的是哪处异常。我们提出 CTLink，一种文本提示的三维分割模型，可对胸部 CT 报告中描述的所见进行分割。CTLink 在 4123 例非增强胸部 CT 扫描及 9547 个已分割的报告所见上训练，其中包括 ReXGroundingCTv2——一个新标注的数据集，含 1134 例扫描和 1895 个所见，每个所见的每一个实例均已分割。在 200 例 ReXGroundingCT 验证扫描上，CTLink 的命中率为 0.816，实例 F1 分数为 0.456，平均 Dice 分数为 0.400；而公开可用的文本提示分割模型 VoxTell 分别为 0.533、0.175 和 0.234（所有比较 P < .001）。在 MICCAI 2026 ReXGrounding 挑战赛的测试集上，由七个 CTLink 模型组成的集成在全部 48 支参赛队伍中取得了最高的命中率（0.782）和实例 F1 分数（0.386）。在由独立放射科医师重复分割两次的 50 例测试扫描上，CTLink 达到或超过了评估者间一致性。弥漫性非局灶性所见仍是主要局限，部分原因在于即使在放射科医师之间，其范围的勾画也不一致。CTLink 模型权重见 https://huggingface.co/rajpurkarlab/CTLink，数据集见 https://huggingface.co/datasets/rajpurkarlab/ReXGroundingCT。

title: PathStream: Towards Streaming Diagnostic Copilots for Whole-Slide Pathology
zh_title: PathStream：面向全切片病理的流式诊断助手
summary: 提出病理医生主导的流式诊断任务，记录5位病理医生在1,791张TCGA全切片上的浏览轨迹，构建PathStreamBench并提出PathStream。
key_points: 5位病理医生、1,791张WSI、10个器官
构建评估响应时机、描述与诊断的基准
助手随浏览选择性描述并综合证据
reason: 新病理基准与人机协作范式，契合偏好；预印本
abstract: Pathologists reach a diagnosis by integrating morphological evidence across regions and magnifications along viewing trajectories. Existing pathology AI rarely reflects this process: models predict from selected image regions, answer questions within fixed visual contexts, or navigate slides autonomously. We formalize pathologist-led streaming diagnosis, in which the pathologist controls navigation while a copilot selectively describes incoming views and synthesizes accumulated evidence into a final diagnosis. We record five pathologists' viewing trajectories on 1,791 TCGA whole-slide images (WSIs) spanning ten organs, with response labels, morphological descriptions, and session-level findings and diagnoses. We construct PathStreamBench to assess response timing, morphological description, and session-level diagnosis, alongside auxiliary video understanding. We introduce PathStream, which jointly learns streaming responses and diagnosis through two-stage training, with a diagnosis-attention loss guiding attention during diagnosis to relevant visual and textual evidence accumulated as the examination unfolds. PathStream outperforms 14 vision-language models and three domain-fine-tuned baselines on the core tasks, achieving a trajectory WSI Relevance score of 77.87, surpassing the strongest domain-fine-tuned baseline's 62.76. Without additional training, its diagnostic capabilities generalize to new educational pathology videos, three external centers, and an unseen organ.
zh_abstract: 病理医生通过沿着观察轨迹整合不同区域和放大倍数下的形态学证据来做出诊断。现有的病理人工智能很少体现这一过程：模型根据选定的图像区域进行预测，在固定的视觉上下文中回答问题，或自主浏览切片。我们形式化了由病理医生主导的流式诊断（pathologist-led streaming diagnosis），即由病理医生控制浏览，而辅助系统（copilot）有选择地描述新出现的视野，并将累积的证据综合为最终诊断。我们在涵盖十个器官的 1,791 张 TCGA 全切片图像（WSI）上记录了五位病理医生的观察轨迹，并给出了响应标签、形态学描述以及会话级别的发现与诊断。我们构建了 PathStreamBench，用于评估响应时机、形态学描述和会话级别诊断，同时包含辅助的视频理解任务。我们提出了 PathStream，它通过两阶段训练联合学习流式响应与诊断，并采用诊断注意力损失（diagnosis-attention loss），引导模型在诊断时关注随检查推进而累积的相关视觉和文本证据。在核心任务上，PathStream 优于 14 个视觉-语言模型和三个领域微调基线，其轨迹 WSI 相关性（Relevance）得分为 77.87，超过最强的领域微调基线的 62.76。无需额外训练，其诊断能力即可泛化到新的教学病理视频、三个外部中心以及一个未见过的器官。

title: Medical Reasoning in Large Language Models: Development and Evaluation of the MedEvalArena Benchmark.
source: PubMed · Journal of medical Internet research
zh_title: MedEvalArena：可再生成的医学推理大模型基准
summary: 六个前沿LLM互相出题、由LLM裁判组评估有效性并作答，构建可动态再生成的医学推理基准。
key_points: 6个前沿模型各贡献50道有效题
题目按AAMC/ABMS专科分布生成
采用对称循环赛与LLM评审团
reason: 新基准且对比多前沿模型，但依赖LLM评判，规模有限
abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] Large language models (LLMs) perform strongly on medical specialty board multiple-choice questions (MCQs) but underperform in complex medical reasoning. This gap indicates a need to improve LLM medical reasoning and evaluation paradigms. This study aimed to develop and evaluate MedEvalArena, a dynamically regenerable benchmark for assessing medical reasoning in LLMs. In a symmetric round-robin format, 6 frontier LLMs from the OpenAI, Grok, Gemini, Claude, Kimi, and DeepSeek families generated challenging board-style medical MCQs, adjudicated question validity on an ensemble LLM-as-judge panel, and answered the validated examination. Candidate items were generated until each model contributed 50 validated questions according to Association of American Medical Colleges (AAMC)/American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS) physician specialty distributions, yielding a 300-question examination. Judges adjudicated candidate questions' logical validity and medical accuracy. We compared question-generation validity rates, assessed leave-one-out judge agreement, and tested for self-judging preference. Questions were audited for overlap with public MedQA (medical question-answering) benchmarks. We tested question-answering (QA) accuracy across LLMs using a binomial-logit generalized linear mixed model likelihood-ratio test. A generator-stratified 90-question subset was completed by 5 board-certified physicians for paired human-LLM analysis. We evaluated inference cost-accuracy tradeoffs. Multiple comparisons were adjusted by the Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) procedure. zh_abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] 大语言模型（LLM）在医学专科委员会选择题（MCQ）上表现出色，但在复杂医学推理方面表现欠佳。这一差距表明需要改进LLM的医学推理能力和评估范式。本研究旨在开发并评估MedEvalArena，这是一个可动态再生的、用于评估LLM医学推理的基准。在对称循环赛形式中，来自OpenAI、Grok、Gemini、Claude、Kimi和DeepSeek系列的6个前沿LLM生成具有挑战性的委员会风格医学选择题，由LLM裁判组合小组（ensemble LLM-as-judge panel）判定题目有效性，并回答经验证的考试。按照美国医学院协会（AAMC）/美国医学专科委员会（ABMS）的医师专科分布生成候选题目，直至每个模型贡献50道经验证的题目，形成300题的考试。裁判对候选题目的逻辑有效性和医学准确性进行判定。我们比较了出题有效率，评估了留一法裁判一致性，并检验了自我评判偏好。对题目与公开的MedQA（医学问答）基准的重叠情况进行了审查。我们使用二项-logit广义线性混合模型似然比检验比较了各LLM的问答（QA）准确率。由5名获得委员会认证的医师完成了按出题者分层的90题子集，用于人类与LLM的配对分析。我们评估了推理成本与准确率的权衡。多重比较采用Benjamini-Hochberg（BH）方法校正。裁判小组判定的有效率在OpenAI（94.8%，Wilson 95% CI 85.9%–98.2%）、Gemini（92.3%，95% CI 83.2%–96.7%）和Claude（83.3%，95% CI 72.6%–90.4%）模型生成的题目中显著高于Kimi（63.8%，95% CI 54.3%–72.4%）、Grok（56%，95% CI 45.8%–65.8%）和DeepSeek（46.0%，95% CI 37.4%–54.7%）。Kimi的有效率也显著高于DeepSeek（两样本比例检验；BH校正后P=.01）。公开来源相似性审查未发现完全相同或近似重复的匹配。留一法裁判一致性为中等。针对出题者的同系列裁判系数为非负（0至11.0个百分点）；但经BH校正后均无显著性。在300题考试中，6个前沿LLM的QA准确率介于85.7%（257/300）至91.7%（275/300）之间，差异无显著性（广义线性混合模型……（原文截断））

title: SleepXA: Composing Pretrained Neural and Cardiac Foundation Models for Sleep Representation Learning
zh_title: SleepXA：组合预训练脑电与心脏基础模型的睡眠表征学习
summary: 利用同步多导睡眠监测数据，将独立预训练的EEG与ECG基础模型组合，在三个大型队列9,230晚记录上预训练，并在27项下游任务评估。
key_points: 组合已有EEG与ECG基础模型
9,230晚PSG，三个大型队列预训练
27项下游任务评估
reason: 睡眠基础模型、大规模队列、多任务评估，契合偏好；预印本
abstract: Physiological signals recorded during sleep provide synchronized views of neural, cardiac, respiratory, and other bodily systems, while preserving modality-specific information. Existing EEG and ECG foundation models already capture rich but distinct physiological structure, motivating an alternative to training a multimodal sleep model from scratch: composing existing pretrained models. We introduce SleepXA, a framework that uses synchronized polysomnography (PSG) to compose independently pretrained neural and cardiac foundation models. SleepXA combines pretrained EEG and ECG encoders with lightweight encoders for additional PSG modalities, and learns shared and modality-specific representations through sleep-guided alignment. We pretrain SleepXA on 9,230 overnight PSG recordings from three large cohorts and evaluate it on 27 downstream tasks spanning sleep representation, clinical and disease prediction, and daytime physiological transfer. SleepXA ranks among the top two methods on 22 of 27 tasks. Controlled experiments further show consistent benefits across sensor configurations and EEG-ECG backbone choices, while pretrained initialization outperforms architecture-matched training from scratch and SleepXA surpasses alternative multimodal composition strategies. These results suggest that synchronized multimodal physiology can serve as a natural interface for composing existing physiological foundation models, yielding reusable representations that extend beyond sleep to clinical and daytime physiological settings.
zh_abstract: 睡眠期间记录的生理信号提供了神经、心脏、呼吸及其他身体系统的同步视角，同时保留了各模态特有的信息。现有的脑电（EEG）和心电（ECG）基础模型已经捕捉到丰富但各不相同的生理结构，这促使人们寻求一种替代从头训练多模态睡眠模型的方法：组合现有的预训练模型。我们提出了 SleepXA，这一框架利用同步多导睡眠图（PSG）来组合独立预训练的神经和心脏基础模型。SleepXA 将预训练的 EEG 和 ECG 编码器与用于其他 PSG 模态的轻量级编码器相结合，并通过睡眠引导的对齐学习共享表示和模态特异性表示。我们在来自三个大型队列的 9,230 份整夜 PSG 记录上预训练 SleepXA，并在涵盖睡眠表征、临床与疾病预测以及日间生理迁移的 27 项下游任务上进行评估。SleepXA 在 27 项任务中的 22 项位列前两名。对照实验进一步表明，其在不同传感器配置和 EEG-ECG 主干选择下均有一致的收益，预训练初始化优于架构相同的从头训练，且 SleepXA 超越了其他多模态组合策略。这些结果表明，同步的多模态生理信号可作为组合现有生理基础模型的天然接口，产生可复用的表示，其适用范围从睡眠扩展到临床和日间生理场景。

abstract: [Journal of chemical information and modeling] Accurately predicting absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity (ADMET) properties remains a major challenge in accelerating drug discovery, especially for underexplored natural products (NPs). Herein, we present a unified multitask learning framework that integrated heterogeneous network (HN) embeddings and a modified kernel-based deep neural network (DNN) to simultaneously predict all ADMET properties. Our model named as hdADMET captures complex molecular interactions through HNs that incorporated compound-drug relationships, experimental validated ADMET features, and the interrelationships among ADMET properties to transform the embedding representations into a kernel-based DNN for boosting the learning ability of the prediction model. Hold-out cross-validation on benchmark data sets, including ChEMBL, BindingDB, CTRPandGDSC, and NPASS, demonstrated improved and robust accuracy through data integration. Compared with the state-of-the-art multitask models, the hdADMET model achieved competitive performance with a significantly lower computational cost. Its practical utility was further demonstrated by accurately predicting the ADMET profiles of newly identified NPs mined from the literature studies. The promising candidate with high anticancer activity, low toxicity, and favorable metabolic properties was identified for further experimental validation. The hdADMET model offered an alternative way to prioritize leading compounds for clinical translation through HN embeddings and deep learning.

title: A Multiagent Large Language Model Framework for Longitudinal Multimodal Tracking of Wet Age-Related Macular Degeneration: Retrospective Feasibility Study.

summary: 基于GPT-4o与AutoGen构建三层多智能体框架，整合湿性AMD随访中的多模态影像与治疗记录并生成结构化报告，为概念验证可行性研究。

abstract: [JMIR formative research] Wet age-related macular degeneration (AMD) requires long-term, high-frequency management involving multimodal retinal imaging across repeated follow-up visits. Reconstructing disease trajectories from fragmented imaging reports, treatment histories, and clinical notes creates a substantial information integration burden for clinicians in routine chronic disease management. This study aimed to evaluate the preliminary feasibility of a proof-of-concept, multiagent large language model (LLM) framework that integrates longitudinal multimodal imaging findings and treatment records into structured reports to support clinician review during wet AMD follow-up. We developed a 3-layer multiagent LLM framework using GPT-4o and AutoGen. The framework consisted of modality-specific perception agents using a visual grounding prompting strategy, an integration agent, and a tracking report agent. To test technical feasibility, the framework was evaluated on a dense retrospective pilot dataset of 12 patients encompassing 69 long-term follow-up visits. AI-generated outputs were assessed against expert review at the visit level and through report-level quality scoring. In this exploratory cohort, the framework achieved a mean visit-level activity classification accuracy of 80.8% (SD 3.4%) across 4 independent runs (range 78.3%-85.5%), with a mean Cohen κ of 0.605 (SD 0.072; range 0.549-0.705). The framework generated structured longitudinal summaries of disease activity, multimodal findings, and treatment histories. The visual grounding prompting strategy reduced the nonimage reference rate from 13.8% (12/87) to 1.1% (1/87), supporting more consistent grounding of image-based outputs in visual evidence. This proof-of-concept study supports the preliminary feasibility of using a multiagent LLM framework to organize longitudinal multimodal wet AMD follow-up data and produce structured summaries for clinician review. These reports are intended to support review of disease progression and treatment response associations during longitudinal follow-up. Future prospective multicenter studies with larger patient cohorts should evaluate whether these reports improve clinical workflow efficiency, reduce clinician workload, and support follow-up management decisions.

key_points: 结合覆盖理论与生成式AI

abstract: [Journal of chemical information and modeling] Proteins are highly diverse functional polymers where the specific sequence of amino acids, selected from a standard genetically encoded alphabet of 20 (C20), determines the structure and ultimately the function of the resulting folded protein. This standard alphabet has been identified to be nonrandomly distributed in physicochemical properties crucial to both structure formation and function, often referred to as coverage theory. While machine learning models have drastically improved protein structure prediction, success of protein design models lags structure prediction, particularly for custom secondary structure motifs and amino acid alphabets. Here, we therefore bridge contemporary biological theory with recent advancements in artificial intelligence (AI) to develop and evaluate a generative AI protein design model, trained on hundreds of thousands of proteins within the RCSB PDB, for custom secondary structure motifs using reduced amino acid alphabets (RAAs). Results indicate an overall success in designing novel proteins with desired secondary structure motifs for a broad range of amino acid alphabets and complexity of designs. Interestingly, for a substantial fraction of designs, ESMFold predicts a fold close to that of the target structure despite training only on physicochemical sequence space and secondary structure information. The development of this model advances research across multiple disciplines, from general scientific AI architecture development to protein design for biotechnology, astrobiology, and early-Earth evolutionary biology.
zh_abstract: [Journal of chemical information and modeling] 蛋白质是高度多样的功能性聚合物，其特定氨基酸序列选自标准的、由遗传编码的 20 种字母表（C20），决定了折叠后蛋白质的结构并最终决定其功能。该标准字母表已被发现在对结构形成和功能都至关重要的理化性质上呈非随机分布，这通常被称为覆盖理论（coverage theory）。尽管机器学习模型已极大改进了蛋白质结构预测，但蛋白质设计模型的成功仍落后于结构预测，尤其是针对自定义二级结构基序和氨基酸字母表时。因此，我们在此将当代生物学理论与人工智能（AI）的最新进展相结合，开发并评估了一个生成式 AI 蛋白质设计模型，该模型在 RCSB PDB 中数十万个蛋白质上训练，使用精简氨基酸字母表（RAAs）针对自定义二级结构基序进行设计。结果表明，对于各种氨基酸字母表及不同复杂度的设计，该模型总体上成功设计出具有所需二级结构基序的新型蛋白质。有趣的是，对于相当比例的设计，尽管仅在理化序列空间和二级结构信息上训练，ESMFold 预测出的折叠仍与目标结构接近。该模型的开发推动了多个学科的研究，从通用科学 AI 架构的开发，到生物技术、天体生物学和早期地球进化生物学的蛋白质设计。

title: Humans show limited ability to distinguish human-authored from AI-generated political content on social media.
source: PubMed · Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
zh_title: 人类难以区分人写与AI生成的政治社媒内容
summary: 行为实验显示，参与者辨别2024年美国总统辩论相关帖子是否为AI生成时仅略高于随机，对新LLM更弱。
key_points: 比较六种LLM生成帖与人类帖

abstract: [Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America] This study employs a set of behavioral experiments to examine how individuals perceive the humanness of social media posts about the 2024 U.S. presidential debate between Kamala Harris and Donald Trump. Posts presented in the experiment were authored either by humans or chatbots, varying the large language model (LLM), the model architecture, the social media platform, and the political personas. Participants judged randomly paired posts to identify which they perceived to be AI-generated. We find that human-authored posts were on average perceived as more human-like than AI outputs generated from five of the six LLMs in this study. However, participants' ability to detect AI-generated content is limited. They do so only slightly above chance in human-AI pairs, and this ability weakens for newer LLMs, varies by platform, and reflects partisan bias. Only posts generated with Llama 3.3 scored, on average, higher on perceived humanness than human-authored posts. The social media platform also mattered, with participants distinguishing human from AI on most platforms (YouTube, TikTok, Truth Social), but not on X/Twitter. Incivility and negative emotions are associated with high humanness perceptions, and partisan identity also shaped evaluations, with Republican respondents more likely to view ideologically misaligned AI posts as AI-generated.
zh_abstract: [美国国家科学院院刊] 本研究采用一组行为实验，考察个体如何感知有关 2024 年美国总统竞选中卡玛拉·哈里斯与唐纳德·特朗普辩论的社交媒体帖子的“人类程度”。实验中呈现的帖子由人类或聊天机器人撰写，并在大语言模型（LLM）、模型架构、社交媒体平台和政治人设方面有所变化。参与者对随机配对的帖子进行判断，指出他们认为哪一条由人工智能生成。我们发现，平均而言，人类撰写的帖子被认为比本研究中六个 LLM 中五个所生成的 AI 输出更像人类。然而，参与者识别 AI 生成内容的能力有限：在人类—AI 配对中仅略高于随机水平，且这种能力对于较新的 LLM 会减弱，因平台而异，并体现出党派偏见。只有用 Llama 3.3 生成的帖子，其平均人类程度感知得分高于人类撰写的帖子。社交媒体平台也有影响：参与者在大多数平台（YouTube、TikTok、Truth Social）上能够区分人类与 AI，但在 X/Twitter 上则不能。不文明用语和负面情绪与较高的人类程度感知相关，党派身份也影响评价，共和党受访者更倾向于将意识形态上不一致的 AI 帖子视为 AI 生成。

title: TrialAgentBench: Evaluating AI Agents for Clinical-Trial Analysis and Long-Horizon Drug-Development Decisions
zh_title: TrialAgentBench：评估AI智能体的临床试验分析与药物开发决策
summary: 发布含约3500项任务的基准，利用已知真值的模拟试验评估AI智能体在试验分析及多阶段药物开发项目决策中的能力，并测试24个模型。
key_points: 公开约3500个任务，从单试验到多期项目
重跑代码于新试验评分，按决策价值评估项目
评估24个闭源与开源模型
reason: 公开基准，涉及药物开发智能体，但为模拟数据预印本
abstract: Clinical drug development is a long-horizon, high-stakes process requiring sequential decisions based on information that costs money and time to acquire. AI agents have demonstrated capabilities for scientific analysis, but there is no established way to evaluate them on these decisions, as real trials are expensive, involve people, and never reveal the counterfactual. We introduce TrialAgentBench, a benchmark for evaluating AI agents on clinical trial analysis and drug development decision-making using simulated trials where the truth is known, embedded within the data records of a fictional drug sponsor. We publicly release nearly 3,500 tasks, varying from analysing a single trial to managing multi-phase programmes with budget and time constraints. We score each analysis by rerunning its code on new trials, and each programme by the value its decisions achieve. Across 24 closed- and open-weight models, the strongest agents can analyse raw, messy trial records to within 6% of a process-aware analysis, even when an assumption is violated, with 95% confidence intervals containing the true effect 94--95% of the time. Over the prior year, the best model improved from 19% above this analysis, with serious misses on 15% of tasks, to 3.5% and 1%. What limits them is decision-making from evidence under uncertainty: when to correct, what evidence to buy, when to stop. The strongest agents are overly careful, correcting on 83% of tasks with equal recording errors, where it is unnecessary. On drug programmes, the best agent has substantial headroom, reaching 48% of the value an oracle achieves against 58% for a rule-based developer, with others falling 24 to 66% short. Model generations show ongoing improvements in handling data and evidence, with substantial variation. The strongest models can act as competent analysts, but do not yet make reliable long-horizon decisions.
zh_abstract: 临床药物研发是一个周期长、风险高的过程，需要基于获取时耗费金钱和时间的信息做出一系列序贯决策。AI 智能体已展现出科学分析能力，但目前尚无公认的方法来评估其在这类决策上的表现，因为真实试验成本高昂、涉及受试者，且永远无法揭示反事实结果。我们提出 TrialAgentBench，这是一个用于评估 AI 智能体在临床试验分析和药物研发决策方面表现的基准，它使用真值已知的模拟试验，并将其嵌入一家虚构药物申办方的数据记录中。我们公开发布了近 3,500 项任务，范围从分析单个试验到在预算和时间约束下管理多阶段研发项目。我们通过在新试验上重新运行代码来对每项分析评分，并以决策所实现的价值来对每个研发项目评分。在 24 个闭源和开放权重模型中，最强的智能体能够分析原始、杂乱的试验记录，其结果与考虑过程的分析相差不超过 6%，即使在某一假设被违反时也是如此，其 95% 置信区间包含真实效应的比例为 94%–95%。在过去一年中，最佳模型从高于该分析 19%、并在 15% 的任务中出现严重失误，改善至 3.5% 和 1%。限制这些智能体的是在不确定性下基于证据做决策：何时进行校正、购买何种证据、何时停止。最强的智能体过于谨慎，在 83% 记录错误相同、无需校正的任务中仍进行了校正。在药物研发项目上，最佳智能体仍有很大提升空间，达到先知（oracle）所获价值的 48%，而基于规则的研发者为 58%，其他智能体则低 24% 至 66%。不同模型世代在处理数据和证据方面持续改进，但差异显著。最强的模型可以充当称职的分析师，但尚不能做出可靠的长周期决策。

abstract: [BJU international] Our objective was to evaluate artificial intelligence (AI)-based Gleason grading of prostate cancer (PCa) biopsies compared with expert pathologist-based consensus grading and clinical risk factors for predicting biochemical recurrence (BCR) after radical prostatectomy. Although Gleason grading is the most validated prognostic factor in PCa, interobserver variability may affect its prognostic accuracy, particularly for intermediate-risk tumours and non-subspecialty pathologists. Whole-slide images from PCa biopsy specimens were analysed in patients originally diagnosed with grade group (GG)-2 PCa by general pathologists; patients subsequently underwent radical prostatectomy (n = 217). A representative biopsy slide containing up to two cores was analysed per case. Gleason scores were re-assigned by consensus among three genitourinary pathologists or by AI model. Cox proportional hazards models were constructed using CAPRA (Cancer of the Prostate Risk Assessment) score, percent pattern 4 (%p4), and cribriform/intraductal carcinoma, derived from either pathologist consensus or AI-based grading. Discrimination was described with Harrell's C-index; the pathologist-based and AI-based multivariable models were formally compared using Uno's C-statistic, 3- and 5-year time-dependent area under the curve, and Akaike information criterion. In total, 35 patients (16%) had BCR. In univariable models, AI-based GG had a numerically higher C-index than consensus pathologist GG (0.66 vs 0.61). Similarly, CAPRA score incorporating AI-based GG (AI-CAPRA) had a numerically higher C-index than that incorporating consensus-pathologist GG (pathologist-CAPRA) (0.68 vs 0.65). In multivariable models, AI-detected cribriform/intraductal carcinoma independently predicted an increased risk of BCR when combined with AI-CAPRA and AI %p4 (hazard ratio 2.97; 95% confidence interval 1.11-7.91), whereas neither pathologist-detected cribriform/intraductal carcinoma nor pathologist-detected %p4 was independently prognostic when combined with pathologist-CAPRA. AI-based Gleason grading had prognostic performance similar to that of expert pathologist consensus grading, alone or combined with clinical variables. AI-detected (but not pathologist-detected) cribriform/intraductal carcinoma had independent prognostic value in multivariable models with CAPRA score. These findings support a role for AI-assisted pathology in PCa risk stratification, particularly in settings without subspecialty genitou
zh_abstract: [BJU international] 我们的目的是评估基于人工智能（AI）的前列腺癌（PCa）活检 Gleason 分级，与专家病理医师共识分级及临床风险因素相比，在预测根治性前列腺切除术后生化复发（BCR）方面的表现。尽管 Gleason 分级是 PCa 中验证最充分的预后因素，但观察者间变异可能影响其预后准确性，尤其是对中危肿瘤以及非亚专科病理医师而言。我们分析了 PCa 活检标本的全切片图像，这些患者最初由普通病理医师诊断为分级组（GG）2 的 PCa，随后接受了根治性前列腺切除术（n = 217）。每例分析一张包含最多两条穿刺针芯的代表性活检切片。Gleason 评分由三位泌尿生殖系统病理医师共识或由 AI 模型重新评定。利用 CAPRA（Cancer of the Prostate Risk Assessment）评分、4 级成分百分比（%p4）以及筛状/导管内癌，分别基于病理医师共识或 AI 分级构建 Cox 比例风险模型。区分度以 Harrell C 指数描述；基于病理医师和基于 AI 的多变量模型采用 Uno C 统计量、3 年和 5 年时间依赖性曲线下面积以及赤池信息准则进行正式比较。共有 35 例患者（16%）发生 BCR。在单变量模型中，基于 AI 的 GG 的 C 指数在数值上高于病理医师共识 GG（0.66 对 0.61）。同样，纳入基于 AI 的 GG 的 CAPRA 评分（AI-CAPRA）的 C 指数在数值上高于纳入病理医师共识 GG 的 CAPRA 评分（病理医师-CAPRA）（0.68 对 0.65）。在多变量模型中，当与 AI-CAPRA 和 AI %p4 联合时，AI 检出的筛状/导管内癌可独立预测 BCR 风险增加（风险比 2.97；95% 置信区间 1.11-7.91），而与病理医师-CAPRA 联合时，病理医师检出的筛状/导管内癌和病理医师检出的 %p4 均不具有独立预后价值。基于 AI 的 Gleason 分级无论单独使用还是与临床变量联合，其预后表现均与专家病理医师共识分级相近。在包含 CAPRA 评分的多变量模型中，AI 检出的（而非病理医师检出的）筛状/导管内癌具有独立预后价值。这些发现支持 AI 辅助病理在 PCa 风险分层中发挥作用，尤其是在缺乏泌尿生殖系统亚专科

source: PubMed · Minimally invasive therapy & allied technologies : MITAT : official journal of the Society for Minimally Invasive Therapy
