summary: 该综述梳理支撑病理基础模型的AI与深度学习演进，并调研学术界和产业界公开报道的主要全切片图像基础模型。
key_points: 聚焦基于WSI训练的病理基础模型
称可减少标注负担、提升泛化并支持多模态建模
采用叙述性文献检索，涵盖期刊与预印本
reason: 有信息量的综述，上限6档；命中病理基础模型偏好小幅上调
abstract: [Minimally invasive therapy & allied technologies : MITAT : official journal of the Society for Minimally Invasive Therapy] Foundation models (FMs) are transforming artificial intelligence by generating large-scale representations of data that can be adapted across diverse downstream tasks. In computational pathology, the emergence of FMs trained on whole-slide images (WSIs) promises to reduce annotation burden, improve generalization, and enable multimodal disease modeling. This review summarizes the evolution in AI and deep learning that enabled pathology FM and surveys major publicly reported models developed by both academia and industry. To construct a comprehensive and representative survey of pathology foundation models, we performed a narrative literature search targeting peer-reviewed journals, preprint repositories (arXiv, medRxiv), and major Artificial Intelligence in medicine conferences up to mid-2026. The search strategy utilized combinations of keywords including 'pathology foundation model', 'self-supervised learning whole-slide images', and 'computational pathology vision transformers'. The survey highlights the current landscape of high-performing models while discussing their clinical promise alongside key technical and implementation challenges. Pathology foundation models represent a significant shift in the field. Future directions must focus on developing multimodal architectures and achieving seamless clinical integration to fully realize their potential.
zh_abstract: [Minimally invasive therapy & allied technologies : MITAT : official journal of the Society for Minimally Invasive Therapy] 基础模型（FM）通过生成可适配多种下游任务的大规模数据表征，正在改变人工智能。在计算病理学中，基于全切片图像（WSI）训练的基础模型的出现，有望减轻标注负担、提高泛化能力并实现多模态疾病建模。本综述总结了促成病理基础模型的人工智能和深度学习的发展历程，并梳理了学术界和产业界公开报道的主要模型。为构建全面且具有代表性的病理基础模型综述，我们针对同行评审期刊、预印本库（arXiv、medRxiv）以及截至2026年年中的主要医学人工智能会议进行了叙述性文献检索。检索策略使用了包括“pathology foundation model”“self-supervised learning whole-slide images”和“computational pathology vision transformers”等关键词的组合。本综述重点介绍了当前高性能模型的概况，同时讨论了其临床前景以及关键的技术和实施挑战。病理基础模型代表了该领域的重大转变。未来的方向必须聚焦于开发多模态架构并实现无缝的临床整合，以充分发挥其潜力。

title: Decompose and Describe: Narrowing the Diagnosis-to-Report Gap in 3D CT Report Generation
zh_title: 分解与描述：缩小3D CT报告生成的诊断到报告差距
summary: 发现五个医学VLM在诊断VQA优于报告生成，提出DeCAD按诊断、区域文本和区域视觉逐级分解生成报告。
key_points: 揭示诊断到报告差距
常规报告适配无法弥合差距
DeCAD逐级分解诊断与区域描述
reason: 预印本，多模型对比有新方法，VLM方向加分
abstract: Automated 3D CT report generation could support radiology workflows, yet medical vision-language models (MedVLMs) often omit diagnostic findings from generated reports. We ask whether the diagnostic ability of these models carries over to free-form reporting. Across five MedVLMs, diagnostic VQA achieves higher macro-F1 than reports generated from the same CT studies and evaluated on the same disease categories. We call this task-dependent discrepancy the diagnosis-to-report gap. Conventional Report Adaptation improves reporting for most models but does not close the gap. To investigate and narrow it, we introduce DeCAD (Decompose CT Analysis and Describe), which progressively decomposes CT report generation at diagnostic, regional textual, and regional visual levels. The model identifies positive findings before writing a report, organizes diagnosis and description into regional tasks, and restricts each task to visual tokens from the corresponding region. Diagnostic and regional textual decomposition improve report-level diagnostic performance across the five MedVLMs, whereas regional visual decomposition provides limited additional gains. In a standard VLM without medical VQA pretraining, the first two levels remain effective; regional visual decomposition also provides further gains with a region-level contrastively pretrained encoder. Full DeCAD achieves state-of-the-art performance on CT-RATE and Merlin. Analyses show greater CT-token attention during diagnosis and higher recall of reference-positive findings in both the diagnostic output and final report than with Report Adaptation. These results show that explicitly organizing diagnosis improves diagnostic reporting and helps narrow the diagnosis-to-report gap.
zh_abstract: 自动化三维CT报告生成可以辅助放射科工作流程，但医学视觉-语言模型（MedVLMs）生成的报告常常遗漏诊断性发现。我们探讨这些模型的诊断能力能否迁移到自由文本报告中。在五个MedVLM上，对于同一批CT检查并在相同疾病类别上进行评估时，诊断性VQA取得的宏平均F1（macro-F1）高于生成的报告。我们将这种与任务相关的差异称为“诊断到报告差距”（diagnosis-to-report gap）。传统的报告适配（Report Adaptation）可改善大多数模型的报告生成，但并未弥合该差距。为探究并缩小这一差距，我们提出DeCAD（Decompose CT Analysis and Describe），它在诊断层面、区域文本层面和区域视觉层面逐步分解CT报告生成。模型在撰写报告之前先识别阳性发现，将诊断与描述组织为区域性任务，并将每个任务限制为仅使用对应区域的视觉token。诊断层面和区域文本层面的分解提升了五个MedVLM在报告层面的诊断性能，而区域视觉层面的分解带来的额外增益有限。在未经医学VQA预训练的标准VLM中，前两个层面依然有效；当使用经区域级对比预训练的编码器时，区域视觉分解也能带来进一步增益。完整的DeCAD在CT-RATE和Merlin上取得了最先进的性能。分析显示，与报告适配相比，DeCAD在诊断过程中对CT token的注意力更高，并且在诊断输出和最终报告中对参考标准阳性发现的召回率更高。这些结果表明，显式地组织诊断过程可提升诊断性报告的质量，并有助于缩小诊断到报告的差距。

title: Rethinking Closed-Ended Medical VLM Evaluation: From Stable Wrongness to Counterfactual Answer Sensitivity
zh_title: 重审封闭式医学VLM评估：从稳定错误到反事实答案敏感性
summary: 指出医学VLM在封闭式VQA中存在“稳定错误”：移除或错配图像证据后仍给出自信且可重复的错误答案，使采样一致性类不确定性方法失效，并提出反事实方法。
key_points: 定义“稳定错误”失效模式
采样稳定性不确定性方法在此失效
引入反事实答案敏感性评估
reason: 揭示医学VLM评估缺陷，方法新颖；预印本，细节有限
abstract: As medical VLMs are increasingly evaluated for clinical decision-support scenarios, knowing when to trust their predictions is critical. Closed-ended medical VQA has become a common benchmark format because it enables automated scoring. Yet, systematic investigation into whether this format changes the reliability problem remains scarce. We identify a failure mode that we call stable wrongness: models can produce incorrect yes/no answers that remain confident and repeatable even when patient-specific visual evidence is removed or mismatched. This failure violates the premise behind sampling-stability uncertainty methods, including recent hallucination-aware calibration (HAC) variants: disagreement is informative only when errors are unstable. When shortcut-driven errors are themselves stable, sampling agreement can remain deceptively high. Motivated by this limitation, we introduce Counterfactual Answer Sensitivity (CAS), which shifts reliability estimation from answer stability to evidence sensitivity. CAS uses cross-modal counterfactual interventions, such as text-only, black, and corrupted images, to audit whether a committed yes/no answer remains supported when visual evidence is invalidated. Across 7 VLMs and 3 benchmarks, CAS outperforms the best HAC-family scores across all evaluated settings, achieving a macro-averaged AUROC gain of +0.150 for error detection. Mechanistic analysis further shows that CAS recovers hidden errors in the HAC-confident region and that its strongest standalone signal is counterfactual decision-boundary shift rather than hard prediction stability. Our findings suggest that closed-ended evaluation should test visual dependence, not only answer stability, in safety-critical medical contexts.
zh_abstract: 随着医学视觉语言模型（VLM）越来越多地被用于临床决策支持场景的评估，了解何时可以信任其预测至关重要。封闭式医学视觉问答（VQA）因可实现自动评分，已成为常见的基准形式。然而，关于这种形式是否改变了可靠性问题的系统性研究仍然匮乏。我们发现了一种称为“稳定性错误”（stable wrongness）的失效模式：即使患者特异性的视觉证据被移除或不匹配，模型仍可能给出错误的是/否答案，且这些答案具有高置信度并可重复。这种失效违背了基于采样稳定性的不确定性方法（包括近期的幻觉感知校准（HAC）变体）的前提：只有当错误不稳定时，分歧才具有信息量。当由捷径驱动的错误本身是稳定的时，采样一致性仍可能具有欺骗性地偏高。受这一局限启发，我们提出反事实答案敏感度（Counterfactual Answer Sensitivity，CAS），将可靠性估计由答案稳定性转向证据敏感性。CAS 使用跨模态反事实干预（如纯文本、黑色图像和被破坏的图像），审查在视觉证据失效时，已给出的是/否答案是否仍然有依据。在 7 个 VLM 和 3 个基准上，CAS 在所有评估设置中均优于最佳的 HAC 系列得分，错误检测的宏平均 AUROC 提升 +0.150。机制分析进一步表明，CAS 能够找回 HAC 高置信区域中隐藏的错误，且其最强的独立信号是反事实决策边界的偏移，而非硬预测稳定性。我们的发现表明，在安全攸关的医学场景中，封闭式评估应检验对视觉的依赖，而不仅仅是答案的稳定性。

title: ColonoWorld: Camera-Controlled Full-Procedure Colonoscopy Video Generation
zh_title: ColonoWorld：相机可控的全流程结肠镜视频生成
summary: 提出以相机轨迹和粗略结肠3D管道为条件的结肠镜世界模型，基于体内视频训练，可生成盲肠到直肠全流程视频并按位置时间放置息肉、器械等。
key_points: 可生成未见结肠形状的全程视频
可指定位置与时间放置息肉、器械和冲洗
面向自主导航系统的开发与评估
reason: 医学世界模型新方法，优于现有视频生成，预印本；偏好加分
abstract: Navigation systems in colonoscopy are advancing from guiding the endoscopist to steering the scope autonomously. Since an incorrect motion can injure the patient, developing and evaluating these systems calls for a world model of colonoscopy. Such a model must follow a commanded scope motion, keep the colon anatomy consistent, and show lesions and procedural events. Yet camera-controlled generators trained on general scenes lose the colon's structure under motion, and endoscopic generators offer no camera control. We present ColonoWorld, a colonoscopy world model conditioned on a camera trajectory and a coarse 3D tube of the colon, trained on in vivo videos. From a whole-colon tube, it generates a full cecum-to-rectum procedure, even for unseen colon shapes. It also places polyps, instruments, and irrigation at specified locations and times. ColonoWorld outperforms state-of-the-art video generators, reducing camera trajectory error by 32% and FVD by 29%. Our code and annotations will be released at https://aidaslab.github.io/ColonoWorld.
zh_abstract: 结肠镜导航系统正从引导内镜医师发展为自主操控内镜。由于错误的运动可能伤害患者，开发和评估这类系统需要一个结肠镜检查的世界模型。该模型必须能够遵循指令的内镜运动、保持结肠解剖结构的一致性，并呈现病变和操作事件。然而，在通用场景上训练的相机可控生成模型在运动过程中会丢失结肠的结构，而内镜生成模型又不提供相机控制。我们提出了 ColonoWorld，这是一个以相机轨迹和结肠粗略三维管状结构为条件、基于体内视频训练的结肠镜检查世界模型。给定整个结肠的管状结构，它可以生成从盲肠到直肠的完整检查过程，即使对于未见过的结肠形状也是如此。它还能在指定的位置和时间放置息肉、器械和冲洗。ColonoWorld 优于最先进的视频生成模型，使相机轨迹误差降低 32%，FVD 降低 29%。我们的代码和标注将在 https://aidaslab.github.io/ColonoWorld 发布。

title: System of agentic AI for the discovery of metal-organic frameworks.
zh_title: 面向金属有机框架发现的智能体AI系统MOFGen
summary: MOFGen由大语言模型、扩散模型、量子力学与可合成性智能体组成，生成数十万种MOF结构及可合成有机配体。
key_points: LLM提出组成，扩散模型生成晶体结构
量子力学智能体优化并筛选候选
可合成性智能体结合专家规则与机器学习
reason: AI驱动科学发现有新意，但属材料领域，非医疗，摘要无验证细节
abstract: [Nature computational science] Generative models and machine learning promise accelerated material discovery in metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) for CO2 capture and water harvesting, but face substantial challenges in navigating vast chemical spaces while ensuring synthesizability. Here we present MOFGen, a system of agentic artificial intelligence (AI) comprising interconnected agents: a large language model that proposes MOF compositions, a diffusion model that generates crystal structures, quantum mechanical agents that optimize and filter candidates, and synthetic-feasibility agents guided by expert rules and machine learning. Trained on a broad set of experimentally reported MOFs and computational databases, MOFGen generated hundreds of thousands of MOF structures and synthesizable organic linkers. The uniqueness of our approach lies in its ability to generate large MOF structures with atomic precision, beyond the scale of conventional generative models limited to tens of atoms. This approach was validated through high-throughput experiments and the successful synthesis of four 'AI-dreamt' MOFs.
zh_abstract: [Nature computational science] 生成模型和机器学习有望加速用于CO2捕集和水收集的金属有机框架（MOF）材料的发现，但在探索庞大化学空间并确保可合成性方面面临重大挑战。本文提出MOFGen，这是一个由相互连接的智能体组成的智能体式人工智能（AI）系统，包括：提出MOF组成的大语言模型、生成晶体结构的扩散模型、对候选物进行优化和筛选的量子力学智能体，以及由专家规则和机器学习引导的合成可行性智能体。MOFGen在大量已有实验报道的MOF和计算数据库上训练，生成了数十万个MOF结构和可合成的有机配体。我们方法的独特之处在于能够以原子精度生成大型MOF结构，超越了仅限于数十个原子的传统生成模型的规模。该方法通过高通量实验以及四种“AI构想”MOF的成功合成得到了验证。

title: GPT-4-Assisted Versus Human Detection of Intraoperative Adverse Events From Spine Surgery Operative Reports.
zh_title: GPT-4与人工从脊柱手术记录中识别术中不良事件
summary: 在单中心1454例椎板切除术手术记录中，比较GPT-4与四名人工审阅者检测术中不良事件的表现。
key_points: 回顾性队列，2016–2022年单机构
标准化提示词提取硬膜切开及其他事件
分歧由资深审阅者裁定作金标准
reason: 样本千余但单中心回顾性，仅内部验证，属中档
abstract: [Neurosurgery practice] Manual chart review remains the primary method of clinical data collection in spine surgery research but is time intensive and prone to human error. Large language models may enable automated extraction of clinically meaningful events from unstructured operative text. We evaluated the performance of generative pre-trained transformer 4 (GPT-4) in detecting intraoperative adverse events from spine surgery operative notes compared with trained human reviewers. A retrospective cohort of 1454 laminectomy cases performed at a single academic institution between 2016 and 2022 was analyzed. Deidentified operative notes were independently reviewed by 4 trained human reviewers and GPT-4 using standardized prompts to identify incidental durotomy and nondurotomy intraoperative adverse events. Discordant classifications were adjudicated by a senior reviewer to establish ground truth. Performance metrics including sensitivity, specificity, predictive values, and F1 score were calculated. Analyses were stratified by operative note length, and review time was estimated. Incidental durotomy occurred in 88 cases (6.1%). GPT-4 achieved 100.0% sensitivity compared with 89.8% for human reviewers, with lower positive predictive value (88.0% vs 100.0%) but similar specificity (99.1% vs 100.0%). For nondurotomy adverse events (n = 21), GPT-4 demonstrated higher sensitivity than humans (90.5% vs 57.1%) with equivalent specificity (100.0%). GPT-4 maintained stable performance across note length quartiles, whereas human reviewer sensitivity decreased for longer notes. Human reviewers required approximately 35 hours to review all notes, compared with approximately 2 hours for GPT-4. GPT-4 demonstrated higher observed sensitivity than trained human reviewers for detecting intraoperative adverse events from spine surgery operative reports while reducing review time by more than 90%. Large language model-assisted chart review may serve as a scalable human-in-the-loop adjunct to traditional chart review, improving the completeness and efficiency of neurosurgical outcomes research.
zh_abstract: [Neurosurgery practice] 人工病历审查仍是脊柱外科研究中临床数据收集的主要方法，但耗时且易出现人为错误。大语言模型或可从非结构化手术文本中自动提取具有临床意义的事件。我们评估了生成式预训练转换器4（GPT-4）在脊柱手术记录中检测术中不良事件的表现，并与经过培训的人工审查者进行比较。分析了一个单一学术机构在2016年至2022年间实施的1454例椎板切除术的回顾性队列。去标识化的手术记录由4名经过培训的人工审查者和GPT-4使用标准化提示独立审查，以识别意外硬脊膜切开和非硬脊膜切开类术中不良事件。不一致的分类由一名资深审查者裁定，以确立金标准。计算了敏感性、特异性、预测值和F1分数等性能指标。按手术记录长度分层分析，并估算了审查时间。意外硬脊膜切开发生于88例（6.1%）。GPT-4的敏感性为100.0%，人工审查者为89.8%；阳性预测值较低（88.0% vs 100.0%），特异性相近（99.1% vs 100.0%）。对于非硬脊膜切开类不良事件（n = 21），GPT-4的敏感性高于人工（90.5% vs 57.1%），特异性相当（100.0%）。GPT-4在各手术记录长度四分位数中表现稳定，而人工审查者的敏感性在较长记录中下降。人工审查者审查全部记录约需35小时，GPT-4约需2小时。在检测脊柱手术报告中的术中不良事件方面，GPT-4的观察敏感性高于经过培训的人工审查者，同时将审查时间缩短了90%以上。大语言模型辅助的病历审查可作为传统病历审查的可扩展人机协同辅助手段，提高神经外科结局研究的完整性和效率。

title: Development and Validation of an Artificial Intelligence-Driven Multigene Assay Decision-Support System for Personalized Management of T1 High-Grade Bladder Cancer.
zh_title: AI驱动多基因检测辅助T1高级别膀胱癌个体化管理
summary: 将多组学风险分层框架转化为Guider：整合30基因RT-qPCR检测与临床病理变量，预测T1高级别膀胱癌进展与复发，并含探索性治疗情境模块。
key_points: 由多组学T1HG-UCBguider转化为低成本RT-qPCR决策辅助
30基因TaqMan检测结合临床病理变量
预测进展与复发，含BCG等治疗情境探索模块
reason: 肿瘤预后预测、贴近临床转化；摘要未显示外部验证细节
abstract: [MedComm] T1 high-grade bladder cancer presents a therapeutic dilemma, as current risk stratification fails to guide the choice between early cystectomy and bladder-preserving therapy. In our recent work, we defined a high-risk multiomic subtype driven by anoikis resistance and immune evasion and developed the T1HG-UCBguider framework for risk stratification; however, its reliance on multiomic sequencing limits clinical implementation. Here, we translate this framework into Guider, an artificial intelligence-driven reverse transcription-quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) decision-aid designed for cost-conscious use in routine pathology workflows and integrating a 30-gene TaqMan assay with clinicopathological variables to predict progression and recurrence, with exploratory treatment-context modules for no instillation, Bacillus Calmette-Guérin, and intravesical chemotherapy. In a multicenter ambispective cohort of 1198 patients, Guider achieved > 10% higher absolute predictive performance than guideline-based risk groups and the published 12-gene progression score within this Chinese T1 high-grade cohort. Reclassification identified 82.5% of guideline-defined high-risk patients who progressed and 45.1% of very-high-risk nonprogressors who might be considered for bladder preservation. Guider could potentially support treatment de-escalation in 29.7% and escalation in 12.9% of patients. These findings establish a scalable translational framework bridging multiomic discovery and clinical decision support, warranting prospective interventional validation in geographically, ethnically, and demographically diverse populations.
zh_abstract: [MedComm] T1期高级别膀胱癌带来治疗上的两难，因为目前的风险分层无法指导在早期膀胱切除术与保留膀胱治疗之间做出选择。在我们近期的工作中，我们定义了一种由抗失巢凋亡和免疫逃逸驱动的高风险多组学亚型，并开发了用于风险分层的T1HG-UCBguider框架；然而，其对多组学测序的依赖限制了临床应用。在此，我们将该框架转化为Guider，这是一种人工智能驱动的逆转录定量聚合酶链反应（RT-qPCR）决策辅助工具，旨在以成本可控的方式用于常规病理工作流程，整合了30基因TaqMan检测与临床病理变量以预测进展和复发，并设有针对不灌注、卡介苗（Bacillus Calmette-Guérin）和膀胱灌注化疗的探索性治疗情境模块。在一项纳入1198例患者的多中心双向性队列中，在该中国T1高级别队列内，Guider的绝对预测性能比基于指南的风险分组和已发表的12基因进展评分高出10%以上。重新分类识别出82.5%发生进展的指南定义高危患者，以及45.1%未进展的极高危患者，这些患者可考虑保留膀胱。Guider有可能支持29.7%的患者降级治疗和12.9%的患者升级治疗。这些发现建立了一个可扩展的转化框架，连接多组学发现与临床决策支持，值得在地理、种族和人口特征多样的人群中开展前瞻性干预验证。

title: CT-Navigator: Towards Interpretable and Generalizable CT Understanding through Agentic Perception and Tool-Invocation
zh_title: CT-Navigator：基于智能体感知与工具调用的可解释CT理解
summary: 提出“智能体感知”范式，模拟放射科医生从整体扫描到切片与感兴趣区域的逐步阅片，并调用外部工具，以提升3D CT多模态大模型的可追溯解读。
key_points: 针对现有3D医学MLLM单跳指令训练、难以迭代推理
借鉴放射科医生阅片流程，逐步导航切片与区域
结合工具调用，使结论落地于视觉证据
reason: 新颖的CT智能体方法，命中多模态LLM偏好；预印本，摘要无结果数据
abstract: Clinical computed tomography (CT) interpretation inherently requires progressive visual exploration, where radiologists navigate from whole scans to individual slices and regions of interest and interact with external tools when necessary. However, existing 3D medical multimodal large language models (MLLMs) typically connect a specialized 3D visual encoder to a language model, without fully leveraging the native 2D visual and agentic capabilities of generalist MLLMs. Trained on large-scale one-hop CT instruction-following data, these models also have limited ability to perform iterative reasoning and explicitly ground their conclusions in visual evidence, limiting their support for traceable CT interpretation. To solve these problems, we propose \textbf{agentic perception} as an alternative paradigm inspired by radiologists' interpretation workflows. We introduce \textbf{CT-Navigator}, a framework that harnesses generalist MLLMs' 2D visual and agentic capabilities to progressively ground CT interpretation in explicit, traceable visual evidence through hierarchical visual exploration and radiology tool invocation. To build these capabilities, we curate 8,904 visual chain-of-thought (V-CoT) trajectories for cold-start agentic supervised fine-tuning. We then optimize the policy through reinforcement learning on 33,219 questions, with data selection and dynamic rollout sampling prioritizing informative learning signals. Finally, we introduce CTNavi-Bench, a 3D CT visual question answering benchmark comprising 7,000 questions spanning anatomical regions throughout the human body. CT-Navigator achieves 79.50\% accuracy on CTNavi-Bench, surpassing the strongest baseline by 17.59\%, and demonstrates strong generalization across three external CT benchmarks. The code, model, and benchmark will be released on \href{https://github.com/fyb99/ct_navigator}{GitHub}.
zh_abstract: 临床计算机断层扫描（CT）的解读本质上需要渐进式的视觉探索：放射科医生从整套扫描逐步深入到单个切片和感兴趣区域，并在必要时借助外部工具。然而，现有的三维医学多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）通常将专用的三维视觉编码器与语言模型相连接，未能充分利用通用MLLM原生的二维视觉能力和智能体（agentic）能力。这些模型在大规模单跳CT指令遵循数据上训练，进行迭代推理以及将结论明确建立在视觉证据之上的能力有限，从而限制了其对可追溯CT解读的支持。为解决这些问题，我们受放射科医生解读流程的启发，提出**智能体感知（agentic perception）**这一替代范式。我们提出**CT-Navigator**框架，它利用通用MLLM的二维视觉与智能体能力，通过层级式视觉探索和放射学工具调用，将CT解读逐步建立在明确、可追溯的视觉证据之上。为构建这些能力，我们整理了8,904条视觉思维链（V-CoT）轨迹，用于冷启动的智能体监督微调。随后，我们在33,219个问题上通过强化学习优化策略，并借助数据筛选和动态rollout采样来优先利用信息量大的学习信号。最后，我们提出CTNavi-Bench，这是一个包含7,000个问题、覆盖全身各解剖区域的三维CT视觉问答基准。CT-Navigator在CTNavi-Bench上取得79.50%的准确率，比最强基线高17.59%，并在三个外部CT基准上展现出较强的泛化能力。代码、模型和基准将在 \href{https://github.com/fyb99/ct_navigator}{GitHub} 上发布。

title: Decoupling Perception from Generation for Agentic 3D CT Report Generation
zh_title: 解耦感知与生成的智能体式3D CT报告生成
summary: 将胸部CT报告生成转为由LLM智能体协调的一组视觉问答决策，把感知学成判别式任务，提出Rad-VL-JEPA统一报告检索与发现识别等。
key_points: 感知与推理、报告撰写解耦
LLM智能体负责结合患者背景提出视觉查询
提出Rad-VL-JEPA，针对训练数据有限时漏检细微异常
reason: 新颖的CT报告生成智能体方法，命中VLM偏好；预印本，摘要无结果
abstract: Chest CT reports repeatedly assess the same anatomical regions for findings and their attributes, such as whether a lung nodule is present and where it is located. These assessments suggest learning to answer visual questions directly, rather than coupling perception to open-ended text generation. Yet current CT report generation models largely follow generic vision-language modeling, which may miss subtle abnormalities when training data are limited. We therefore formulate report generation as a set of visual question-answering decisions coordinated by a large language model (LLM) agent. This decouples visual perception from reasoning and report writing: perception can be learned as a discriminative, non-generative task, while the LLM focuses on reasoning over patient context and posing relevant visual queries. We introduce Rad-VL-JEPA, which unifies report retrieval, finding recognition, and fine-grained attribute characterization through vision-language joint-embedding prediction. Building on this perception module, an agent trained with reinforcement learning (RL) acquires patient-specific visual evidence, while a separate editor incorporates the evidence into the final report, further separating evidence acquisition from report realization. Experiments show that Rad-VL-JEPA achieves strong performance on fine-grained CT understanding tasks with lower amortized per-query inference time than a generative VLM baseline trained with the same CT encoder and VQA data. The resulting reporting system outperforms strong VLM-based and agentic baselines.
zh_abstract: 胸部CT报告会反复针对相同的解剖区域评估各类征象及其属性，例如是否存在肺结节以及其位置。这些评估提示，可以学习直接回答视觉问题，而不是将感知与开放式文本生成耦合在一起。然而，当前的CT报告生成模型大多沿用通用的视觉-语言建模方法，在训练数据有限时可能遗漏细微异常。因此，我们将报告生成表述为由大语言模型（LLM）智能体协调的一组视觉问答决策。这将视觉感知与推理及报告撰写解耦：感知可作为判别式的非生成任务来学习，而LLM则专注于结合患者背景进行推理并提出相关的视觉查询。我们提出了Rad-VL-JEPA，它通过视觉-语言联合嵌入预测，将报告检索、征象识别和细粒度属性刻画统一起来。在该感知模块的基础上，一个经强化学习（RL）训练的智能体获取针对患者的视觉证据，而另一个独立的编辑器将这些证据整合进最终报告，从而进一步将证据获取与报告生成分离。实验表明，Rad-VL-JEPA在细粒度CT理解任务上表现优异，且其摊销后的单次查询推理时间低于使用相同CT编码器和VQA数据训练的生成式VLM基线。由此构建的报告系统优于强大的基于VLM的基线和智能体基线。

title: SAE-Audit: Clinical-Trial Prediction via Inference-Time Optimization of Black-Box LLMs Audited by Sparse Autoencoder Evidence
zh_title: SAE-Audit：以稀疏自编码器证据审计黑盒LLM的临床试验预测
summary: 利用Llama-3.1-8B上的稀疏自编码器概念证据，对黑盒LLM做推理时优化，预测试验完成或提前终止。
key_points: 前沿LLM在该任务上仅略高于随机
SAE转为临床概念词表，稀疏探针关联结局
用开放模型证据审计并优化黑盒LLM
reason: 新颖预印本方法，涉及试验预测与可解释性，但摘要无具体结果
abstract: Clinical trials are costly and often take years to complete, making early outcome prediction valuable for trial planning. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to forecast clinical-trial outcomes, yet their predictions remain unreliable and their rationales may not faithfully reflect the evidence underlying their answers. On tasks such as predicting whether a registered clinical trial will complete or terminate early, frontier LLMs perform only modestly above chance in our experiments. We introduce SAE-Audit, which optimizes a black-box LLM at inference time with evidence obtained from a deployable open model. A frozen sparse autoencoder (SAE) on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct is converted into a vocabulary of clinical concepts. Sparse probes fitted on past trials determine which concepts are associated with the outcome. For a new protocol, the concepts detected by the probe are written as evidence, each with the direction and strength of its association with the outcome, and the LLM being audited optimizes its answer in the light of this evidence. Without additional training, SAE-Audit raises balanced accuracy of deepseek-v4-flash by 9.6--12.0 points on five clinical-trial prediction tasks and raises GPT-5.6-terra by 8.0 points on trial completion, exceeding other agentic inference-time optimization methods by a large margin. As an auxiliary, SAE probes module within SAE-Audit is itself accurate and auditable, providing natural-language explanations directly derived from verified concept contributions and protocol evidence, without requiring additional LLMs at inference time. SAE-Audit provides verifiable, concept-level evidence for more accurate and auditable clinical-trial prediction. It can also be embedded into biomedical AI agents such as Biomni to optimize their performance.
zh_abstract: 临床试验成本高昂，且往往需要数年才能完成，因此早期结局预测对试验规划具有价值。大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地用于预测临床试验结局，但其预测仍不可靠，其给出的理由也可能无法忠实反映答案背后的证据。在预测已注册的临床试验将完成还是提前终止等任务上，我们的实验中前沿 LLM 的表现仅略高于随机水平。我们提出 SAE-Audit，它在推理时利用来自可部署开源模型的证据来优化黑盒 LLM。我们将 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上冻结的稀疏自编码器（SAE）转换为临床概念词表。在既往试验上拟合的稀疏探针确定哪些概念与结局相关。对于新的试验方案，探针检出的概念连同其与结局关联的方向和强度被写成证据，被审计的 LLM 据此证据优化其答案。无需额外训练，SAE-Audit 在五项临床试验预测任务上将 deepseek-v4-flash 的平衡准确率提高了 9.6–12.0 个百分点，并在试验完成预测上将 GPT-5.6-terra 提高了 8.0 个百分点，大幅超过其他智能体式推理时优化方法。作为辅助，SAE-Audit 中的 SAE 探针模块本身即准确且可审计，其自然语言解释直接源自经验证的概念贡献和方案证据，推理时无需额外的 LLM。SAE-Audit 为更准确、可审计的临床试验预测提供了可验证的概念层面证据。它还可嵌入 Biomni 等生物医学 AI 智能体以优化其性能。

title: Pain Reassessment from Pulse Waveforms with Language Model Explanations
zh_title: 基于脉搏波形与语言模型解释的疼痛再评估
summary: 在MIMIC-III与MC-MED共52,082次评估、21,514名患者中，结合纵向PPG表征与语言模型解释进行疼痛再评估，并做跨场景迁移。
key_points: 重症到急诊平均精度0.824，反向0.822
去除历史脉搏表征后一致性由0.718降至0.534
纵向PPG结合证据关联的语言解释
reason: 大样本、跨数据集迁移与消融，但为回顾性预印本
abstract: Routine photoplethysmography (PPG) offers a continuous physiological signal for pain reassessment between self-reports. Whether prior recordings provide an individualized physiological reference beyond care-process timing remains unresolved. Across 52,082 report-linked assessments from 21,514 patients in MIMIC-III critical care and MC-MED emergency care, we evaluate a workflow that pairs longitudinal PPG representations with local evidence-linked language interpretation. Among 27 methods, source-selected full-history models achieved average precision of 0.824 from critical to emergency care and 0.822 in reverse. Removing historical pulse-run representations while retaining reassessment availability and elapsed time lowered critical-to-emergency four-hour within-patient concordance from 0.718 to 0.534. This comparison supports the contribution of prior pulse-run representations to within-patient ordering beyond timing cues. Across 2,905 test patients, a local Qwen model interpreting frozen predictions achieved a 94.7% patient-equal pass rate on automated evidence checks after at most one revision. Longitudinal pulse context and evidence-linked language interpretation support a patient-centred workflow for pain reassessment.
zh_abstract: 常规光电容积脉搏波描记（PPG）可提供连续的生理信号，用于在患者自我报告之间重新评估疼痛。既往记录能否提供超越诊疗过程时间因素的个体化生理参照，目前尚未明确。我们在 MIMIC-III 重症监护和 MC-MED 急诊中，对来自 21,514 名患者的 52,082 次与报告关联的评估，评价了一种将纵向 PPG 表征与本地证据关联语言解读相结合的工作流程。在 27 种方法中，经源域选择的全病史模型从重症监护到急诊的平均精确率（average precision）为 0.824，反向为 0.822。在保留重新评估可得性和经过时间的同时去除历史脉搏段表征，使重症监护到急诊的四小时个体内一致性由 0.718 降至 0.534。该比较支持，除时间线索外，既往脉搏段表征对个体内排序也有贡献。在 2,905 名测试患者中，一个本地 Qwen 模型对冻结的预测结果进行解读，经至多一次修订后，在自动化证据核查中达到 94.7% 的患者等权通过率。纵向脉搏背景与证据关联的语言解读支持以患者为中心的疼痛重新评估工作流程。

title: Diagnosing Verbalized Confidence in a Medical Vision-Language Model for Selective Prediction on Colorectal Histopathology Patches
zh_title: 诊断医学视觉语言模型的口述置信度：结直肠组织病理切片选择性预测
summary: 在PathMNIST及患者独立外部队列上零样本测试MedGemma-27b-it及其基座，发现MedGemma口述置信度几乎无区分力，基座Gemma-3更有信息。
key_points: 两模型准确率仅40.6%与35.5%
MedGemma置信度AUROC约0.50，96%集中于单值
Gemma-3 AUROC约0.70，选择性预测有提升
reason: 有外部队列的病理VLM置信度诊断，结论有价值；预印本
abstract: Flagging uncertain histopathology patches for specialist review needs a confidence that is higher when the model is right. We test whether an open medical vision-language model emits one. MedGemma-27b-it and its base Gemma-3-27b-it were run zero-shot under one prompt on 10,004 PathMNIST validation patches and 7,180 patches of a patient-disjoint external cohort. Both are too inaccurate to deploy (40.6% and 35.5%); the object of study is the confidence. MedGemma's verbalized confidence puts 96% of patches at one value; its confidence-correctness AUROC is 0.499 and 0.528, and routing by it moves selective-accuracy AUC by -0.004 and +0.037. Gemma-3 spreads its confidence over nine values, reaches AUROC 0.70, and gains +0.114 and +0.115. MedGemma's label-token probabilities do not rescue it: their validation advantage reverses where the top-20 alternatives include every class. On 1,800-patch subsets of each cohort, stratified on correctness and reweighted to the full splits, agreement across five prompt variants beats random by +0.123 and +0.106, and wording-only paraphrases give +0.100 and, externally and in direction only, +0.054; agreement's external margins over confidence do not survive slide-level clustering. Under one restructured prompt variant, MedGemma's stated confidence routes (+0.112, +0.141), so the failure is tied to a prompt chosen for macro F1.
zh_abstract: 要标记不确定的组织病理学图像块以供专科医生复核，需要一种在模型判断正确时更高的置信度。我们检验一个开源医学视觉-语言模型是否能给出这样的置信度。在同一提示下，对 MedGemma-27b-it 及其基础模型 Gemma-3-27b-it 进行零样本测试，数据为 PathMNIST 验证集的 10,004 个图像块和患者互不重叠的外部队列的 7,180 个图像块。两者准确率均过低而无法部署（分别为 40.6% 和 35.5%）；本研究的对象是置信度。MedGemma 的口头表述置信度使 96% 的图像块落在同一个值上；其置信度-正确性 AUROC 分别为 0.499 和 0.528，按其路由使选择性准确率 AUC 分别变化 -0.004 和 +0.037。Gemma-3 的置信度分布于九个取值，AUROC 达 0.70，选择性准确率 AUC 分别提高 +0.114 和 +0.115。MedGemma 的标签词元概率也无法挽救：其在验证集上的优势，在前 20 个备选包含全部类别的情况下出现反转。在各队列 1,800 个图像块的子集上（按正确性分层并重新加权至完整划分），五种提示变体之间的一致性优于随机，分别为 +0.123 和 +0.106；仅措辞改写的提示给出 +0.100，而在外部队列中仅在方向上为 +0.054；一致性相对置信度的外部优势在考虑玻片水平聚类后不再成立。在一种重构的提示变体下，MedGemma 的自述置信度可用于路由（+0.112，+0.141），因此该失败与为宏平均 F1 而选择的提示相关。

title: Seeing Is Not Acting: WARD Diagnoses the Evidence-to-State-to-Action Gap in Longitudinal Clinical Agents
zh_title: WARD：纵向临床智能体证据-状态-行动差距诊断基准
summary: 提出含4560项任务的纵向临床智能体基准，评估模型如何将累积证据转化为患者状态判断与安全行动。
key_points: 40条轨迹、95次住院、240个检查点
含纵向与交互式工具介导两个赛道
评测12个模型的中间环节失败
reason: 较大规模临床智能体基准，预印本；智能体方向小幅上调
abstract: Large language models for longitudinal clinical care must revise their assessments and actions as patient information accumulates. However, benchmarks centered on isolated responses or final task outcomes provide limited insight into intermediate failures in evidence use, state updating, and action selection. We introduce WARD, a benchmark for evaluating how clinical agents translate accumulating evidence into patient-state judgments and timely, safe actions. WARD comprises 4,560 clinical tasks across seven clinical output domains, organized into 240 checkpoints from 40 longitudinal clinical trajectories spanning 95 hospitalizations. Its Longitudinal Track evaluates these tasks under controlled cumulative evidence. Its Interactive Track evaluates end-to-end, tool-mediated clinical management across 271 verifiable evidence items and 141 reference transitions. Across 12 models with scorable checkpoint outputs, evidence recognition consistently outpaces downstream state and action decisions, with linked-evidence nonresponse reaching 74.47--90.90\%. Models also struggle to retain and update information over time, while in the Interactive Track only 11.46\% of executed actions advance a reference transition. These results reveal a persistent evidence-to-state-to-action gap and highlight the need for process-level evaluation of longitudinal clinical agents.Code and data: https://github.com/Dingsuper-creator/WARD.
zh_abstract: 用于纵向临床照护的大语言模型必须随着患者信息的积累而修正其评估和行动。然而，以孤立回答或最终任务结果为中心的基准，对证据使用、状态更新和行动选择中的中间失败所能提供的洞见有限。我们提出 WARD，一个用于评估临床智能体如何将不断积累的证据转化为患者状态判断以及及时、安全行动的基准。WARD 包含 4,560 个临床任务，涵盖七个临床输出领域，组织为 240 个检查点，来源于 40 条纵向临床轨迹，涉及 95 次住院。其纵向赛道（Longitudinal Track）在受控的累积证据下评估这些任务。其交互赛道（Interactive Track）则评估端到端、借助工具的临床管理，涉及 271 条可验证的证据项和 141 个参考转移。在 12 个具有可评分检查点输出的模型中，证据识别始终领先于下游的状态和行动决策，关联证据未响应率达 74.47--90.90%。模型在随时间保留和更新信息方面也存在困难，而在交互赛道中，仅有 11.46% 的已执行行动推进了参考转移。这些结果揭示了持续存在的“证据—状态—行动”差距，并凸显了对纵向临床智能体进行过程层面评估的必要性。代码和数据：https://github.com/Dingsuper-creator/WARD。

title: Beyond Attention Maps: Understanding and Improving Medical MLLMs via Visual Values
zh_title: 超越注意力图：通过视觉Value改进医学多模态大模型
summary: 构建平扫/增强配对医学VQA数据集，发现视觉value比注意力权重更影响预测，并提出VIVID蒸馏方法。
key_points: 构建NC与CE配对的医学VQA数据集
干预显示value对预测影响大于注意力
提出VIVID视觉value干预蒸馏
reason: 医学MLLM新分析与方法，有新数据集，预印本
abstract: Current MLLM methods largely focus on whether models attend to the right visual regions, implicitly treating spatial attention map as the primary key of effective visual perception. To examine this assumption, we introduce a medical VQA dataset with paired non-contrast (NC) and contrast-enhanced (CE) images that share corresponding anatomy while providing different cues. We show that this view is incomplete: across paired NC and CE medical images, MLLMs often exhibit similar attention patterns despite producing contrasting answers, while controlled bidirectional interventions induce substantially larger prediction changes on visual values than attention weights. These results identify the visual content retrieved through values as a critical factor in improving perception beyond spatial attention alone. Guided by this finding, we propose VIVID (VIsual Value Intervention Distillation), which uses enhanced visual values to identify and refine teacher corrections aligned with useful visual evidence to improve on-policy distillation from CE to NC images. Across six internal and external test sets, VIVID consistently outperforms existing on-policy distillation methods across different model scales and architectures, requires only NC images at inference, and maintains strong zero-shot performance on general-domain VQA benchmarks. The project page is available at https://qiuzyc.github.io/VIVID.
zh_abstract: 当前的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）方法主要关注模型是否关注到正确的视觉区域，隐含地将空间注意力图视为有效视觉感知的主要关键。为检验这一假设，我们引入了一个医学视觉问答（VQA）数据集，其中包含成对的非增强（NC）和增强（CE）图像，二者具有对应的解剖结构但提供不同的线索。我们表明这一观点并不完整：在成对的 NC 与 CE 医学图像上，MLLM 往往表现出相似的注意力模式，却给出相反的答案；同时，受控的双向干预在视觉 value 上引起的预测变化，远大于在注意力权重上引起的变化。这些结果表明，通过 value 检索到的视觉内容是在空间注意力之外提升感知能力的关键因素。基于这一发现，我们提出 VIVID（VIsual Value Intervention Distillation，视觉 value 干预蒸馏），它利用增强后的视觉 value 来识别并优化与有用视觉证据相一致的教师修正，从而改进从 CE 到 NC 图像的 on-policy 蒸馏。在六个内部和外部测试集上，VIVID 在不同模型规模和架构下均持续优于现有 on-policy 蒸馏方法，推理时仅需 NC 图像，并在通用领域 VQA 基准上保持较强的零样本性能。项目页面见 https://qiuzyc.github.io/VIVID。

title: Who Gets Re-ranked When a Clinical Model Gains New Data?
zh_title: 临床模型新增数据后哪些患者会被重新排序
summary: 预印本研究急诊风险模型加入实验室结果等新数据源后，缺少新数据的患者排名变化及警报列表影响，在MC-MED与MIMIC-IV-ED上评估。
key_points: 按数据可用性拆分基于排名的兼容性指标
MC-MED 78,475次就诊，MIMIC-IV-ED 10万例预注册复现
放射报告文本无可检测增益，实验室结果提升预测
reason: 两家医院含预注册复现，但为预印本且聚焦模型更新，属值得一看档
abstract: Hospitals often update a deployed risk model by adding a data source, such as laboratory results, that only some patients have. Work on safe model updates assumes fixed inputs and so ignores patients who lack the new data. The update has no new measurements for them, yet their rank can change, and a sick patient not yet tested can drop off an alert list. We split rank-based compatibility by data availability and pair it with error correction and alert-list effects. We compared each update with ordinary retraining on the old inputs, predicting ICU admission or death and hospital admission, on 78,475 emergency department visits from MC-MED and, in a pre-registered replication, 100,000 stays from MIMIC-IV-ED at a second hospital. Radiograph report text gave no detectable gain and almost no extra re-ranking. Laboratory results improved prediction but, at both hospitals and with linear or tree models, pushed patients without labs down alert lists; linear updates also reshuffled them more than retraining did, without ranking them better. A top-20% admission list caught 4.2% of admitted patients without labs after the update, against 18.8% after retraining (second hospital: 4.9% against 22.6%), while catching more patients overall. This held for list sizes from 5% to 50% and in every patient group we checked, despite better measured calibration. Separate alert thresholds for patients with and without labs restored most or all of their catch rate at both hospitals at almost no cost. Teams should check these patients before deploying such an update.

title: Deciphering state bridges via a single-cell large language model
zh_title: 通过单细胞大语言模型解析状态桥
summary: 基于UCE单细胞基础模型，整合8,789个人类样本、逾5900万细胞、614种生物学状态，分析状态间重塑关系并发现22,161个显著桥。
key_points: 基于UCE统一36种细胞类型注释
614个状态嵌入为36维组成变化向量
发现22,161个显著状态桥(P<0.05)
reason: 大规模单细胞基础模型应用，预印本，缺验证信息
abstract: Large-scale single-cell transcriptomic data provide a new avenue for precision medicine by uncovering cellular heterogeneity. However, systematic comparison of remodeling patterns across various biological states remains unavailable. Here, we first developed a computational framework based on a foundation model of single cell biology, Universal Cell Embedding (UCE), to harmonize annotations comprising 36 cell types. Based on an integrated dataset of single cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) with 8,789 human samples comprising more than 59 million cells or nuclei across 614 biological states, we then embedded each state with a 36-dimensional vector in a unified space of cell-composition change and further deciphered states bridges by analyzing the relationships among the 614 state vectors. As a result, 22,161 significant bridges (P < 0.05) between the 614 states were revealed. Moreover, we successfully identified a number of well-known bridges such as bridge between Alzheimer's disease and Parkinson's disease (P = 2.21e-15), suggesting the effectiveness of the proposed framework. More importantly, we uncovered a number of new bridges. Furthermore, analyses of the number of changed cell types (NCC) and Shannon entropy revealed heterogeneous and tissue-dependent patterns of cellular composition remodeling. This study provides a new strategy for identifying disease associations and potential therapeutic relationships by deciphering bridges between biological states from scRNA-seq landscape.
zh_abstract: 大规模单细胞转录组数据通过揭示细胞异质性，为精准医学提供了新途径。然而，目前仍缺乏对不同生物学状态下重塑模式的系统比较。在此，我们首先基于单细胞生物学基础模型通用细胞嵌入（Universal Cell Embedding，UCE）开发了一个计算框架，以统一包含36种细胞类型的注释。基于整合的单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据集（包含8,789份人类样本、涵盖614种生物学状态的超过5,900万个细胞或细胞核），我们在细胞组成变化的统一空间中用一个36维向量嵌入每种状态，并通过分析614个状态向量之间的关系进一步解析状态桥（state bridges）。结果揭示了614种状态之间22,161个显著的桥（P < 0.05）。此外，我们成功识别出若干已知的桥，如阿尔茨海默病与帕金森病之间的桥（P = 2.21e-15），提示所提出框架的有效性。更重要的是，我们发现了许多新的桥。进一步地，对变化细胞类型数（NCC）和香农熵的分析揭示了细胞组成重塑的异质性和组织依赖性模式。本研究通过从scRNA-seq图谱中解析生物学状态之间的桥，为识别疾病关联和潜在治疗关系提供了新策略。

title: Continually pretrained open-weight language models can outperform traditional machine learning in EHR-based clinical prediction
zh_title: 持续预训练开源权重LLM在EHR临床预测上超越传统机器学习
summary: VEX-EHR扩展120亿参数开源LLM词表并在单中心EHR上持续预训练，在出院、再入院、ICU急性肾损伤预测上优于梯度提升树和CEHR-BERT。
key_points: 17,601个临床与审计日志编码，47亿token
仅用10%标签在出院预测上超过对照
reason: EHR基础模型方向，权重公开，但单中心预印本
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) prompted with electronic health record (EHR) data have predicted clinical outcomes less accurately than locally trained machine-learning models. We developed VEX-EHR by extending the vocabulary of a 12-billion-parameter open-weight LLM (weights publicly available) with 17,601 clinical and audit-log codes from 170,483 patients' records at one academic medical center, continuing its pretraining on those 2019-2024 records (4.7 billion tokens) and fine-tuning it per task. AUROCs were 0.917 for next-24-hour discharge, 0.715 for 30-day readmission and 0.847 for intensive care unit acute kidney injury, against 0.868, 0.677 and 0.828 for gradient-boosted trees and 0.848, 0.650 and 0.791 for CEHR-BERT, an EHR foundation model. Continued pretraining added 0.031-0.053 AUROC on every task. With 10% of the labels, VEX-EHR exceeded both comparators using all labels for discharge, and CEHR-BERT for readmission, valuable where labels are costly. Adapted by continued pretraining, open-weight LLMs can outperform traditional machine learning in EHR-based prediction.
zh_abstract: 以电子健康记录（EHR）数据作为提示的大语言模型（LLM）在预测临床结局方面的准确性不及本地训练的机器学习模型。我们开发了VEX-EHR：在一个120亿参数的开放权重LLM（权重公开可得）的词表基础上，加入来自某学术医疗中心170,483例患者记录的17,601个临床代码和审计日志代码，在这些2019-2024年的记录（47亿个token）上继续预训练，并针对各任务进行微调。VEX-EHR在未来24小时内出院、30天再入院和重症监护病房急性肾损伤任务上的AUROC分别为0.917、0.715和0.847，而梯度提升树分别为0.868、0.677和0.828，EHR基础模型CEHR-BERT分别为0.848、0.650和0.791。继续预训练使各任务的AUROC均提高0.031-0.053。仅使用10%的标签时，VEX-EHR在出院任务上超过了使用全部标签的两个对照模型，在再入院任务上超过了CEHR-BERT，这在标注成本高昂时具有价值。通过继续预训练进行适配后，开放权重LLM在基于EHR的预测中可以优于传统机器学习。

title: KMed-31B Technical Report
zh_title: KMed-31B技术报告：多教师蒸馏的医学大模型
summary: 基于开源权重模型后训练，按任务类型训练四类专家并经MOPD²蒸馏整合，面向本地有限硬件部署。
key_points: 按输出与反馈特性将任务分四类
多教师在线策略Delta蒸馏整合专家
构建合成健康对话语料用于问诊
reason: 预印本医学LLM训练方法，有新意，评测信息有限；领域模型加分
abstract: We present KMed-31B, a medical large language model post-trained from an open-weight model for on-premises deployment with limited hardware. Post-training a model for diverse medical tasks remains difficult, because improving one kind of task can lower performance on another. We attribute this to differences between tasks in expected output and available feedback. Medical question answering and diagnosis prediction have reference answers, whereas clinical inquiry has no single correct response and is judged with rubrics. We therefore divide medical training tasks into four categories by these two properties, train one specialist per category with a reward that its feedback supports, and integrate the specialists into a single student with Multi-teacher On-policy Delta Distillation (MOPD$^2$). For clinical inquiry, we build Synthetic Health Dialogue, a simulated corpus of consultations with lay users and clinicians whose patient cases span common clinical presentations in primary care. Relative to its base model, KMed-31B raises HealthBench Hard from 22.95 to 41.87 and HealthBench Professional from 37.92 to 50.20 in non-thinking mode, and from 23.80 to 51.48 and from 41.97 to 59.18 in thinking mode, while its scores on four multiple-choice medical benchmarks are maintained or slightly improved. KMed-31B has the highest unadjusted HealthBench Hard score among the compared models, including proprietary ones, and scores higher on HealthBench Professional than every open-weight model we compare, including models with more than ten times as many total parameters. Applied to another base model, Qwen3.8-27B, the same training recipe also raises both HealthBench scores. We describe the training recipe, data construction, and settings in detail so that institutions requiring on-premises deployment can develop medical models from open-weight foundations.
zh_abstract: 我们提出了 KMed-31B，这是一个基于开放权重模型进行后训练的医学大语言模型，可在硬件有限的条件下本地部署。针对多样化医疗任务对模型进行后训练仍然困难，因为提升某一类任务的表现可能会降低另一类任务的表现。我们将其归因于各任务在预期输出和可获得反馈方面的差异。医学问答和诊断预测有参考答案，而临床问诊没有唯一正确的回答，需依据评分细则（rubric）进行评判。因此，我们按这两个属性将医学训练任务划分为四类，为每一类训练一个专家模型，并采用其反馈所能支持的奖励，再通过多教师在线策略差值蒸馏（Multi-teacher On-policy Delta Distillation，MOPD$^2$）将这些专家整合为单一的学生模型。针对临床问诊，我们构建了 Synthetic Health Dialogue，这是一个模拟的问诊语料库，涵盖与非专业用户和临床医生之间的问诊，其患者病例覆盖基层医疗中常见的临床表现。与其基础模型相比，KMed-31B 在非思考模式下将 HealthBench Hard 从 22.95 提高到 41.87，将 HealthBench Professional 从 37.92 提高到 50.20；在思考模式下分别从 23.80 提高到 51.48、从 41.97 提高到 59.18，同时其在四个医学多项选择基准上的得分保持不变或略有提升。在所比较的模型（包括专有模型）中，KMed-31B 的未经调整 HealthBench Hard 得分最高；其 HealthBench Professional 得分高于我们所比较的所有开放权重模型，包括总参数量超过其十倍的模型。将同一训练方案应用于另一基础模型 Qwen3.8-27B，也同样提高了两项 HealthBench 得分。我们详细介绍了训练方案、数据构建和设置，以便需要本地部署的机构能够基于开放权重基础模型开发医学模型。

title: CLASP: Deciding Structure and Claims Before Decoding for Whole-Slide Pathology Report Generation
zh_title: CLASP：解码前先决定结构与论断的全切片病理报告生成
summary: 提出先决策后解码的WSI病理报告生成器：先由相似病例确定句子计划与长度，再依校准后验选择发现，改善解码器欠生成与高频发现回退问题。
key_points: 在PathText-BRCA上发现报告长度与结构主导n-gram重叠
ESP借相似病例确定结构，CCD依校准后验选发现
针对解码器欠生成、回退到高频发现
reason: 病理报告生成新方法并有基准分析，命中病理偏好；预印本
abstract: Whole-slide pathology report generation has advanced through stronger slide encoders, retrieved knowledge, and, recently, slide-level multimodal LLMs. However, these generators leave every report-level choice to the decoder: how long the report is, how it is organised, and which findings it states and where. On the standard PathText-BRCA benchmark, we find that these choices dominate n-gram overlap, as reports from the query's hospital selected without learning approach the state of the art, while decoders under-generate and fall back to the most frequent findings. We present CLASP, a decide-then-decode generator that makes these choices explicitly, once per slide. Before decoding, an Exemplar Structure Prior (ESP) takes the sentence plan and length from reports of image-similar cases, a Calibrated Claim Decision (CCD) selects the findings from calibrated slide posteriors, and a Claim-to-Sentence Placement (CSP) assigns each finding to a planned sentence. A Plan-Conditioned Decoder (PCD), refined by structure-anchored sequence training, then writes the report under these decisions. With 35M parameters, CLASP outperforms retrained report generators and slide-level LLMs of up to 7B parameters, matches the strongest published results, and generalises to lung cancer from unseen hospitals. Its decisions change what the reports state, not only their length, transfer to an LLM decoder, and can withhold what H&E cannot show: withholding receptor status leaves 23% fewer contradictions with clinical records than the same network without decisions.
zh_abstract: 全切片病理报告生成已借助更强的切片编码器、检索知识以及近来的切片级多模态大语言模型（LLM）而取得进展。然而，这些生成器将报告层面的各项选择全部交给解码器：报告多长、如何组织，以及陈述哪些发现、放在何处。在标准的 PathText-BRCA 基准上，我们发现这些选择对 n-gram 重叠度起主导作用：未经学习而直接选取查询病例所在医院的报告，其表现即可接近当前最优水平，而解码器则生成不足，并回退到最常见的发现。我们提出 CLASP，这是一种“先决策、后解码”的生成器，每张切片显式地做出一次这些选择。在解码之前，范例结构先验（Exemplar Structure Prior，ESP）从图像相似病例的报告中获取句子计划和长度，校准断言决策（Calibrated Claim Decision，CCD）根据校准后的切片后验选择发现，断言-句子置放（Claim-to-Sentence Placement，CSP）则将每项发现分配到计划好的句子中。随后，经结构锚定序列训练优化的计划条件解码器（Plan-Conditioned Decoder，PCD）在这些决策下撰写报告。CLASP 仅有 3500 万参数，其表现优于重新训练的报告生成器及多达 70 亿参数的切片级 LLM，与已发表的最强结果相当，并可泛化至来自未见过医院的肺癌数据。其决策不仅改变报告的长度，也改变报告所陈述的内容，可迁移至 LLM 解码器，并能够不输出 H&E 染色无法显示的内容：与不含决策的同一网络相比，不输出受体状态可使与临床记录相矛盾之处减少 23%。

title: Center-Aware Ordinal Learning for Prostate Cancer Grading from Histopathology Images
zh_title: 面向前列腺癌分级的中心感知有序学习
summary: 提出结合病理编码器与注意力MIL的中心感知有序学习框架，用EMD损失和有序对比学习处理ISUP分级，在约9100张活检WSI上评估。
key_points: EMD损失处理有序分级误差
有序监督对比对齐跨中心同级切片
课程学习缓解良性样本占优
reason: 病理方法新颖、数据量较大，但为预印本，摘要未见外部验证细节
abstract: Prostate cancer grading from histopathology whole-slide images (WSIs) is complicated by the ordered nature of ISUP grades, class imbalance, and center-dependent variations in staining, tissue preparation, and scanning. Most weakly supervised methods treat grade groups as independent categories and may therefore learn representations that do not transfer reliably across institutions. We propose a center-aware ordinal learning framework that combines a pretrained pathology encoder with attention-based multiple instance learning. The framework uses an Earth Mover's Distance loss to account for ordinal errors, an ordinal supervised contrastive objective to align same-grade slides across centers while separating grades according to disease severity, and curriculum learning to reduce the dominance of benign cases. We evaluate the framework on approximately 9,100 biopsy WSIs from the two-center PANDA dataset. The proposed framework achieves an accuracy of 0.842 and a quadratic weighted kappa of 0.958 on the held-out test set. Its main benefit is observed in cross-center transfer: when a linear probe is trained on Karolinska representations and evaluated on Radboud, accuracy increases from 0.643 to 0.823 and quadratic weighted kappa from 0.899 to 0.930. Performance remains stable in the reverse direction. UMAP projections further show improved mixing between centers while preserving an ordinal grade trajectory. These results suggest that combining ordinal and center-aware objectives produces more transferable slide representations for multi-center prostate cancer grading.
zh_abstract: 由于 ISUP 分级具有有序性、类别不平衡，以及染色、组织制备和扫描存在中心依赖性差异，基于组织病理学全切片图像（WSI）的前列腺癌分级较为复杂。大多数弱监督方法将分级组视为相互独立的类别，因此所学表征可能无法在不同机构间可靠迁移。我们提出一种中心感知的有序学习框架，将预训练的病理编码器与基于注意力的多示例学习相结合。该框架使用推土机距离（Earth Mover's Distance）损失来考虑有序误差，使用有序监督对比目标使不同中心的同级别切片对齐并按疾病严重程度区分不同级别，并采用课程学习以减轻良性病例的主导作用。我们在双中心 PANDA 数据集约 9,100 张活检 WSI 上评估该框架。该框架在留出测试集上达到 0.842 的准确率和 0.958 的二次加权 kappa。其主要获益体现在跨中心迁移：以 Karolinska 的表征训练线性探针并在 Radboud 上评估时，准确率由 0.643 升至 0.823，二次加权 kappa 由 0.899 升至 0.930。反方向上性能保持稳定。UMAP 投影进一步显示中心间混合改善，同时保留有序的分级轨迹。这些结果提示，结合有序目标与中心感知目标可为多中心前列腺癌分级产生更易迁移的切片表征。

title: Learning a Rule Bank to Revise 3D CT Reports with Independent Evidence
zh_title: 学习规则库，借助独立证据修订3D CT报告
summary: 提出智能体系统，为每个报告模型学习可执行规则库，利用独立分类器与影像测量局部修订报告，在CT-RATE上提升CE-F1。
key_points: 无需重训报告模型
每处修改可追溯到触发规则
SelfCue-KD的CE-F1提升11.5点
reason: 新颖的智能体报告修订方法，有基线对比，但为预印本且单一数据集
abstract: Vision--language models can generate fluent radiology reports from 3D chest CT scans, yet they may still omit abnormalities or misstate findings. Independent image analysis using models separate from the report model provides additional observations, but acting on uncertain evidence may introduce new errors. We propose an agent system that learns a revision policy represented as an executable rule bank for each report model. Inspired by experience banks, the agent proposes and refines rules using revision outcomes across development cases. During inference, the retained rules guide local edits using independent classifier predictions and quantitative image measurements without retraining the report model. Unedited sentences are preserved, and each change is linked to the rule that triggered it. On CT-RATE, revision increases CE-F1 by 11.5 points for SelfCue-KD and 0.9 points for NV-Reason-CT, with gains across five draft-sampling seeds. SelfCue-KD's CT-FineBench score also increases by 15.2 points. Draft-only rule learning yields limited gains, while the two image-evidence sources provide complementary benefits for abnormality detection. Measurements also supply numerical details missing from the drafts. These results support learning model-specific rules to control how independent image evidence informs report revision. Code is available at https://github.com/renjie-liang/CT-RuleBank.
zh_abstract: 视觉-语言模型可以根据三维胸部 CT 扫描生成流畅的放射学报告，但仍可能遗漏异常或错误表述所见。使用独立于报告模型的其他模型进行独立图像分析，可提供额外的观察结果，但依据不确定的证据采取行动可能引入新的错误。我们提出一种智能体系统，针对每个报告模型学习一种以可执行规则库表示的修订策略。受经验库启发，该智能体利用开发病例中的修订结果提出并完善规则。在推理时，保留的规则借助独立分类器的预测和定量图像测量来指导局部编辑，而无需重新训练报告模型。未编辑的句子得以保留，且每处更改都与触发它的规则相关联。在 CT-RATE 上，修订使 SelfCue-KD 的 CE-F1 提高 11.5 个点，使 NV-Reason-CT 提高 0.9 个点，且在五个草稿采样种子下均有提升。SelfCue-KD 的 CT-FineBench 得分也提高了 15.2 个点。仅基于草稿的规则学习带来的提升有限，而两种图像证据来源对异常检测具有互补的益处。测量结果还补充了草稿中缺失的数值细节。这些结果支持通过学习模型特定的规则，来控制独立图像证据如何用于报告修订。代码见 https://github.com/renjie-liang/CT-RuleBank。

title: Can Your AI Twin Meet People for You? It Can Hold a Conversation. But What Does It Need to Judge Like You?
zh_title: AI分身能替你见人吗？基于710人的LLM数字孪生对话模拟
summary: 基于CANDOR语料为710人构建LLM分身，模拟5,680次初次对话，并与355对真实留出配对的会后评价对照，分身对话可预测真实好感度。
key_points: 分身对话预测真实喜欢程度，ρ=0.277
含问卷与评分历史之外的增量信息，偏相关0.16
交换对照显示信号来自对话而非人设卡
reason: 大规模persona社会模拟，有真实人类对照，但为预印本
abstract: Should your AI twin go meet people on your behalf? We built LLM twins of 710 real people from their other conversations in the CANDOR corpus, sent them to meet each other in 5,680 simulated first conversations, and checked every rehearsal against what the real people said after meeting for real (355 held-out, participant-disjoint pairs, against baselines that include each person's rating history). The rehearsals work: a twin's conversation predicts real liking ($ρ$=0.277), carries information that questionnaires and rating history do not have (partial $ρ$=0.16 [0.05, 0.26]), and recovers most of what the same reader gets from the real conversation (0.321). Swap controls show that this signal travels through the conversation, not through the persona card. What, then, does a twin need to judge like you? Not your voice: making twins talk more like their owners, with person-specific activation steering and a LoRA trained on their own speech, did not help in a pre-specified test and lowered accuracy in an exploratory second round (-0.183 [-0.294, -0.066]). Nor simply your stated ratings: a persona-prompted twin that holds the conversation does not yet carry its owner's judgment, and when told its owner's past ratings it anchors on them instead of weighing them. Learning helps: a small appraisal head trained on other real conversations, which combines the twin's post-call answers with its owner's rating history, lifts rehearsal-based prediction above the history baseline out of fold (+0.059 [0.001, 0.115], against +0.022 without the twin's answers; pre-specified primary contrast +0.056 [-0.001, 0.111]). We propose an attribution protocol for twin-based social simulation and identify learned appraisal as the component twins need next.
zh_abstract: 你的 AI 分身应该代你去见人吗？我们依据 CANDOR 语料库中 710 位真实参与者的其他对话构建了他们的 LLM 分身，让这些分身在 5,680 次模拟的初次对话中彼此见面，并将每次预演与真人实际见面后所作的评价进行核对（355 对留出的、参与者互不重叠的配对，基线包括每个人的评分历史）。预演是有效的：分身的对话可预测真实的喜欢程度（$ρ$=0.277），携带问卷和评分历史所不具备的信息（偏 $ρ$=0.16 [0.05, 0.26]），并且还原了同一阅读者从真实对话中获得信息的大部分（0.321）。交换对照表明，这一信号是通过对话传递的，而不是通过人设卡片。那么，分身需要什么才能像你一样做判断？不是你的声音：通过针对个人的激活引导（activation steering）以及基于其本人语音训练的 LoRA 使分身说话更像其主人，在预先指定的检验中没有帮助，在探索性的第二轮中还降低了准确率（-0.183 [-0.294, -0.066]）。也不是单纯告知你的评分：能够进行对话的、由人设提示驱动的分身尚不具备其主人的判断力，而当被告知主人过去的评分时，它会锚定于这些评分，而不是加以权衡。学习是有帮助的：一个在其他真实对话上训练的小型评估头（appraisal head）将分身通话后的回答与其主人的评分历史相结合，使基于预演的预测在折外超过了历史基线（+0.059 [0.001, 0.115]，而不使用分身回答时为 +0.022；预先指定的主要对比为 +0.056 [-0.001, 0.111]）。我们提出了一种用于基于分身的社会模拟的归因方案，并指出习得的评估（appraisal）是分身接下来所需要的组成部分。

title: Improving the Improver: Semantic PID Control for Medical Agent Self-Improvement
zh_title: 语义PID控制：医疗智能体的自我改进
summary: 预印本提出受PID控制启发的Semantic PID-RSI框架，用于改进术后病理分期与长期生存预测的医疗智能体，并构建CliAgent工作流。
key_points: CliAgent基于多模态患者证据进行临床推理
针对递归自我改进的反馈模糊与开发集过拟合
通过三种诊断角色评估候选修改批次
reason: 新颖智能体方法，涉及预后预测，但摘要无充分验证信息，属值得一看档
abstract: High-stakes vertical medical tasks, such as postoperative pathological staging and long-term survival prediction, demand multi-step clinical reasoning over heterogeneous evidence under weak supervision and high outcome uncertainty. While we first orchestrate CliAgent, a domain-tailored clinical agent workflow that systematically grounds predictions in multi-modal patient evidence, manually designed medical agents remain constrained by static, brittle rules. Moreover, existing recursive self-improvement (RSI) methods suffer from feedback ambiguity and severe development-set overfitting when evolving agents in high-noise medical domains. Focusing on improving the improver, we propose Semantic PID-RSI, an evidence-guided control-theoretic framework for medical agent self-improvement. Inspired by PID control, our improver evaluates candidate modification batches via three diagnostic roles: P isolates current clinical failure modes, I synthesizes longitudinal evidence from past trials, and D estimates response dynamics and regression risks (D-pre/D-post). Selected plans are compiled into behavior contracts for staged probing and independent adoption judging. Instantiated and validated on challenging oncology tasks (pT/pN staging and survival prognosis), evolving CliAgent with Semantic PID-RSI on a 3B-activated open-weight model achieves substantial gains (up to +6.27 C-index points), outperforming overfitting-prone RSI baselines and approaching the performance of frontier proprietary models (e.g., GPT-6 series) equipped with CliAgent.

title: GlaucomaMarker - Biomarker-Grounded Glaucoma Vision-Language Model
zh_title: GlaucomaMarker：基于生物标志物的青光眼视觉语言模型
summary: 将公开分割掩码转为描述11种视网膜结构生物标志物的文本，用9,778张图像、45,190个图文对训练RETFound和FLAIR；在真实临床队列中GlaucomaMarker-F的AUROC为0.905，FLAIR为0.848。
key_points: 分割掩码转为生物标志物描述文本
在RETFound和FLAIR上训练图文对
临床队列AUROC 0.905 vs 0.848
reason: 眼科VLM新方法有基线对比，但为预印本、证据有限；眼科方向小幅上调
abstract: Glaucoma is a leading cause of irreversible blindness. In the current clinical setting, glaucoma diagnosis is generally conducted by assessing optic disc cupping and asymmetry. Vision-language models (VLMs) have been utilized in recent years for glaucoma, mostly trained on fixed templates or AI-generated captions, as no public text describes the biomarkers. Our proposed framework, GlaucomaMarker, hypothesizes that retinal structural biomarkers can ground glaucoma-based VLMs. It converts public segmentation masks into sentences describing eleven biomarkers, to teach retinal foundation models to read them. We applied this framework to RETFound (GlaucomaMarker-R) and FLAIR (GlaucomaMarker-F), training on 9,778 images that yielded 45,190 image-text pairs. On a real-world clinical cohort, GlaucomaMarker-F detects glaucoma with an AUROC of 0.905, against 0.848 for FLAIR, and both read the biomarkers where baselines stay near random guessing. Since the biomarker text is computed from existing masks, it comes at no extra cost.

title: HandXFM: Semantic-Structural Distillation for Hand Radiograph Foundation Models
zh_title: HandXFM：手部X光片基础模型的语义-结构蒸馏
summary: HandXFM从BiomedCLIP蒸馏语义先验、从胸片ViT蒸馏结构线索，预训练后可适配骨龄、SvH评分、异常检测、关节定位、骨分割和VQA等任务，摘要称优于任务专用及单专家基线。
key_points: 双教师蒸馏：BiomedCLIP与胸片ViT
适配骨龄、SvH评分、分割、VQA等任务
摘要称优于任务专用和单专家基线
reason: 影像基础模型新方法有对比，但为预印本，细节有限
abstract: Hand radiographs support diverse clinical tasks, including skeletal maturity assessment, rheumatoid arthritis scoring, abnormality screening, and anatomical localization, yet existing models are typically trained separately for each task and dataset. We present HandXFM, a domain-specific foundation model that leverages cross-modality knowledge for comprehensive hand X-ray understanding. HandXFM distills semantic priors from BiomedCLIP and structural cues from a chest X-ray Vision Transformer (ViT) through a unified alignment framework, integrating complementary medical knowledge in an interpretable way. After pretraining, HandXFM can be adapted to a range of musculoskeletal tasks, including bone age estimation, SvH score prediction, abnormality detection, joint localization, bone segmentation, and visual question answering. It consistently outperforms task-specific and single-expert baselines, achieving up to 0.11 improvement in Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC) for bone age prediction and a 12\% accuracy gain in abnormality classification. Moreover, HandXFM generalizes to unseen datasets and yields cross-attention maps linking clinical terms to anatomical regions. These results demonstrate that multi-expert distillation effectively unifies semantic and structural supervision within a single pretrained model, establishing HandXFM as an interpretable and generalizable foundation model for hand radiograph analysis.
zh_abstract: 手部X线片支持多种临床任务，包括骨骼成熟度评估、类风湿关节炎评分、异常筛查和解剖定位，但现有模型通常针对每项任务和每个数据集分别训练。我们提出HandXFM，这是一种利用跨模态知识实现全面手部X线理解的特定领域基础模型。HandXFM通过统一的对齐框架，从BiomedCLIP中蒸馏语义先验，并从胸部X线视觉Transformer（Vision Transformer，ViT）中蒸馏结构线索，以可解释的方式整合互补的医学知识。预训练后，HandXFM可适配多种肌肉骨骼任务，包括骨龄估计、SvH评分预测、异常检测、关节定位、骨骼分割和视觉问答。其表现始终优于任务特定模型和单一专家基线，骨龄预测的Pearson相关系数（PCC）最多提高0.11，异常分类准确率提高12%。此外，HandXFM可泛化至未见过的数据集，并生成将临床术语与解剖区域联系起来的交叉注意力图。这些结果表明，多专家蒸馏可在单一预训练模型中有效统一语义监督与结构监督，使HandXFM成为用于手部X线片分析的可解释且可泛化的基础模型。

title: Toward a digital twin of the ICU patient: Forecasting and treatment response in a generative event model
zh_title: ICU患者数字孪生：生成式事件模型预测与治疗反应
summary: 在单一医疗系统12.7万ICU患者上训练79M参数Transformer TWICE，通过模拟未来预测19项结局，AUROC 0.836，与最佳监督配置相当。
key_points: 训练于127,332例患者、15.7亿token
无任务特定训练，平均AUROC 0.836 vs 0.834
评估含反事实验证与个体轨迹
reason: 患者级生成式基础模型，命中偏好；单系统预印本
abstract: A digital twin of a patient in intensive care would forecast the patient's course and what a treatment would change. Generative event models, trained to continue a patient's electronic health record (EHR), have been proposed as a path toward such twins. We trained TWICE, a 79M-parameter decoder-only transformer, on the ICU records of one academic health system (127,332 training patients and 1.57 billion tokens). We evaluated it on clinical prediction tasks, generation fidelity, individual trajectories and counterfactual validation. Reading 19 clinical outcomes off 50 simulated futures, with no task-specific training, TWICE matched the best of 144 supervised configurations on held-out patients (mean AUROC 0.836 vs. 0.834). It led on events that change care within a day and trailed on death. With the training data fixed, more and longer simulated futures were worth more than a 6.8-fold larger model. Its generated records matched real ones closely and were as specific to each patient as its own variability allowed. Its predicted risk rose as events approached. Pre-specified controls showed that it reproduced the side effects of drugs and was barely moved by an inert drug. On the values that treatments are given to correct, however, an opposite treatment moved its forecasts like the right one. TWICE forecasts ICU events about as well as task-specific models, and we see it as a step toward a digital twin of the ICU patient.
zh_abstract: 重症监护病房中患者的数字孪生可以预测患者的病程以及某项治疗会带来的改变。经训练可延续患者电子健康记录（EHR）的生成式事件模型，已被提出作为实现此类孪生的途径。我们在一个学术医疗系统的 ICU 记录上（127,332 例训练患者，15.7 亿个 token）训练了 TWICE，这是一个 7900 万参数的仅解码器 Transformer。我们在临床预测任务、生成保真度、个体轨迹和反事实验证方面对其进行了评估。在不进行任何特定任务训练的情况下，TWICE 从 50 个模拟未来中读取 19 项临床结局，在留出患者上与 144 种监督配置中的最佳者相当（平均 AUROC 0.836 对 0.834）。它在一天内会改变诊疗的事件上领先，而在死亡预测上落后。在训练数据固定的情况下，更多、更长的模拟未来比 6.8 倍大的模型更有价值。其生成的记录与真实记录高度吻合，并且对每位患者的特异性达到了其自身变异性所允许的程度。随着事件临近，其预测风险上升。预先设定的对照显示，它重现了药物的副作用，并且几乎不受惰性药物影响。然而，对于治疗所要纠正的那些数值，相反的治疗与正确的治疗对其预测的影响相同。TWICE 对 ICU 事件的预测效果与特定任务模型大致相当，我们认为这是迈向 ICU 患者数字孪生的一步。

title: SonoAtlasWorld: Anatomy-Grounded Ultrasound World Models for Wide-Range Scanning
zh_title: SonoAtlasWorld：以解剖为状态的超声世界模型
summary: 提出以CT提取的3D解剖资产为锚的超声世界模型，用于机器人超声策略学习的数据生成与评估。
key_points: 以CT提取的持久3D解剖资产作为状态
探头动作决定解剖与声学可见性条件
三阶段流程：预训练、因果转换、长程对齐
reason: 预印本，医学世界模型新方法，加分但验证有限
abstract: Learning robotic ultrasound policies requires interactive environments for scalable data generation and repeatable evaluation, while exploration on real patients is limited by acquisition costs and safety constraints. Generative world models offer an alternative, but image history and probe actions alone do not ensure anatomical consistency across wide-range scans and changing acoustic windows. We introduce SonoAtlasWorld, an ultrasound world model built on anatomy as state. A persistent 3D anatomical asset extracted from computed tomography (CT) anchors each scan to a specific anatomy. Probe actions determine anatomical and acoustic visibility conditions for a causal ultrasound generator trained on clinical videos. Our three-stage pipeline combines anatomy-conditioned pretraining, causal conversion and long-rollout alignment. Inference optimizations achieve pose-to-ultrasound throughput of 81.2 FPS. To evaluate anatomical control beyond image similarity, we introduce the Action-Following Index (AFI), which measures normalized reconstruction gain over a static-prefix baseline. On 40 held-out 3D volumes, SonoAtlasWorld achieves liver and macro-organ AFI of 0.428 and 0.262, compared with at most 0.117 and 0.038 for the tested action- and geometry-conditioned methods. Long-rollout alignment reduces brightness drift by 3.46x at the end of 40 repeated scan cycles. SonoAtlasWorld also generates offline policy-training demonstrations and supports anatomically grounded closed-loop evaluation. Scaling the generated training data improves key-plane acquisition success from 48.2% to 81.2% on unseen anatomies in simulation, demonstrating its utility for robotic ultrasound policy learning.
zh_abstract: 学习机器人超声策略需要可交互的环境，以便进行可扩展的数据生成和可重复的评估，而在真实患者身上进行探索则受到采集成本和安全约束的限制。生成式世界模型提供了一种替代方案，但仅凭图像历史和探头动作并不能保证在大范围扫查和声窗变化过程中解剖结构的一致性。我们提出 SonoAtlasWorld，这是一种以解剖结构作为状态的超声世界模型。从计算机断层扫描（CT）中提取的持久性三维解剖资产将每次扫查锚定到特定解剖结构。探头动作决定了因果超声生成器的解剖和声学可见性条件，该生成器在临床视频上训练。我们的三阶段流程结合了解剖条件预训练、因果转换和长序列滚动对齐。推理优化使位姿到超声的吞吐量达到 81.2 FPS。为了评估超越图像相似性的解剖控制能力，我们提出了动作跟随指数（AFI），其衡量相对于静态前缀基线的归一化重建增益。在 40 个留出的三维体数据上，SonoAtlasWorld 的肝脏和宏观器官 AFI 分别为 0.428 和 0.262，而所测试的动作条件和几何条件方法最高分别仅为 0.117 和 0.038。长序列滚动对齐使 40 次重复扫查周期结束时的亮度漂移降低了 3.46 倍。SonoAtlasWorld 还可生成离线策略训练示范，并支持基于解剖结构的闭环评估。扩大生成的训练数据规模后，在模拟中对未见过的解剖结构的关键切面获取成功率从 48.2% 提高到 81.2%，表明其对机器人超声策略学习具有实用价值。

title: FlowScope: 3D Scene Flow Pretraining Improves Surgical Robot Policies
zh_title: FlowScope：3D场景流预训练提升手术机器人策略
summary: 用无标注临床立体视频预测场景流来预训练手术策略网络，在真实手术机器人系统上提高针拾取等任务成功率。
key_points: 在1149例手术、135万片段上预训练ACT主干
针拾取成功率由54%升至90%
推理无额外开销，完整任务2%升至14%

abstract: Imitation learning for surgical robots is limited by the cost of collecting demonstrations. Meanwhile, many robot-assisted procedures are recorded as stereo video, yet policies cannot learn from them directly; clinical video carries no action labels. We present FlowScope, which pretrains a surgical policy network on unlabeled clinical video by forecasting scene flow, the metric 3D motion of scene points, with labels computed by off-the-shelf stereo depth and optical flow models. We pretrain the trunk of an Action Chunking Transformer (ACT) on a dataset of 1,149 clinical procedures (1.35M clips) and discard the flow head afterward, so the deployed policy is a standard ACT with no added inference cost. On a real surgical robotic system, FlowScope raises needle pickup success from 54% to 90% and first-handover success on needle regrasp from 4% to 52% (full task: 2% to 14%) over training from scratch (n=50 trials each), and retains its gains with a generative flow-matching action head. Ablations indicate that metric 3D motion is the strongest pretraining signal among those tested; kinematics, 2D tracks, depth alone, and scale-free 3D flow, each paired with kinematics, yield smaller or no gains. Representation analyses suggest that scene-flow pretraining encodes metric needle depth more accurately, that kinematics pretraining increases reliance on the robot state, and that needle-depth probes follow the ordering of real-robot success where offline validation error does not.

title: Beyond Final Answers: Interpretable Tumor Immune Microenvironment Reasoning from H&E and mIF

abstract: Readouts of the tumor immune microenvironment (TIME), such as CD8+ T-cell density, intra-epithelial infiltration and the Ki67 index, combine tissue architecture from H&E with cell phenotypes from multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF). Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) could automate these readouts with an explanation, but two gaps remain. Pathology MLLMs read H&E alone, while these readouts need the cell phenotypes that mIF measures. And their reasoning has no step-level truth to be checked against, so R1-style reinforcement learning rewards only the final answer and leaves the reasoning unverified. Same-section H&E and mIF provide what both gaps lack: mIF measures every cell without manual annotation, which gives cell-level ground truth for each step that clinical guidelines prescribe, from delineating a tissue compartment to counting and normalizing the marker-positive cells within it. We therefore present HERMES (H&E-mIF Reasoning with Multimodal Evidence Supervision), an R1-style MLLM that reasons jointly over paired H&E and mIF in guideline steps and is trained with a process reward that checks every stated quantity against this truth. Across four field-level TIME tasks in colorectal cancer, HERMES (4B) reaches an average accuracy of 84.5%, compared with 74.7% for the strongest of twelve proprietary, general, medical and pathology MLLMs, and a higher share of its intermediate quantities is correct than for the strongest open-weight baseline. Without the process reward, reinforcement learning barely improves on supervised fine-tuning (80.0% vs. 78.8%) and fewer stated quantities are correct; editing a decisive stated quantity changes the answer as implied in all 885 test questions. Without retraining, it keeps the highest average accuracy on an external cohort imaged with CODEX (76.4% vs. 67.3%) and on head and neck cancer, a cancer type absent from training (76.7% vs. 72.5%).
zh_abstract: 肿瘤免疫微环境（TIME）的各项读数，如CD8+ T细胞密度、上皮内浸润和Ki67指数，结合了来自H&E的组织结构与来自多重免疫荧光（mIF）的细胞表型。多模态大语言模型（MLLM）有望在给出解释的同时自动完成这些读数，但仍存在两方面的不足。病理MLLM仅读取H&E，而这些读数需要mIF所测量的细胞表型；并且其推理缺乏可供核对的逐步真值，因此R1式强化学习仅奖励最终答案，而推理本身未经验证。同一切片的H&E与mIF恰好弥补了这两方面的不足：mIF无需人工标注即可测量每个细胞，从而为临床指南所规定的每一步提供细胞水平的真值，从划定组织区域，到对其中标志物阳性细胞进行计数和归一化。因此，我们提出HERMES（H&E-mIF Reasoning with Multimodal Evidence Supervision），一种R1式MLLM，它按照指南步骤对配对的H&E与mIF进行联合推理，并通过过程奖励进行训练，该奖励依据此真值核查每一个陈述的数量。在结直肠癌的四项视野水平TIME任务中，HERMES（4B）的平均准确率达到84.5%，而十二个专有、通用、医学和病理MLLM中表现最强者为74.7%，且其中间量的正确比例高于最强的开放权重基线。若无过程奖励，强化学习相比监督微调几乎没有提升（80.0%对78.8%），且陈述正确的数量更少；在全部885道测试题中，修改一个起决定作用的陈述数量均会使答案发生相应的改变。无需重新训练，它在使用CODEX成像的外部队列（76.4%对67.3%）以及训练中未包含的癌种头颈癌（76.7%对72.5%）上仍保持最高的平均准确率。

title: Artificial intelligence and enhanced recovery after surgery: from protocol-driven pathways to adaptive perioperative care systems (cognitive ERAS).
zh_title: AI与加速康复外科：迈向自适应围手术期认知ERAS
summary: 综述探讨AI如何整合纵向围手术期数据、结合因果推理，推动ERAS从规程驱动走向数据驱动的个体化自适应照护。

abstract: [Minerva anestesiologica] Enhanced recovery after surgery (ERAS) programs have transformed perioperative care through standardized, evidence-based pathways, improving outcomes across surgical specialties. However, increasing patient complexity and heterogeneity expose important limitations of protocol-driven approaches, which often fail to capture dynamic physiological variability and individualized recovery trajectories. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers a pathway to overcome these constraints by integrating longitudinal perioperative data and generating individualized risk predictions. However, prediction alone is insufficient for clinically meaningful personalization, which requires causal reasoning to estimate which interventions are most likely to improve outcomes for specific patients and at different stages of recovery. In this context, ERAS may evolve toward a data-informed, adaptive care system that integrates prediction, causal inference, and supervised workflow coordination. Emerging agentic AI systems may further extend ERAS beyond passive decision support toward structured care orchestration within defined clinical governance boundaries. This review examines how different AI methodologies, including supervised learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, natural language processing, generative models, and causal inference, can be aligned with ERAS objectives across the perioperative continuum. We also critically evaluate current evidence and key barriers to implementation. Looking forward, the convergence of AI, digital health technologies, and continuous patient monitoring may enable the emergence of cognitive ERAS, a data-driven perioperative care model that integrates prediction, causal estimation, and continuous learning to deliver personalized and dynamically adaptive recovery pathways.
zh_abstract: [Minerva anestesiologica] 术后加速康复（ERAS）方案通过标准化、循证的路径改变了围手术期护理，改善了各外科专科的结局。然而，患者复杂性和异质性的增加暴露了以方案为驱动的方法的重要局限，这些方法往往无法捕捉动态的生理变异和个体化的康复轨迹。人工智能（AI）通过整合围手术期纵向数据并生成个体化风险预测，提供了克服这些限制的途径。然而，仅有预测不足以实现具有临床意义的个体化，后者需要因果推理来估计哪些干预措施在不同康复阶段最可能改善特定患者的结局。在此背景下，ERAS可能向一种数据驱动的自适应护理系统发展，整合预测、因果推断和受监督的工作流程协调。新兴的智能体（agentic）AI系统可能进一步将ERAS从被动的决策支持扩展到在既定临床治理边界内的结构化护理统筹。本综述探讨了包括监督学习、深度学习、强化学习、自然语言处理、生成模型和因果推断在内的不同AI方法如何在整个围手术期连续过程中与ERAS目标相契合。我们还批判性地评价了当前证据和实施中的主要障碍。展望未来，AI、数字健康技术与持续患者监测的融合可能催生“认知型ERAS”，这是一种数据驱动的围手术期护理模式，整合预测、因果估计和持续学习，以提供个体化且动态自适应的康复路径。

title: BlindDDG: A Blind Evaluation-Based Method for Protein Mutation Stability Prediction.
source: PubMed · Journal of chemical information and modeling
zh_title: BlindDDG：基于盲评的蛋白质突变稳定性预测
summary: 提出BlindDDG框架，将蛋白质突变稳定性预测由ΔΔG定量回归转为稳定性变化方向分类。
key_points: 从ΔΔG回归转为方向分类
引入盲评策略建模突变引起的变化

reason: 新方法但摘要无验证细节，属增量偏上
abstract: [Journal of chemical information and modeling] Protein thermodynamic stability changes upon mutation profoundly affect protein structure and biological function. Recent advances in deep learning and protein language models have provided powerful tools for computational analysis of mutation-induced stability changes. However, most existing methods focus on quantitative regression of free-energy changes, which places strong dependence on precise experimentally measured ΔΔG values, although reliably determining the direction of stability change is itself an important objective in many practical applications. Here, we propose BlindDDG, a novel framework that reformulates protein mutation stability prediction from quantitative ΔΔG estimation to direction-oriented stability change classification. First, we introduce a blind-evaluation strategy that models mutation-induced changes by learning the representation difference between wild-type and mutant proteins, rather than relying solely on their individual intrinsic properties. This formulation focuses on the direction of stability changes and reduces the dependence on precise quantitative ΔΔG measurements. Second, a Siamese architecture with shared parameters is employed to encode the wild-type and mutant states and capture subtle mutation-associated differences. Third, a local structure-aware cross-attention mechanism is developed to integrate mutation-centered structural information with global protein language model representations, enabling effective multimodal feature interaction. Experimental results on the independent S669 benchmark demonstrate that BlindDDG achieves strong classification performance, obtaining an F1 score of 0.5449, an MCC of 0.3929, an accuracy of 0.7721, and a recall of 0.5417 for stabilizing mutation identification. BlindDDG outperforms all evaluated methods in F1 score, MCC, accuracy, and recall, highlighting its effectiveness in capturing mutation-induced stability changes, particularly for imbalanced stability classification.
zh_abstract: [Journal of chemical information and modeling] 突变引起的蛋白质热力学稳定性变化深刻影响蛋白质的结构和生物学功能。深度学习和蛋白质语言模型的最新进展为突变诱导稳定性变化的计算分析提供了强大工具。然而，大多数现有方法侧重于自由能变化的定量回归，这强烈依赖于实验测得的精确ΔΔG值，尽管在许多实际应用中，可靠判定稳定性变化的方向本身就是一个重要目标。在此，我们提出BlindDDG，这是一种新框架，将蛋白质突变稳定性预测从定量ΔΔG估计重新表述为面向方向的稳定性变化分类。首先，我们引入一种盲评估策略，通过学习野生型与突变型蛋白质之间的表示差异来建模突变诱导的变化，而不是仅依赖于它们各自的内在性质。这种表述聚焦于稳定性变化的方向，并降低了对精确定量ΔΔG测量的依赖。其次，采用参数共享的孪生（Siamese）架构对野生型和突变型状态进行编码，以捕捉与突变相关的细微差异。第三，开发了一种局部结构感知的交叉注意力机制，将以突变为中心的结构信息与全局蛋白质语言模型表示相整合，实现有效的多模态特征交互。在独立的S669基准上的实验结果表明，BlindDDG取得了很强的分类性能，在稳定化突变识别方面F1分数为0.5449，MCC为0.3929，准确率为0.7721，召回率为0.5417。BlindDDG在F1分数、MCC、准确率和召回率方面均优于所有被评估方法，突显了其在捕捉突变诱导稳定性变化方面的有效性，尤其适用于不平衡的稳定性分类。

title: Thermodynamically Guided CRISPR Spacer Optimization: Strategy-Dependent Off-Target Trade-Offs.
source: PubMed · Journal of chemical information and modeling
zh_title: 热力学引导的CRISPR间隔序列优化与脱靶权衡
summary: 将SpCas9间隔序列优化建模为约束搜索，比较三种强化学习、评分引导搜索与提示式LLM五种策略的脱靶权衡。
key_points: 以CRISPRspec特异性为核心目标

abstract: [Journal of chemical information and modeling] Most CRISPR-Cas9 design tools select guide RNAs (gRNAs) by ranking predefined candidates rather than actively optimizing them. Here we instead formulate SpCas9 spacer refinement as a constrained search problem, in which a limited number of nucleotide substitutions may be introduced outside the PAM-proximal seed region. The search is driven by a thermodynamically grounded objective that combines CRISPRspec-based specificity with penalties for suboptimal GC content and long homopolymer runs. Within this single setting we compare five search strategies: three reinforcement-learning (RL) policies, which are Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), Quantile-Regression Deep Q-Network (QR-DQN), and Rainbow Deep Q-Network (Rainbow DQN), together with a nonlearning score-guided search and a prompt-guided large language model (LLM). All five share the same objective, mutable positions, substitution budget, and evaluation protocol, so that only the search strategy differs. On 100 held-out IGF2R guides from a gene and chromosome excluded from training, every strategy significantly reduced the predicted off-target burden (38.6-78.3%) and improved independent specificity metrics without degrading on-target scores. The strategies nevertheless differed sharply in per-guide safety: the LLM achieved the largest aggregate reduction but introduced new off-target sites into 38% of guides that were initially free of them, whereas PPO, an on-policy RL algorithm, retained a strong gain with the lowest regression rate of 15%. These results show that the thermodynamic objective supplies a robust common optimization signal, while the choice of search strategy governs the trade-off between aggregate improvement and regression of already-favorable guides.
zh_abstract: [Journal of chemical information and modeling] 大多数CRISPR-Cas9设计工具通过对预定义候选序列排序来选择向导RNA（gRNA），而非主动对其进行优化。本文将SpCas9间隔序列优化表述为一个受约束的搜索问题，即可在PAM近端种子区之外引入有限数量的核苷酸替换。搜索由一个基于热力学的目标函数驱动，该函数将基于CRISPRspec的特异性与对不理想GC含量和较长同聚物序列的惩罚相结合。在这一统一设定下，我们比较了五种搜索策略：三种强化学习（RL）策略，即近端策略优化（PPO）、分位数回归深度Q网络（QR-DQN）和Rainbow深度Q网络（Rainbow DQN），以及一种非学习的评分引导搜索和一种提示引导的大语言模型（LLM）。这五种策略共享相同的目标函数、可变位置、替换预算和评估方案，因此仅搜索策略不同。在来自训练中排除的基因和染色体的100条留出IGF2R向导上，每种策略均显著降低了预测的脱靶负担（38.6–78.3%），并改善了独立的特异性指标，且未降低靶向评分。然而，各策略在单条向导的安全性方面差异明显：LLM实现了最大的总体降幅，但在38%原本无脱靶位点的向导中引入了新的脱靶位点；而作为同策略（on-policy）RL算法的PPO保持了显著的改善，回退率最低，为15%。这些结果表明，热力学目标函数提供了稳健的通用优化信号，而搜索策略的选择决定了总体改善与原本良好向导发生回退之间的权衡。

abstract: [Ultrasound in medicine & biology] The aim of this study is to develop a workflow for acquiring and analyzing livestream echocardiography images from a GE HealthCare Vivid E95 system, a real-time artificial intelligence (AI)-based automatic left ventricle segmentation, and cardiac parameter prediction. The system provides automated echocardiography image analysis independent of electrocardiogram signals. A software pipeline was developed to acquire and analyze livestream echocardiography images from the ultrasound system. A UNet neural network model was trained using publicly available datasets (CAMUS, EchoNet-Dynamic) and an in-house dataset (Physical Activity and Fitness in Childhood Cancer Survivors). AI models were trained using these three datasets and three loss functions, with each model evaluated independently on all three test datasets. The model with the highest Dice score on the test datasets was selected and used to process livestream echocardiography images throughout the entire cardiac cycle. The resulting segmentation masks were used to compute the cardiac parameters. The offline-trained UNet models achieved an average Dice score of 0.9509. The livestream echocardiography image prediction showed average ejection fractions of 48%, 48% and 56%, corresponding to the Simpson's single-plane, area-length and Bullet methods, respectively. In contrast, EchoPAC (the GE HealthCare software tool to compute cardiac parameters) showed an average ejection fraction of 55% in nine volunteers with no known cardiac diseases. This study shows the feasibility of AI-assisted echocardiographic image analysis based on livestream echocardiography. However, the accuracy of the obtained cardiac parameters needs improvement to align with clinical standards.
zh_abstract: [Ultrasound in medicine & biology] 本研究旨在开发一套工作流程，用于采集和分析 GE HealthCare Vivid E95 系统的实时流（livestream）超声心动图图像，实现基于人工智能（AI）的实时左心室自动分割及心脏参数预测。该系统可独立于心电图信号提供自动化超声心动图图像分析。研究开发了一条软件流水线，用于从该超声系统采集并分析实时流超声心动图图像。使用公开数据集（CAMUS、EchoNet-Dynamic）和内部数据集（儿童癌症幸存者的体力活动与体能研究）训练了 UNet 神经网络模型。AI 模型使用这三个数据集和三种损失函数进行训练，每个模型分别在全部三个测试数据集上独立评估。选取在测试数据集上 Dice 得分最高的模型，用于处理整个心动周期的实时流超声心动图图像。所得分割掩膜用于计算心脏参数。离线训练的 UNet 模型平均 Dice 得分为 0.9509。实时流超声心动图图像预测显示，按 Simpson 单平面法、面积-长度法和 Bullet 法计算的平均射血分数分别为 48%、48% 和 56%。相比之下，在 9 名无已知心脏疾病的志愿者中，EchoPAC（GE HealthCare 用于计算心脏参数的软件工具）显示的平均射血分数为 55%。本研究表明，基于实时流超声心动图的 AI 辅助超声心动图图像分析是可行的。然而，所得心脏参数的准确性仍需提高，才能达到临床标准。

title: Genome-to-Image Translation: Reconstructing Escherichia coli Morphology from Genomic Sequences
zh_title: 基因组到图像：由基因组序列重建大肠杆菌形态
summary: 用冻结基因组语言模型编码分离株，条件WGAN-GP结合抗生素与耐药标签生成菌落图像，训练于167,356张单细胞图像。
