abstract: Antimicrobial resistance in Escherichia coli is established in routine practice by culture-based susceptibility testing, which is slow relative to the clinical need for an early treatment decision. Resistance status also leaves a measurable trace in cell morphology, and whole-genome sequencing of clinical isolates is increasingly available, which raises the question of whether colony appearance can be predicted directly from an isolate's genome. We formulate this as a conditional image-generation problem. The assembled contigs of each isolate are encoded into a single 768-dimensional vector by a frozen genomic language model through a segment-contig-isolate aggregation hierarchy, and a conditional Wasserstein GAN with gradient penalty synthesizes colony images from this embedding together with the applied antibiotic and the resistance label. We train on 167,356 single-cell images from 22 clinical blood isolates imaged under azithromycin, ciprofloxacin, tetracycline, and a no-drug control, compare seven pretrained convolutional backbones inside the generator, and select ConvNeXt-Tiny on distributional image-quality metrics. The synthetic images are then assessed extrinsically: added to a reduced real training set, they improve per-antibiotic resistance classification, with a significant gain in resistant-class recall.
zh_abstract: 大肠埃希菌（Escherichia coli）的抗菌药物耐药性在常规实践中通过基于培养的药敏试验确定，但相对于早期治疗决策的临床需求而言，该方法较慢。耐药状态还会在细胞形态上留下可测量的痕迹，而临床分离株的全基因组测序日益普及，这就提出了一个问题：能否直接根据分离株的基因组预测菌落外观。我们将其表述为一个条件图像生成问题。每个分离株的组装重叠群（contig）通过“片段-重叠群-分离株”聚合层级，由一个冻结的基因组语言模型编码为单个 768 维向量；带梯度惩罚的条件 Wasserstein GAN 则以该嵌入向量、所用抗生素及耐药标签为条件合成菌落图像。我们使用来自 22 株临床血液分离株、在阿奇霉素、环丙沙星、四环素和无药对照条件下成像的 167,356 张单细胞图像进行训练，在生成器内部比较了七种预训练卷积骨干网络，并根据分布型图像质量指标选择了 ConvNeXt-Tiny。随后对合成图像进行外部评估：将其加入缩减后的真实训练集后，可改善各抗生素的耐药性分类，其中耐药类别的召回率显著提高。

title: Triage Accuracy of Jev and Open-Weight System One Decision Models and Their Use for Early Emergency Recognition in Symptom-Assessment Applications
zh_title: Jev与开放权重System One决策模型的分诊准确率及早期急症识别
summary: 在233例合成和10,000例真实病例上评估16个决策模型，最佳模型合成病例分诊正确率72.1%，早期急症识别AUROC 0.87。
key_points: 共163,728次评估，含14个开放权重模型
真实病例中与既有算法一致率56.1%
作者认为决策模型不应取代现有方法
reason: 评估规模较大，但真实病例以既有算法为参照，无临床结局
abstract: Laypeople increasingly use large language models (LLMs) for triage advice, but LLMs answer in variable free text, which makes it hard to evaluate them for use in medical devices. Decision models, which assign a probability to each predefined triage category, may be easier to evaluate. To test their triage accuracy, we evaluated 16 decision models (14 open-weight, 2 proprietary) on 233 synthetic and 10,000 real-world cases, yielding 163,728 total assessments. The best models triaged 72.1% of synthetic cases correctly and agreed with an existing algorithm in 56.1% of real-world cases. They were more promising for recognising emergencies early: given only demographics, chief complaints, risk factors and red-flag answers, the best model reached an AUROC of 0.87. At a 5% error margin, it could decide for or against emergencies for about half of users. Decision models should therefore not replace triage engines but could shorten symptom assessments at setting-specific error margins.

title: Demographic Encoding is Not Exposure: Fairness and Privacy in Chest X-ray Foundation Models
zh_title: 胸片基础模型：人口统计编码不等于隐私暴露
summary: 预印本在BiomedCLIP、DINOv2、RAD-DINO冻结嵌入上训练200个头，发现人口统计编码与成员推断脆弱性基本无关，泄露更取决于头容量与训练时长。
key_points: 在CheXpert和NIH ChestX-ray14上审计200个线性/MLP头
72项CheXpert关联均统计等价于零
擦除人口统计信息未改变泄露，但缩小了年龄相关漏诊差距
reason: 基础模型公平与隐私设计规范，双数据集，但属预印本且无外部临床验证
abstract: Medical foundation models encode patient demographics and can reveal whether a patient was in the training set, and these properties are often treated as one problem. We tested whether they are aligned by measuring demographic encoding, diagnostic fairness gaps and membership-inference vulnerability on the same models. We trained 200 linear or multilayer-perceptron (MLP) heads on frozen BiomedCLIP, DINOv2 and RAD-DINO embeddings, with three seeds, and audited them on CheXpert and NIH ChestX-ray14. Demographic encoding explained almost no variance in patient vulnerability, and all 72 CheXpert associations were statistically equivalent to zero. Erasing linearly decodable demographics left leakage unchanged but reduced age-related underdiagnosis gaps. Leakage depended instead on head capacity and training length. On RAD-DINO, a linear head reached a membership-inference area under the curve (AUC) of 0.694, compared with 0.907 for a 30-epoch MLP, at similar test performance. Fairness and privacy should therefore be audited separately, and linear heads or shorter training reduce leakage with little or no loss of utility. The code is available on GitHub for public use.
zh_abstract: 医学基础模型会编码患者人口统计学信息，并可能揭示某患者是否在训练集中，这两种属性常被视为同一问题。我们通过在相同模型上测量人口统计学编码、诊断公平性差距和成员推断脆弱性，检验二者是否一致。我们在冻结的BiomedCLIP、DINOv2和RAD-DINO嵌入上训练了200个线性或多层感知机（MLP）头，采用三个随机种子，并在CheXpert和NIH ChestX-ray14上进行审计。人口统计学编码几乎不能解释患者脆弱性的方差，CheXpert的全部72项关联在统计学上均与零等价。擦除线性可解码的人口统计学信息后，泄漏不变，但与年龄相关的漏诊差距减小。泄漏则取决于头部容量和训练时长。在RAD-DINO上，线性头的成员推断曲线下面积（AUC）为0.694，而训练30个epoch的MLP为0.907，二者测试性能相近。因此，公平性与隐私应分别审计，采用线性头或缩短训练可减少泄漏，且对效用几乎没有损失或没有损失。代码已在GitHub上公开。

title: Laya-IsoToken: Day-One Clinical Codebook Switching via Closed-Form Operator Compilation
zh_title: Laya-IsoToken：闭式算子编译实现临床编码本即时切换
summary: 提出在无目标编码本标注病历的情况下，通过冻结多语言概念空间并利用公开编码描述，实现ICD等编码本的当日切换。
key_points: 临床文本片段读取器在源数据上仅训练一次
每个编码无专属分类器参数
仅用目标编码公开描述进行闭式编译
reason: 新颖预印本方法，摘要未见充分对比与外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Healthcare systems periodically revise diagnostic and procedural classifications (ICD-9 to ICD-10/11), update hospital reimbursement groupers (MS-DRG), and deploy clinical coding across languages. Supervised coding networks bind clinical text encoders to fixed per-code classifier weights, forcing hospitals to re-annotate tens of thousands of records before switching codebooks, whereas standalone large language models incur high latency and hallucinate invalid codes. Here we show that day-one clinical codebook switching becomes feasible without target-labeled notes when local clinical evidence reading is decoupled from a strictly frozen multilingual concept space. Laya-IsoToken trains a clinical span reader once on source records with zero per-code classifier parameters, separating text evidence from historical disease prevalence. Given only public target code descriptions, closed-form matrix compilation aligns distributional shifts, compensates for paraphrased definitions, and deduplicates sibling codes in under three seconds, while a pre-deployment geometric residual routes unfamiliar concepts to offline language model verification. Across 32,804 MIMIC-IV ICD-9 discharges, Laya-IsoToken matches published supervised baselines (62.6% Micro-F1) while reducing active calibration error by 32%. Switched with zero target training notes to 13,783 unseen-patient ICD-10 discharges, MS-DRG groups, and multilingual cohorts, it outperforms biomedical dense retrievers, semantic crosswalks (+5.4 F1 points on ICD-10, paired $d_z = 0.49$, $p < 0.001$), and official US CMS equivalence mappings (+3.5 points, $p < 0.001$) at 9.4 ms per admission. Pairing this reader with an offline 31B verifier across 1,000 full discharge summaries lifts zero-training ICD-10 coding to 40.6% Micro-F1 (57.0% category F1, $d_z = 0.66$, $p < 0.001$) with 0.0% invalid code hallucinations.

title: Foundation Model and Radiomics Distance Scores for Post-Hoc Segmentation Failure Detection
zh_title: 基于基础模型与影像组学距离分数的分割失败事后检测
summary: 提出两种基于马氏距离的分割失败评分（影像组学形状特征与掩码感知的冻结DINOv3特征），在多中心前列腺与海马MRI的域偏移下与既有方法相当。
key_points: 无需额外回归/分割模型或模型内部信息
使用冻结DINOv3并对掩码区域加权
多站点前列腺与海马MRI测试
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，多站点验证但证据有限
abstract: Medical image segmentation models can fail silently when clinical data differs from training data. Deployed models rarely ship with quality control, and are often black boxes. Prior methods that work in this post-hoc failure detection setting still need a separate regression or segmentation model, registration, or access to model internals. We instead propose two failure scores based on the Mahalanobis distance to a labeled reference set. The first uses radiomic shape features of the predicted mask. The second uses frozen foundation model (FM) features, made mask-aware by overlaying the mask on the image, encoding it with a frozen DINOv3, and pooling patch features with more weight on the mask region. We test on multi-site prostate and hippocampus MRI under imaging-protocol and population shift. Ranking cases by predicted failure risk within each site, both scores are competitive with the registration-based (Atlas-RCA) and ensemble-based (pairwise Dice) baselines, without registration that can fail silently or access to individual predictions. Our results show that pooling all test cases into one ranking, as prior work does, rewards ordering sites by difficulty, so a detector can rank sites well, miss failures within them, and still look strong. Within-site evaluation measures true per-case failure. The two evaluation schemes reward different behavior, so we recommend reporting both. The code is available at https://github.com/imigraz/fm-radiomics-failure-detection.
zh_abstract: 当临床数据与训练数据不同时，医学图像分割模型可能出现无声失败。已部署的模型很少配备质量控制，且通常是黑箱。在这种事后失败检测场景中有效的现有方法，仍需要单独的回归或分割模型、配准，或访问模型内部。我们则提出两种基于到带标签参考集的马氏距离（Mahalanobis distance）的失败评分。第一种使用预测掩膜的影像组学形状特征。第二种使用冻结的基础模型（FM）特征：通过将掩膜叠加在图像上使其具备掩膜感知能力，用冻结的 DINOv3 对其编码，并对 patch 特征进行池化，对掩膜区域赋予更大权重。我们在成像协议和人群发生偏移的多中心前列腺和海马 MRI 上进行了测试。在每个中心内按预测失败风险对病例排序时，这两种评分均可与基于配准的（Atlas-RCA）和基于集成的（pairwise Dice）基线相竞争，且无需可能无声失败的配准，也无需访问各个预测。我们的结果表明，如既往工作那样将所有测试病例汇总为一个排序，会奖励按难度对中心进行排序，因此检测器可以很好地对中心排序、漏掉中心内部的失败，却仍显得表现强劲。中心内评估衡量的是真正的逐病例失败。这两种评估方案奖励的行为不同，因此我们建议同时报告两者。代码见 https://github.com/imigraz/fm-radiomics-failure-detection。

title: A Cascaded Framework with a Cross-Attention-Guided Mamba-CNN Model for Pre- and Post-Treatment Glioma Segmentation
zh_title: 级联Mamba-CNN交叉注意力模型用于治疗前后胶质瘤分割
summary: 提出CMC-Seg级联框架，在BraTS 2025 mpMRI上处理治疗前及含切除腔的治疗后胶质瘤分割。
key_points: 交叉注意力引导的Mamba-CNN
覆盖术后切除腔病例
兼顾精度与计算成本
reason: 新方法有公开数据集验证，但证据有限，预印本
abstract: Accurate glioma segmentation is vital for diagnosis and follow-up, but manual segmentation is time-consuming, subjective, and variable across interpreters. Gliomas are heterogeneous in size, shape, and location. Deep learning has therefore emerged as a potential solution. CNNs excel at local features but may struggle with long-range dependencies, whereas Vision Transformers capture global context efficiently but incur higher computational complexity. Most previous studies focused on pre-treatment gliomas; post-treatment cases with resection cavities (RCs) remain less explored. This study proposes a Cross-Attention-Guided Mamba-CNN (CMC-Seg) model within a cascaded framework for pre- and post-treatment diffuse glioma segmentation, aiming to balance accuracy and computational cost. Experiments used BraTS 2025 mpMRI of diffuse glioma patients. After preprocessing, a coarse segmentation model extracted tumor-centered patches, which were fed to CMC-Seg for fine-grained segmentation. CMC-Seg was compared with 3D U-Net, SegResNet, SwinUNETR, UNETR, nnFormer, and SegMamba. On the test set, CMC-Seg achieved the highest mean Dice (81.20%) and non-enhancing tumor core (NETC) Dice (77.09%). It also achieved an RC Dice of 78.63% and the lowest 95% Hausdorff distance (HD95; 4.39 mm). Results were comparable to CNN and Mamba baselines and significantly better than Transformer-based baselines (P < 0.05). CMC-Seg required the fewest inference GFLOPs (381.49). Ablation experiments indicated that multi-direction scanning and cross-attention improved performance, particularly for RC (P < 0.05). Grad-CAM explainability experiments showed that CMC-Seg focuses on diagnostically relevant tumor regions.
zh_abstract: 准确的胶质瘤分割对诊断和随访至关重要，但手动分割耗时、主观，且不同判读者之间存在差异。胶质瘤在大小、形状和位置上具有异质性，因此深度学习已成为一种潜在的解决方案。卷积神经网络（CNN）擅长局部特征，但可能难以处理长程依赖；而视觉 Transformer（Vision Transformer）能有效捕获全局上下文，但计算复杂度更高。既往多数研究集中于治疗前胶质瘤；伴有切除腔（RC）的治疗后病例仍较少被探索。本研究在级联框架内提出一种交叉注意力引导的 Mamba-CNN（CMC-Seg）模型，用于治疗前和治疗后弥漫性胶质瘤的分割，旨在平衡准确性与计算成本。实验使用 BraTS 2025 弥漫性胶质瘤患者的 mpMRI。预处理后，粗分割模型提取以肿瘤为中心的图像块，再输入 CMC-Seg 进行精细分割。将 CMC-Seg 与 3D U-Net、SegResNet、SwinUNETR、UNETR、nnFormer 和 SegMamba 进行比较。在测试集上，CMC-Seg 取得最高的平均 Dice（81.20%）和非强化肿瘤核心（NETC）Dice（77.09%）。其 RC Dice 为 78.63%，95% Hausdorff 距离（HD95）最低（4.39 mm）。结果与 CNN 和 Mamba 基线相当，并显著优于基于 Transformer 的基线（P < 0.05）。CMC-Seg 所需的推理 GFLOPs 最少（381.49）。消融实验表明，多方向扫描和交叉注意力可提升性能，尤其是对 RC（P < 0.05）。Grad-CAM 可解释性实验显示，CMC-Seg 关注具有诊断意义的肿瘤区域。

title: Beyond Language Optimization: Enhancing Visual Representations for Radiology Report Generation
zh_title: 超越语言优化：增强放射报告生成的视觉表征
summary: 针对胸片报告生成，提出选择性区域视觉蒸馏框架，在保留原有能力的同时提升疑难异常的视觉表征。
key_points: 分析指出GRPO对异常识别的视觉表征提升有限
训练区域感知教师，仅迁移经验证有益的区域特征
预印本，未经同行评审
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，属值得一看档；摘要未见外部验证细节
abstract: Accurate chest X-ray radiology report generation (RRG) requires recognizing clinically relevant abnormalities and accurately describing them. Although Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) improves the clinical accuracy of generated reports, our analyses suggest limited improvements in visual representations for abnormality recognition. To address this limitation, we propose a selective regional visual distillation framework that enhances visual representations of challenging abnormalities while preserving existing visual capabilities. Specifically, we train a region-aware teacher with targeted supervision on challenging anatomical regions to acquire complementary visual knowledge. Rather than transferring all teacher features, we verify their utility through regional feature replacement and select only those that improve the original student's performance. We further introduce a Spatially Gated Residual Adapter (SGRA) to distill these verified features while minimizing interference with the student's existing visual representations. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR and IU-Xray demonstrate improved clinical report accuracy and region-level abnormality recognition across different multimodal large language model backbones, while largely preserving performance on non-target findings.
zh_abstract: 准确的胸部 X 线放射学报告生成（RRG）需要识别具有临床意义的异常并准确描述它们。尽管组相对策略优化（GRPO）可提高生成报告的临床准确性，但我们的分析表明，其对用于异常识别的视觉表征的改进有限。为解决这一局限，我们提出一种选择性区域视觉蒸馏框架，在保留现有视觉能力的同时增强对难识别异常的视觉表征。具体而言，我们训练一个区域感知教师模型，对具有挑战性的解剖区域进行针对性监督，以获得互补的视觉知识。我们并不迁移教师的全部特征，而是通过区域特征替换来验证其效用，仅选择那些能提升原始学生模型性能的特征。我们进一步引入空间门控残差适配器（SGRA）来蒸馏这些经验证的特征，同时尽量减少对学生模型现有视觉表征的干扰。在 MIMIC-CXR 和 IU-Xray 上的实验表明，在不同的多模态大语言模型骨干网络上，临床报告准确性和区域级异常识别均有提升，同时在很大程度上保持了对非目标发现的性能。

title: MISeg-Agent: A Human-in-the-Loop Agentic Framework for Error Diagnosis and Executable Prompt Review in 3D Medical Image Segmentation
zh_title: MISeg-Agent：三维医学图像分割的人在回路智能体框架
summary: 提出人在回路的智能体框架，用于诊断三维医学分割错误并给出可执行的修正提示建议。
key_points: 先依据基准性能与算力选择预训练分割模型
诊断分割局部错误并提供循证修正建议
每次修正后动态更新后续诊断
reason: 智能体+人机协作的新方法预印本，证据有限，值得一看档
abstract: Despite the strong performance of modern medical image segmentation models, their predictions can still contain localized errors that compromise segmentation quality. Identifying and correcting these errors is therefore essential for improving the reliability of existing segmentation results. While interactive segmentation models enable targeted corrections, identifying potential errors, determining where to intervene, and evaluating corrective actions remain challenging. Moreover, each correction changes the current mask, requiring subsequent error diagnosis and recommendations to adapt accordingly. To address these challenges, we propose MISeg-Agent, a human-in-the-loop agentic framework that diagnoses segmentation errors and provides evidence-based correction recommendations. MISeg-Agent first selects a suitable pretrained segmentation model based on benchmark performance and computational requirements. Given its predicted mask, the framework identifies potential missing and excess foreground regions and recommends suspicious slices and corrective points for review. The framework then evaluates candidate point prompts using an interactive segmentation model and presents the resulting corrections for human verification before applying them. By operating directly on images and predicted masks, the error diagnosis process remains independent of the underlying segmentation model architecture. Evaluations on CT datasets demonstrate that MISeg-Agent improves initial segmentation results and produces final masks closely aligned with reference annotations. By integrating adaptive error diagnosis with validated correction recommendations, MISeg-Agent provides an interpretable approach to identifying and reducing residual errors in existing medical image segmentations.
zh_abstract: 尽管现代医学图像分割模型性能强大，其预测仍可能包含局部错误，从而影响分割质量。因此，识别并纠正这些错误对于提高现有分割结果的可靠性至关重要。交互式分割模型虽可实现有针对性的修正，但识别潜在错误、确定干预位置以及评估修正操作仍然具有挑战性。此外，每次修正都会改变当前掩膜，因此后续的错误诊断和推荐也需要相应调整。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 MISeg-Agent，这是一种人在回路的智能体框架，可诊断分割错误并提供基于证据的修正建议。MISeg-Agent 首先根据基准性能和计算需求选择合适的预训练分割模型。对于其预测的掩膜，该框架识别潜在的前景缺失区域和多余区域，并推荐需复核的可疑切片和修正点。随后，该框架使用交互式分割模型评估候选点提示，并在应用前将所得修正结果呈现给人工验证。由于该框架直接作用于图像和预测掩膜，错误诊断过程独立于底层分割模型的架构。在 CT 数据集上的评估表明，MISeg-Agent 改善了初始分割结果，并生成与参考标注高度一致的最终掩膜。通过将自适应错误诊断与经验证的修正建议相结合，MISeg-Agent 为识别并减少现有医学图像分割中的残余错误提供了一种可解释的方法。

title: TriSegAgent: Context-Efficient 3D Annotation with MLLMs via Tri-Planes
zh_title: TriSegAgent：基于三平面的MLLM高效3D标注
summary: 提出用三正交平面让仅接受2D输入的多模态大模型智能体在3D体数据上执行交互式分割标注循环，兼顾token开销与误差可见性。
key_points: MLLM智能体执行点击-检查-修正的标注循环
三平面作为紧凑的3D观察表示
文中称有理论与实验支持
reason: 新颖的MLLM智能体标注方法，预印本，证据有限
abstract: Interactive segmentation models turn a few clicks into a segmentation prediction across domains, so annotators only decide where the prediction still needs correction. Annotation thus becomes a loop of inspecting the prediction and clicking again. Each step of this loop is a visual judgment, which suits general-purpose multimodal large language model (MLLM) agents. In this work, we focus on letting these agents run this loop on 3D volumes. However, the MLLM in such an agent takes only 2D images as input, so the agent must observe the 3D volume in 2D. Since the loop calls the MLLM many times, this observation must be token-compact enough to keep every call cheap, yet informative enough to show error regions in the 3D prediction. We meet both needs with tri-planes, the three orthogonal planes that cross at one point in the volume. We show, both theoretically and empirically, that tri-planes are context-efficient yet keep sufficient detail to show error regions in the 3D prediction. Building on tri-planes, we introduce TriSegAgent, an MLLM agent that refines the 3D prediction iteratively. Within the agent, the MLLM only judges the prediction on tri-planes, while a visual harness turns each judgment into a 3D action in code. To make the loop reliable, the harness places each click at an exact voxel in the volume and checks whether to accept the 3D prediction. To evaluate the agent, we build a diverse benchmark of 690 regions of interest (ROIs) from 35 public medical datasets across three imaging modalities. With frontier MLLMs, TriSegAgent reaches an overall Dice about 10 points above the strongest baseline, and its lead is even larger on targets below 3 cm. With flash-level MLLMs, it outperforms a recent 3D segmentation agent built on a frontier MLLM.

title: Ontology-Compiled 2D Clinical State Fields with Bidirectional Diffusion Encoders for Zero-Training Cross-Ontology Medical Coding
zh_title: 本体编译二维临床状态场：零训练跨本体医疗编码
summary: 提出与词表无关的医疗编码框架OCSF，用扩散预训练双向编码器读取病历，目标本体离线编译，无需重训即可切换编码体系。
key_points: 解耦病历阅读与目标本体索引
双向扩散预训练编码器生成二维状态矩阵
新编码表可在CPU上离线编译
reason: 新方法有新意，但摘要无结果数据，预印本
abstract: Healthcare systems continually revise clinical taxonomies, update reimbursement schedules, and harmonize cross-border registries. Existing automated coding models bind clinical text understanding to fixed vocabulary-specific heads, requiring manual relabeling and retraining whenever code sets change. We introduce Ontology-Compiled 2D Clinical State Fields (OCSF), a vocabulary-free framework that decouples clinical document reading from target ontology indexing so one trained encoder can switch across arbitrary medical vocabularies in seconds without target training. A single-pass bidirectional diffusion-pretrained encoder and vocabulary-free decoder map each clinical note into a fixed-dimension two-dimensional state matrix with zero code-specific parameters. Any target ontology is compiled offline on CPU from public text descriptions into a scale-invariant Tikhonov deconvolution operator that suppresses sibling-code interference while preserving source decision thresholds. Trained solely on English MIMIC-IV ICD-9 discharge summaries and evaluated without target tuning across 58,706 held-out test notes and five unseen ontologies spanning English ICD-10, MS-DRG, Spanish, Greek, and Chinese (115-185,458 codes), OCSF reaches 63.15% Micro-F1 on in-domain ICD-9 (outperforming a matched closed-vocabulary classifier and eliminating late-epoch tail overfitting) and transfers directly to 26,085 English ICD-10 codes (29.23% recall at gold cardinality), MS-DRG groups, and multilingual terminologies, compiling up to 185,458 codes in under 10 seconds on CPU with sub-millisecond GPU readout.

title: Benchmarking VLM Medical Hallucination across 5 Modalities
zh_title: Multi-Med：跨5种模态的医学VLM幻觉基准
summary: 提出含1000个图像-问题对、覆盖五种影像模态的医学幻觉基准Multi-Med，并评测10个常用VLM。
key_points: 覆盖5种影像模态、4类问题
模型表现随模态与问题类型差异显著
最优模型间差异无统计显著性
reason: 新基准但规模仅1000对，属值得一看档；命中VLM方向小幅上调
abstract: Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) within the medical domain remain a difficult and not well-understood problem, and it is still unclear where these models break down. Although several benchmarks targeting medical hallucination have been introduced, they often lack broad coverage across different medical imaging modalities. We introduce Multi-Med, a medical hallucination benchmark containing 1,000 image-question pairs spanning five distinct modalities. Using this benchmark, we perform an in-depth experimental study of 10 widely used VLMs across five modalities and four question categories. Our findings indicate that model performance differs substantially depending on the imaging modality and question type, and that the differences among the best-performing models are not statistically significant.
zh_abstract: 医学领域视觉-语言模型（VLM）中的幻觉仍是一个困难且尚未被充分理解的问题，这些模型在何处失效仍不清楚。尽管已有若干针对医学幻觉的基准被提出，但它们往往缺乏对不同医学影像模态的广泛覆盖。我们提出 Multi-Med，一个包含 1,000 个图像-问题对、涵盖五种不同模态的医学幻觉基准。基于该基准，我们对 10 种广泛使用的 VLM 在五种模态和四类问题上进行了深入的实验研究。我们的发现表明，模型表现因影像模态和问题类型而有显著差异，且表现最佳的模型之间的差异在统计学上并不显著。

title: Empirical Margin Sensitivity: An Interventional Neuron-Level Probe of Post-Trained Medical LLMs
zh_title: 经验边际敏感度：对后训练医学大模型的神经元级干预探针
summary: 提出EMS方法，在MLP下投影列粒度做干预，于MedQA上在10个公开检查点中发现高EMS列（锚点），探究医学后训练模型的内部依赖。
key_points: 借鉴ROME/MEMIT的权重空间干预范式
覆盖4个通用基座与6个医学后训练模型
衡量正确选项与最难错误项的logit边际变化
reason: 新颖的医学LLM可解释性方法，对比多模型，预印本，中档
abstract: Medical post-training raises benchmark accuracy, but accuracy does not show which internal components a model's decisions depend on, or whether components that support one benchmark also support another. We apply the weight-space intervention paradigm of ROME and MEMIT at the granularity of one MLP down-projection column. Our measurement, Empirical Margin Sensitivity (EMS), replaces each coordinate magnitude of a column by its mean while preserving the column's sign pattern and L1 scale, and records the resulting change in the logit margin between the correct option and its hardest-wrong competitor. This isolates the margin's dependence on a column's fine-grained coordinate structure while the column stays in place. We discover high-EMS columns (anchors) on MedQA in ten public checkpoints (four general-purpose bases and six medical post-trained variants) across the Gemma, Llama, Qwen, and AFM families, and measure the same columns on MedMCQA and PubMedQA. Mean-ablating each discovered anchor set lowers MedQA accuracy in all six post-trained models, by 6 to 28 points. In the two pure-SFT checkpoints, crushing anchors raises the PubMedQA margin on correctly answered items (negative EMS), and anchors with this property sit significantly deeper than the same model's other anchors; the four checkpoints trained with RL or mixed recipes show positive PubMedQA EMS and no significant depth shift. The depth association recurs in each of three held-out checkpoints. Because the checkpoints differ in data and pipeline as well as objective, we report these as per-checkpoint observations.
zh_abstract: 医学后训练可提高基准测试的准确率，但准确率并不能显示模型的决策依赖于哪些内部组件，也无法说明支持某一基准的组件是否同样支持另一基准。我们在单个 MLP 下投影列的粒度上应用 ROME 和 MEMIT 的权重空间干预范式。我们的度量方法——经验边际敏感度（Empirical Margin Sensitivity，EMS）——将某一列各坐标的幅值替换为其均值，同时保留该列的符号模式和 L1 尺度，并记录正确选项与最难的错误竞争选项之间 logit 边际由此产生的变化。这在该列保持原位的情况下，分离出了边际对该列细粒度坐标结构的依赖。我们在十个公开检查点（四个通用基础模型和六个医学后训练变体，涵盖 Gemma、Llama、Qwen 和 AFM 系列）上，基于 MedQA 发现高 EMS 的列（锚点），并在 MedMCQA 和 PubMedQA 上测量相同的列。对所发现的每组锚点进行均值消融，使全部六个后训练模型的 MedQA 准确率下降了 6 至 28 个百分点。在两个纯 SFT 检查点中，破坏锚点会提高正确回答题目上的 PubMedQA 边际（EMS 为负），具有这一性质的锚点所处位置显著深于同一模型的其他锚点；而采用 RL 或混合方案训练的四个检查点则显示 PubMedQA 的 EMS 为正，且没有显著的深度偏移。这种深度关联在三个留出的检查点中均再次出现。由于各检查点在数据和训练流程上的差异不亚于目标函数的差异，我们将这些结果作为逐检查点的观察结果予以报告。

title: DARE: Dual-Level Adversarial Learning with Domain-Aware Regularization for Whole Slide Image Classification
zh_title: DARE：用于全切片图像分类的双层对抗学习与域感知正则化
summary: 针对病理全切片图像跨医院域偏移，提出即插即用的无监督域适应框架DARE，以缓解负迁移与不稳定问题。
key_points: 针对扫描设备、染色等造成的域偏移
双层对抗学习结合域感知正则化
即插即用的WSI无监督域适应框架
reason: 病理域适应新方法，摘要未见详细结果，预印本
abstract: Pathological whole slide images (WSIs) exhibit substantial domain shifts across hospitals due to variations in scanning devices, staining protocols, and tissue preparation procedures, leading to significant performance degradation when models are applied to data from different sources. Although unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) has shown strong performance in transferring models from a labeled source domain to an unlabeled target domain in natural images, it remains relatively underexplored in computational pathology. The ultra-high resolution of WSIs and their pronounced inter-slide and intra-slide heterogeneity pose unique challenges for domain adaptation, often rendering existing UDA methods unstable and susceptible to negative transfer. To address these challenges, we propose Dual-level Adversarial learning with domain-aware REgularization (DARE), a plug-and-play UDA framework for WSI classification. DARE incorporates adaptive pseudo-labeling within a teacher-student architecture to provide stable supervision for the target domain, alongside adversarial alignment of both patch-level and slide-level embeddings. Together, these components enable the joint optimization of semantic representations at both levels for cross-domain alignment. We further introduce domain-aware attention masking to regularize attention and improve cross-domain generalization. Extensive experiments on four public WSI datasets demonstrate that DARE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches across various domain shifts.
zh_abstract: 由于扫描设备、染色方案和组织制备流程的差异，病理全切片图像（WSI）在不同医院之间存在显著的域偏移，导致模型应用于不同来源的数据时性能明显下降。尽管无监督域适应（UDA）在自然图像中将模型从有标注的源域迁移到无标注的目标域方面表现出色，但在计算病理学中的研究仍相对不足。WSI 的超高分辨率及其显著的切片间和切片内异质性给域适应带来了独特挑战，常使现有 UDA 方法不稳定并易发生负迁移。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了带域感知正则化的双层对抗学习（Dual-level Adversarial learning with domain-aware REgularization，DARE），这是一种即插即用的 WSI 分类 UDA 框架。DARE 在教师-学生架构中引入自适应伪标签，为目标域提供稳定的监督，同时对图块级和切片级嵌入进行对抗对齐。这些组件共同实现了两个层级上语义表示的联合优化，以进行跨域对齐。我们还引入了域感知注意力掩码，以正则化注意力并提升跨域泛化能力。在四个公开 WSI 数据集上的大量实验表明，DARE 在各种域偏移下始终优于最先进的方法。

title: PsyDrift: Healthy-Reference Latent Diffusion for Anomaly Scoring in Autism Spectrum Disorder
zh_title: PsyDrift：用于自闭症异常评分的健康参照潜在扩散模型
summary: 在ABIDE-I的1102名受试者上，用仅学习健康样本潜在表示的DDPM生成偏离分数；留站点交叉验证下分类器平均AUROC为0.798，DDPM为0.718。
key_points: 覆盖ABIDE-I全部20个站点
留一站点五种子交叉验证
健康参照基线0.68-0.71，显著性摘要未完整说明
reason: 多站点留站点验证，但AUROC中等，预印本
abstract: Individual heterogeneity and acquisition-site variability complicate neuroimaging-based characterization of autism spectrum disorder (ASD). We propose PsyDrift, combining ASD/healthy-control-supervised functional-connectivity representations with healthy-reference latent diffusion. An encoder produces 128-dimensional representations, and a denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) learns exclusively from healthy training latents. Distance from a diffusion-denoised reconstruction provides a continuous deviation score. We evaluate 1,102 subjects from all 20 ABIDE-I sites using five-seed leave-one-site-out cross-validation. The classifier and DDPM achieve mean-site AUROCs of $0.798 \pm 0.003$ and $0.718 \pm 0.013$, respectively; uncertainties denote seed standard deviations. Matched healthy-reference scorers on the same representation achieve 0.68-0.71; the statistical significance of diffusion's modest numerical advantage remains unestablished. Within ASD, scores show weak associations with ADOS Total (Spearman $ρ= 0.108$, $p = 0.038$) and full-scale IQ ($ρ= -0.138$, $p = 0.002$), without adjustment for age, sex, site, or head motion. Frozen evaluation without retraining or hyperparameter adaptation yields pooled AUROCs of 0.69 on ABIDE-II and 0.61 on ADHD-200, providing preliminary evidence of cross-cohort and cross-disorder transfer. These results demonstrate healthy-reference deviation scoring within an ASD-supervised representation; incremental predictive and clinical value remains unestablished.
zh_abstract: 个体异质性和采集站点差异使基于神经影像的自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）特征刻画变得复杂。我们提出 PsyDrift，将由 ASD/健康对照监督的功能连接表示与健康参照潜在扩散相结合。编码器生成 128 维表示，去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）仅从健康训练潜变量中学习。与扩散去噪重建结果之间的距离提供连续的偏离评分。我们使用五个随机种子的留一站点交叉验证，评估了来自 ABIDE-I 全部 20 个站点的 1,102 名受试者。分类器和 DDPM 的站点平均 AUROC 分别为 $0.798 \pm 0.003$ 和 $0.718 \pm 0.013$；不确定度表示种子标准差。在同一表示上，匹配的健康参照评分器达到 0.68-0.71；扩散在数值上的小幅优势是否具有统计学显著性尚未确定。在 ASD 内部，评分与 ADOS 总分（Spearman $ρ= 0.108$，$p = 0.038$）和全量表智商（$ρ= -0.138$，$p = 0.002$）呈弱相关，未对年龄、性别、站点或头动进行调整。在不重新训练或调整超参数的冻结评估中，ABIDE-II 的合并 AUROC 为 0.69，ADHD-200 为 0.61，为跨队列和跨疾病迁移提供了初步证据。这些结果展示了在 ASD 监督表示内进行健康参照偏离评分；其增量预测价值和临床价值尚未确定。

title: Learning Multimodal Representations from Partially Paired, Small-Scale Data
zh_title: 从部分配对小规模数据学习多模态表征（CAMEO）
summary: 提出基于对抗学习的模态融合框架CAMEO，可结合任意预训练单模态编码器，在少量配对样本下学习共享表征，在计算病理任务中低配对数据下优于CLIP类对比方法。
key_points: 对抗式跨模态潜空间对齐，仅需少量配对样本
可接入任意预训练单模态编码器
在细胞微环境分类、细胞类型组成预测中优于对比学习
reason: 新颖多模态方法，有基线对比，但为预印本且证据有限
abstract: Modeling multimodal data from partially paired samples is critical for advancing domains like biomedicine, where vast unimodal datasets and foundation models exist but paired data remains scarce. Existing fusion methods rely on large-scale paired datasets, limiting their use in scenarios with incomplete pairing. We introduce CAMEO, an adversarial learning-based modality fusion framework that integrates modalities from small, partially paired datasets. Combining any pre-trained unimodal encoder with a cross-modal latent alignment mechanism, CAMEO learns shared representations requiring only minimal paired samples. Evaluated on computational pathology tasks such as niche classification and cell type composition prediction, CAMEO achieves superior data efficiency, outperforming contrastive approaches like CLIP in low paired-data regimes, and highlighting the benefits of adversarial alignment when paired annotations are scarce. To facilitate further research, we additionally release a fully annotated HuggingFace dataset comprising three organs and paired image and gene expression modalities. By extending fusion methods to address limited pairing and small-scale datasets, we provide a framework that advances multimodal learning and broadens its applicability to real-world biomedical problems.
zh_abstract: 对部分配对样本的多模态数据建模，对于生物医学等领域的发展至关重要，这些领域存在大量单模态数据集和基础模型，但配对数据仍然稀缺。现有融合方法依赖大规模配对数据集，限制了其在配对不完整场景中的应用。我们提出CAMEO，一种基于对抗学习的模态融合框架，可整合来自小型部分配对数据集的各模态。CAMEO将任意预训练单模态编码器与跨模态潜在对齐机制相结合，仅需极少量配对样本即可学习共享表征。在细胞微环境（niche）分类和细胞类型组成预测等计算病理学任务上的评估表明，CAMEO具有更优的数据效率，在配对数据较少的情形下优于CLIP等对比学习方法，凸显了配对标注稀缺时对抗对齐的优势。为促进后续研究，我们还发布了一个完整标注的HuggingFace数据集，包含三种器官及配对的图像和基因表达模态。通过将融合方法扩展至有限配对和小规模数据集，我们提供了一个推动多模态学习发展的框架，并拓宽其在现实生物医学问题中的适用性。

title: Targeting protein degradation strategies in drug discovery: integrating PROTACs, ubiquitination biology, and AI-driven design.
zh_title: 靶向蛋白降解药物发现：整合PROTAC、泛素化生物学与AI设计
summary: 综述从机制角度整合PROTAC设计、泛素化生物学与AI驱动设计，分析影响靶向蛋白降解转化的关键因素。
key_points: 聚焦可降解性、E3招募、连接子与三元复合物
涵盖泛素化效率与药代特性
结合AI驱动设计视角
reason: 综述类，AI仅为部分内容，无新证据
abstract: [Molecular biomedicine] Targeted protein degradation (TPD) has emerged as a transformative therapeutic strategy for eliminating disease-associated proteins, including targets that remain challenging to modulate using conventional occupancy-driven inhibitors. Among TPD approaches, proteolysis-targeting chimeras (PROTACs) exploit the ubiquitin-proteasome system (UPS) to induce selective and event-driven degradation of proteins of interest (POIs). Despite rapid advances in PROTAC development, successful translation depends on interconnected determinants, including target degradability, ubiquitin ligase (E3) recruitment, warhead and linker properties, ternary-complex formation, ubiquitination efficiency, intracellular exposure, and pharmacokinetic behavior. This review provides an integrated, mechanism-oriented analysis of these determinants by linking PROTAC design, ubiquitination biology, computational approaches, and clinical development. We examine key principles governing PROTAC-mediated degradation, with emphasis on E3-ligase selection, linker design, ternary-complex geometry and cooperativity, ubiquitin (Ub)-acceptor lysine (Lys) accessibility, ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme (E2)/E3 context, proteasomal engagement, inefficient degradation, and the hook effect. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning for degradation-activity prediction, E3-ligase/POI pairing, ligand and linker optimization, ternary-complex modeling, and absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity (ADMET) assessment are critically evaluated alongside their technical and translational limitations. Preclinical developments, clinical-stage degraders, emerging TPD modalities, and major barriers to translation are also discussed. We propose an integrated framework linking distinct target ubiquitination patterns, degrader design, ternary-complex geometry, AI-enabled prediction, and pharmacokinetic/clinical constraints, providing a mechanism-informed roadmap for the rational development of next-generation protein degraders and identifying mechanistic bottlenecks and translational priorities across therapeutic settings.
zh_abstract: 【分子生物医学】靶向蛋白降解（TPD）已成为清除疾病相关蛋白的变革性治疗策略，包括那些传统占位驱动型抑制剂难以调控的靶点。在TPD方法中，蛋白水解靶向嵌合体（PROTAC）利用泛素-蛋白酶体系统（UPS）诱导目标蛋白（POI）的选择性、事件驱动型降解。尽管PROTAC开发进展迅速，但成功转化取决于一系列相互关联的决定因素，包括靶点可降解性、泛素连接酶（E3）招募、弹头和连接子特性、三元复合物形成、泛素化效率、细胞内暴露量以及药代动力学行为。本综述通过将PROTAC设计、泛素化生物学、计算方法和临床开发联系起来，对这些决定因素进行了整合的、以机制为导向的分析。我们探讨了支配PROTAC介导降解的关键原则，重点包括E3连接酶选择、连接子设计、三元复合物几何构型与协同性、泛素（Ub）受体赖氨酸（Lys）可及性、泛素结合酶（E2）/E3背景、蛋白酶体结合、低效降解以及钩状效应（hook effect）。我们还批判性地评估了人工智能（AI）和机器学习在降解活性预测、E3连接酶/POI配对、配体和连接子优化、三元复合物建模以及吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性（ADMET）评估方面的最新进展及其技术和转化局限。此外还讨论了临床前进展、临床阶段降解剂、新兴TPD模式以及转化的主要障碍。我们提出了一个整合框架，将不同的靶点泛素化模式、降解剂设计、三元复合物几何构型、AI赋能的预测以及药代动力学/临床限制联系起来，为下一代蛋白降解剂的合理开发提供基于机制的路线图，并识别各类治疗场景中的机制瓶颈和转化重点。

title: The arc of uncertainty across clinicians' interactions with AI.
zh_title: 临床医生与AI交互中的不确定性轨迹
summary: 文章讨论LLM辅助临床推理的决策链条（是否使用、如何交互、如何解读、是否采纳），并指出各环节存在风险及管理错误等安全隐患。
key_points: AI辅助推理分为多个连续决策阶段
LLM可能产生不易察觉的临床管理错误
能否稳定改善患者结局仍无定论
reason: 观点类文章，议题相关但无新数据，受观点上限约束
abstract: [Discover artificial intelligence] Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used in various clinical settings to support clinical reasoning and decision-making. Although they have demonstrated strong performance on medical knowledge and reasoning tasks, and early studies suggest potential to reduce medical errors, emerging evidence also highlights important safety concerns, including clinically significant management errors in outputs that may not be readily apparent to users. How these tools can be integrated into clinical practice to consistently lead to improved patient outcomes remains an open question. AI-assisted reasoning unfolds across a sequence of decisions: whether to use AI for the clinical question, how to engage with the tool, how to interpret its output, and whether to act. Each stage in this sequence introduces distinct risks, including inappropriate tool selection, incomplete or biased inputs, overconfidence in fluent responses, and failure to recognize error or appreciate nuance. These risks are further shaped by the same clinician factors that generally affect clinical reasoning such as experience, workload, and uncertainty management. Viewing the AI-clinician interaction as a process rather than a single moment highlights several key points of vulnerability but also opportunities for training. Ultimately, the safe use of AI may depend less on the quality of the model and more on the clinician's ability to recognize when its outputs should be questioned, verified, or set aside.
zh_abstract: [探索人工智能] 大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地用于各类临床场景，以支持临床推理和决策。尽管它们在医学知识和推理任务上表现出色，且早期研究提示其有减少医疗差错的潜力，但新近证据也凸显了重要的安全性问题，包括输出中存在具有临床意义的处置错误，而使用者可能不易察觉。这些工具如何整合进临床实践并持续带来更好的患者结局，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。AI辅助推理是在一系列决策中展开的：是否针对该临床问题使用AI、如何与工具互动、如何解读其输出，以及是否据此行动。这一序列中的每个阶段都带来不同的风险，包括工具选择不当、输入不完整或有偏倚、对流畅回答过度自信，以及未能识别错误或体察细微差别。这些风险又受到同样影响临床推理的临床医生因素的塑造，例如经验、工作负荷和不确定性管理。将AI与临床医生的互动视为一个过程而非单一时刻，既凸显了若干关键的脆弱点，也带来了培训的机会。归根结底，AI能否安全使用，可能更取决于临床医生能否识别何时应对其输出提出质疑、加以核实或弃之不用，而非模型本身的质量。

title: Artificial Intelligence-Enabled Natural Product Pharmacology: From Molecular Discovery to Precision Therapeutics.
zh_title: AI赋能天然产物药理学：从分子发现到精准治疗
summary: 综述系统药理学与AI在天然产物分子筛选、靶点优先排序和多维数据整合中的应用，以骨关节炎为代表模型。
key_points: 天然产物多成分多靶点难以表征
网络药理学与AI用于靶点优先排序
以骨关节炎为示例疾病
reason: 综述类，泛泛讨论，无新证据
abstract: [Pharmacological research] The use of natural products as a chemically diverse source of bioactive molecules for drug development has been well established; however, their multicomponent and multitarget nature, uncertain target causality, variable in vivo exposure, and heterogeneous responses to therapy make them challenging to characterize pharmacologically and translate into clinical practice. Systems pharmacology, together with artificial intelligence (AI), provides new approaches for molecular screening, target prioritization, integration of multidimensional data, and development of precision therapeutics. Osteoarthritis (OA), a heterogeneous whole-joint disease characterized by inflammation, oxidative stress, metabolic dysfunction, and tissue remodeling, serves as a representative model for evaluating such approaches. Network pharmacology can be used to organize relationships among natural product constituents, disease-related targets, and signaling pathways. AI can further assist with activity prediction, compound and target prioritization, multi-omics integration, and patient stratification. Studies combining network pharmacology, molecular docking, deep-learning-based affinity prediction, and experimental validation to narrow the list of potential candidate constituents and targets demonstrate the utility of computational methods in candidate prioritization. This article describes the transition of natural product pharmacology from empirical discovery and systems-based analysis to AI-enabled molecular discovery, mechanistic interpretation, pharmacokinetic assessment, and precision therapeutics. Although computational approaches may facilitate the identification and prioritization of biologically active constituents and targets, they remain limited by uncertainty regarding causality, inadequate in vivo exposure, model dependence, and insufficient clinical evidence. Future studies should focus on precise active-compound identification, direct target validation, systematic pharmacokinetic assessment, and high-quality clinical research to enhance the reliability and translational value of AI-enabled natural product pharmacology.
zh_abstract: [Pharmacological research] 天然产物作为化学多样的生物活性分子来源用于药物开发已得到充分确立；然而，其多成分、多靶点的特性、靶点因果关系的不确定性、体内暴露的可变性以及对治疗反应的异质性，使其难以在药理学上加以表征并转化到临床实践中。系统药理学与人工智能（AI）相结合，为分子筛选、靶点优先排序、多维数据整合和精准治疗开发提供了新方法。骨关节炎（OA）是一种以炎症、氧化应激、代谢功能障碍和组织重塑为特征的异质性全关节疾病，是评估此类方法的代表性模型。网络药理学可用于梳理天然产物成分、疾病相关靶点和信号通路之间的关系。AI 可进一步辅助活性预测、化合物和靶点的优先排序、多组学整合以及患者分层。结合网络药理学、分子对接、基于深度学习的亲和力预测和实验验证以缩小潜在候选成分和靶点范围的研究，证明了计算方法在候选物优先排序中的实用性。本文阐述了天然产物药理学从经验性发现和基于系统的分析，向 AI 赋能的分子发现、机制阐释、药代动力学评估和精准治疗的转变。尽管计算方法可能有助于识别生物活性成分和靶点并确定其优先级，但它们仍受限于因果关系的不确定性、体内暴露不足、对模型的依赖以及临床证据不足。未来研究应聚焦于精确的活性化合物鉴定、直接的靶点验证、系统的药代动力学评估以及高质量的临床研究，以提高 AI 赋能的天然产物药理学的可靠性和转化价值。

title: From Data to Duty: An Informatics Blueprint for Pediatric Oncology Trials.
zh_title: 儿童肿瘤试验的信息学蓝图：从数据到责任
summary: 多学科专家共识提出儿童肿瘤合作组临床试验的数据基础设施改进路径，针对人工录入、数据孤岛等问题。
key_points: 现状：病历摘录并手工录入电子CRF，成本高易错
试验数据关闭后长期孤立，限制罕见癌二次利用
跨学科小组提出务实的信息学改进路径
reason: 共识性蓝图文章，AI关联较弱，属观点类增量档
abstract: [Pediatric blood & cancer] The data generated by cooperative-group clinical trials have transformed outcomes for children with cancer, yet the infrastructure underlying their collection and use has not kept pace with advances in informatics and data science. Data collection on pediatric oncology trials remains largely manual: Clinical research assistants abstract values from medical records and key them into electronic case report forms, a process that is costly, slow, inconsistent, and error-prone. Data are often siloed within trial networks for years after a study closes, limiting their value for secondary research, particularly for rare cancers. In this consensus blueprint, an interdisciplinary group of pediatric oncologists, clinical informaticians, data scientists, nurses, clinical research assistants, drug developers, and parent advocates outlines a pragmatic path forward across three components of the data lifecycle: collection, processing, and sharing. We argue that case report forms should be bound to standardized common data elements; that automated data abstraction from electronic health records, including via large language models with human-in-the-loop validation, should replace much of today's manual abstraction; that paper chemotherapy roadmaps should be reconceived as computable artifacts; and that clinical trials data should be deposited in publicly accessible repositories with appropriate governance as soon as practically feasible. We discuss facilitators and barriers within each component, including standards adoption, regulatory complexity, financial sustainability, and workforce capacity. We propose concrete actions for funders, clinical trials networks, professional societies, and industry. The technology to achieve these goals exists today, and widespread adoption requires coordinated leadership, sustainable funding models, and a cultural shift that recognizes data stewardship as an ethical imperative and a duty to the children and families we serve.
zh_abstract: [Pediatric blood & cancer] 合作组临床试验产生的数据已改变了儿童癌症患者的结局，但支撑其收集和使用的基础设施却未能跟上信息学和数据科学的进步。儿童肿瘤学试验的数据收集仍主要依靠人工：临床研究助理从病历中摘录数值并录入电子病例报告表，这一过程成本高、速度慢、不一致且易出错。数据在研究结束后常常多年被封存在试验网络内部，限制了其在二次研究中的价值，尤其是对罕见癌症。在这份共识蓝图中，一个由儿科肿瘤医师、临床信息学专家、数据科学家、护士、临床研究助理、药物研发人员和家长倡导者组成的跨学科小组，围绕数据生命周期的三个组成部分——收集、处理和共享——提出了务实的前进路径。我们主张：病例报告表应与标准化的通用数据元素绑定；应以从电子健康记录中自动提取数据（包括借助带有人工参与验证的大语言模型）取代当前大部分人工摘录；纸质化疗路线图应被重新构想为可计算的产物；临床试验数据应在实际可行的情况下尽早存入具有适当治理机制的公开可访问存储库。我们讨论了每个组成部分中的促进因素和障碍，包括标准的采用、监管复杂性、财务可持续性和人力资源能力。我们为资助方、临床试验网络、专业学会和产业界提出了具体行动。实现这些目标的技术如今已经具备，而广泛采用需要协调一致的领导力、可持续的资助模式，以及将数据管理视为一项伦理要求和对我们所服务的儿童及家庭的责任的文化转变。

title: TesseraFlow: Scalable Video Diffusion for Dynamic Medical Imaging Inverse Problems
zh_title: TesseraFlow：面向动态医学成像逆问题的可扩展视频扩散
summary: 提出复值像素空间流先验，降低动态医学成像重建中视频先验的计算开销。
key_points: 全局编码器每步读取各帧低分辨率视图
浅层解码器处理，减少全分辨率深层网络开销
针对现有先验每帧需数十秒至数分钟的问题
reason: 有新意的生成式重建预印本方法，摘要证据有限
abstract: Generative priors are state-of-the-art for modeling medical images in image reconstruction tasks, but reconstruction with video priors takes tens of seconds to minutes per frame. Latent priors inherit the errors of their autoencoder, the memory of pixel-space whole-frame priors grows with the frame size, and pixel-space patch priors are slow for two reasons. First, their deep networks process every frame at full resolution at every sampling step, even though early steps resolve only low frequencies. Second, their samplers spend many network evaluations per sampling step on overlapping windows, multiple re-noising rounds, or backpropagation through the prior. We introduce TesseraFlow, a complex-valued pixel-space flow prior that reduces the first cost. A global encoder reads a low-resolution view of every frame once per sampling step. A single shallow decoder operates on this view during early steps and on full-resolution space-time tiles during later steps, so no network processes a whole frame at full resolution. Our sampler, ReTile, addresses the second reason. We use randomized grid shifting at every sampling step along with re-noising, which acts as a stochastic gradient instead of computing overlapping tiles, so a single network pass per sampling step suffices. On its own, ReTile speeds up an existing global-context patch prior by 6-9x, and our prior adds a further 3-5x speedup. TesseraFlow reconstructs about one 256x256 frame per second, 20-367x faster than patch and latent video priors, and can match or exceed the best generative baseline on cardiac, brain, and abdominal MRI and lung CT, at a fraction of its GPU time.
zh_abstract: 生成式先验是图像重建任务中医学图像建模的最先进方法，但使用视频先验进行重建时，每帧需要数十秒至数分钟。潜空间先验会继承其自编码器的误差，像素空间整帧先验的内存随帧尺寸增长，而像素空间分块（patch）先验较慢，原因有二。第一，其深层网络在每个采样步骤都以全分辨率处理每一帧，尽管早期步骤仅解析低频成分。第二，其采样器在每个采样步骤中需对重叠窗口、多轮重新加噪或穿过先验的反向传播进行大量网络评估。我们提出 TesseraFlow，这是一种复值像素空间流先验，用于降低第一类开销。全局编码器在每个采样步骤中对每一帧的低分辨率视图读取一次。单个浅层解码器在早期步骤中作用于该视图，在后期步骤中作用于全分辨率的时空图块（tile），因此没有任何网络需要以全分辨率处理整帧。我们的采样器 ReTile 针对第二个原因。我们在每个采样步骤中结合重新加噪使用随机化网格平移，其作用相当于随机梯度，而无需计算重叠图块，因此每个采样步骤只需一次网络前向计算。单独使用时，ReTile 可将现有的全局上下文分块先验加速 6-9 倍，而我们的先验可再带来 3-5 倍的加速。TesseraFlow 每秒可重建约一帧 256x256 图像，比分块和潜空间视频先验快 20-367 倍，并且在心脏、脑部和腹部 MRI 以及肺部 CT 上能够达到或超过最佳生成式基线，而 GPU 耗时仅为其一小部分。

title: CLASP: Complementary Layer Selection and Profiling for Zero-Shot OOD Detection using Vision-Language Models
zh_title: CLASP：基于视觉语言模型的零样本OOD检测层选择与刻画
summary: 提出仅用分布内数据的框架，联合建模层-提示响应与视觉特征，实现医学影像零样本OOD检测。
key_points: 指出低ID置信熵不能可靠预测OOD区分力
用高斯条件互信息排序视觉编码器层
以马氏距离计算OOD分数，无需微调
reason: VLM医学影像新方法预印本，有基线对比但证据有限
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) enable zero-shot out-of-distribution (OOD) detection in medical imaging, yet existing approaches often rely on final-layer confidence or entropy-based layer selection, potentially missing complementary information. We show that low in-distribution (ID) confidence entropy does not reliably predict OOD discrimination. We introduce CLASP (Complementary Layer Selection and Profiling), an ID-only framework that jointly models layer--prompt responses and visual features. CLASP ranks visual encoder layers using Gaussian conditional mutual information and selects a compact subset through anchored spectral selection, without fixing the number of layers. It then combines the selected layer--prompt profiles with PCA-compressed visual embeddings and fits a single shrinkage-regularized Gaussian. OOD scores are computed using squared Mahalanobis distance, without fine-tuning, OOD training data, or test-time adaptation. Across histopathology, chest X-ray, and brain MRI benchmarks with UniMedCLIP and BioMedCLIP, CLASP performs strongly under varied distribution shifts. On MIDOG near-OOD, it achieves 87.54% AUROC with UniMedCLIP, outperforming confidence-based baselines; with BioMedCLIP, it remains competitive but trails visual-only Mahalanobis modeling. Ablations highlight the value of layer--prompt interactions and cross-feature dependencies, while exposing shift-dependent contributions and limitations under semantic shifts.

title: A Multi-Criteria Evaluation of Color Normalization Methods in Histopathology: Nuclei Preservation, Artifact Sensitivity, Background Fidelity, and Downstream Performanc
zh_title: 组织病理颜色归一化方法的多准则评估
summary: 在7个核数据集上对11种颜色归一化方法及7种色彩空间进行基准评估，考察核结构、背景、伪影与下游性能。
key_points: 比较11种经典与深度学习归一化方法
性能差异更多来自数据集而非方法
无单一方法在所有准则中最优
reason: 多数据集系统评估，病理方向，但无新方法
abstract: Deep learning models for nuclei detection and classification may generalize poorly across medical centers because of variations in staining and scanning. Although color normalization aims to reduce these variations, its effects on nuclear structure, background preservation, artifact sensitivity, and nuclei detection and classification performance have not been systematically evaluated. We present a procedure to benchmark 11 classical and deep learning normalization methods using 7 public and private nuclei datasets. Additionally, we investigate the effect of 7 input color spaces. The normalization methods differed in their effects on nuclear structure, background, and sensitivity to artifacts. However, detection and classification performance varied more across datasets than across normalization methods, and the input color space had limited influence. No single method performed best on all criteria, and image-level metrics did not reliably predict downstream performance, highlighting the need for nuclei- and structure-aware normalization methods. To support this work, we introduce WSI Quality Control and Normalization (WSI-QCN), a publicly available pipeline for robust whole-slide image quality assessment and color normalization; the source code is available on GitHub.
zh_abstract: 用于细胞核检测和分类的深度学习模型，可能由于染色和扫描的差异而在不同医疗中心之间泛化不佳。尽管颜色归一化旨在减少这些差异，但其对细胞核结构、背景保持、伪影敏感性以及细胞核检测和分类性能的影响尚未得到系统评估。我们提出了一套流程，使用 7 个公开和私有的细胞核数据集对 11 种经典和深度学习归一化方法进行基准测试。此外，我们还研究了 7 种输入色彩空间的影响。各归一化方法在细胞核结构、背景以及对伪影的敏感性方面存在差异。然而，检测和分类性能在不同数据集之间的差异大于在不同归一化方法之间的差异，且输入色彩空间的影响有限。没有任何单一方法在所有标准上表现最佳，图像层面的指标也不能可靠地预测下游性能，这凸显了对关注细胞核和结构的归一化方法的需求。为支持这项工作，我们提出 WSI Quality Control and Normalization（WSI-QCN），一个公开可用的流程，用于稳健的全切片图像质量评估和颜色归一化；源代码已在 GitHub 上提供。

title: DoC: Learning to Defer or Commit for Timely, Accurate, and Stable Conversational Diagnosis Prediction
zh_title: DoC：学习延迟或提交的对话式诊断预测
summary: 提出两阶段框架，让模型在临床对话中学习何时延迟、何时提交诊断，在EMSDialog和MediTOD上首次提交准确率分别为76.7%/51.2%。
key_points: 无需标注提交时间，迭代估计提交边界构造监督
延迟感知SFT初始化后用轨迹级奖励做强化学习
奖励覆盖及时性、首次提交准确率与提交后稳定性
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，有基线对比但证据有限，无外部验证
abstract: Conversational diagnosis prediction requires accurate, early, and stable predictions from ongoing clinical dialogue, yet dialogue-level labels do not specify when to commit. We propose a two-phase framework for learning deferral and diagnosis decisions. First, iterative commitment-boundary estimation constructs Defer/diagnosis supervision without annotated commitment times. Second, Defer-aware supervised fine-tuning initializes a policy, refined through reinforcement learning with trajectory-level rewards for timeliness, first-commit accuracy, and post-commit stability. On EMSDialog and MediTOD, DoC commits early, achieving the highest first-commit accuracy among post-trained methods (76.7%/51.2%) and the lowest post-commit error overall (16.4%/48.3%).
zh_abstract: 对话式诊断预测要求从持续进行的临床对话中做出准确、及时且稳定的预测，但对话层面的标签并未指明何时应当做出决定。我们提出一个用于学习延迟（deferral）与诊断决策的两阶段框架。第一阶段，迭代式决定边界估计在没有标注决定时间的情况下构建 Defer/诊断监督信号。第二阶段，感知 Defer 的监督微调初始化一个策略，并通过强化学习进一步优化，该强化学习使用轨迹层面的奖励，涵盖及时性、首次决定的准确性以及决定后的稳定性。在 EMSDialog 和 MediTOD 上，DoC 能够较早做出决定，在经过后训练的方法中取得了最高的首次决定准确率（76.7%/51.2%），并取得了总体最低的决定后错误率（16.4%/48.3%）。

title: Elicitation format changes zero-shot classification accuracy in a medical vision-language model: a two-center evaluation on colorectal histopathology
zh_title: 提问格式改变医学视觉语言模型零样本分类准确率：结直肠病理双中心评估
summary: 在PathMNIST上评估MedGemma-27b-it，要求输出九类概率相比排序前三使准确率下降约13–15个百分点，去除禁止推理说明的限制后可恢复。
key_points: 验证集10,004块、外部中心7,180块病理图像
九类概率格式使准确率下降14.8/13.4个点
取消评论禁令后准确率回升约0.19
reason: 有外部中心评估的预印本，病理VLM方向，但属提示敏感性分析
abstract: Background. Verbalized confidence from a hosted medical vision-language model is usually treated as packaging around an unchanged prediction. Methods. We held a nine-class colorectal histopathology prompt fixed except for the requested response format and evaluated MedGemma-27b-it on 10,004 validation and 7,180 external-center PathMNIST patches, with preregistered endpoints, randomized ties, and random floors recomputed for each patch set. Results. Requesting probabilities over all nine classes instead of a ranked top-3 reduced accuracy by 14.8 points on validation, -0.1475 [-0.1594, -0.1353], and 13.4 at the external center, -0.1341 [-0.1484, -0.1196], against chance accuracy of 0.1111. The nine-class prompt uniquely forbade commentary, reasoning, and a chosen answer; removing that prohibition at matched cardinality and token budget recovered +0.1878 [+0.1623, +0.2134] and +0.1911 [+0.1648, +0.2181], while changing cardinality with the prohibition absent moved accuracy by -0.0013 [-0.0300, +0.0280] and -0.0214 [-0.0494, +0.0071]. The nine-class format returned no parseable distribution on 7.6 and 7.7 percent of patches, mostly zero vectors in the two least-textured classes, and deferring these failures first explained its measurable selective-prediction gain. Across four vision-capable models, accuracy did not grade the cost: two models matched on accuracy differed five- to sevenfold. First-token logit entropy routed better than any elicited signal, +0.1820 [+0.1722, +0.1974] versus +0.0493 [+0.0377, +0.0649] relative to each signal's random floor. Conclusions. Response format changes a medical vision-language classifier, and the operative component here was the instruction suppressing an answer. Use logits when available; otherwise request a short ranked list without prohibiting reasoning or a chosen answer.
zh_abstract: 【背景】来自托管式医学视觉-语言模型的口头表达置信度通常被视为未改变预测结果的外包装。【方法】我们固定一个九类结直肠组织病理学提示词，仅改变所要求的回答格式，并在 10,004 个验证集斑块和 7,180 个外部中心 PathMNIST 斑块上评估 MedGemma-27b-it；研究采用预先注册的终点、随机化的并列处理，并针对每个斑块集重新计算随机下限。【结果】与要求给出排序的前 3 个类别相比，要求给出全部九个类别的概率使验证集准确率降低 14.8 个百分点，为 -0.1475 [-0.1594, -0.1353]，外部中心降低 13.4 个百分点，为 -0.1341 [-0.1484, -0.1196]，而随机准确率为 0.1111。九类提示词独有地禁止评论、推理和给出选定答案；在匹配类别数和 token 预算的条件下去除该禁令后，准确率分别回升 +0.1878 [+0.1623, +0.2134] 和 +0.1911 [+0.1648, +0.2181]，而在不存在该禁令的情况下改变类别数，准确率变化分别为 -0.0013 [-0.0300, +0.0280] 和 -0.0214 [-0.0494, +0.0071]。九类格式在 7.6% 和 7.7% 的斑块上未返回可解析的分布，多为纹理最少的两个类别中的零向量，延迟处理这些失败样本首先解释了其可测量的选择性预测增益。在四个具备视觉能力的模型中，准确率并不能反映这种代价：两个准确率相当的模型之间相差五至七倍。首个 token 的 logit 熵比任何诱导得到的信号路由效果更好，相对于各信号的随机下限分别为 +0.1820 [+0.1722, +0.1974] 与 +0.0493 [+0.0377, +0.0649]。【结论】回答格式会改变医学视觉-语言分类器的表现，而此处起作用的成分是抑制给出答案的指令。有 logits 时应使用 logits；否则应要求给出简短的排序列表，且不要禁止推理或给出选定答案。

title: Meddies-PII: A Multilingual Framework for Personally Identifiable Information Extraction in Clinical De-identification
zh_title: Meddies-PII：临床文本多语言去标识化框架
summary: 发布覆盖17种语言、9类PII标签的合成数据集，350M参数分类器在15个公开基准上表现最优。
key_points: 数据集覆盖17种语言含7种东南亚语言
公开完整生成提示与标签映射
平均精确匹配F1为0.827，对比最强系统0.672
reason: 开放资源、多基准对比，但为预印本且合成数据
abstract: Multilingual PII extraction in clinical text is limited by scarce governed data and by synthetic corpora whose construction is thinly documented. We present a large multilingual dataset covering seventeen languages, including seven Southeast Asian languages, and nine PII labels. We also document a detailed generation pipeline and release the complete prompts, catalogues, checks and label maps. A compact 350M-parameter BIOES token classifier trained on the resource achieves the highest score on all fifteen public benchmarks, significantly ahead of the strongest of four public systems on fourteen of them, with a mean exact-match F1 of 0.827 against 0.672 for the strongest system. We also tested it, without adaptation, on multilingual benchmarks, including two human-annotated German and Spanish clinical-style corpora, where it is competitive with the best public systems once annotation conventions are aligned, and is best in four of ten MultiGraSCCo languages; the results show that performance transfers across public benchmarks. We also analyse the data and find almost no near-duplicates and no text overlap between training and any evaluation set. The dataset, benchmark, model, generation framework and evaluation code are planned for public release upon acceptance.
zh_abstract: 临床文本中的多语言个人身份信息（PII）提取，受限于受监管数据的稀缺，以及合成语料库构建过程文档记录不足。我们提出了一个大型多语言数据集，涵盖十七种语言（包括七种东南亚语言）和九种 PII 标签。我们还记录了详细的生成流程，并公开发布完整的提示词、目录、检查项和标签映射。在该资源上训练的一个紧凑型 3.5 亿参数 BIOES 词元分类器，在全部十五个公开基准上取得最高分，其中在十四个基准上显著优于四个公开系统中最强的系统，平均精确匹配 F1 为 0.827，而最强系统为 0.672。我们还在未经适配的情况下，在多语言基准上对其进行了测试，其中包括两个人工标注的德语和西班牙语临床风格语料库；在标注规范对齐后，其表现与最佳公开系统相当，并在十个 MultiGraSCCo 语言中的四个上表现最佳；结果表明其性能可在公开基准之间迁移。我们还对数据进行了分析，发现几乎不存在近似重复，且训练集与任何评估集之间均无文本重叠。数据集、基准、模型、生成框架和评估代码计划在论文被接收后公开发布。

title: Task-specific fine-tuning versus frontier large language models for RoB 2 risk of bias assessment: development and external benchmark evaluation of RoB-BERT
zh_title: 任务微调与前沿大模型用于RoB 2偏倚评估：RoB-BERT开发与外部基准评估
summary: 开发微调的RoB-BERT，在419份人工评估基准上与三种前沿LLM比较其与人工评估的一致性。
key_points: 基于5,304条审核评估训练
输出信号问题答案并引用支持句
与三种前沿LLM在外部基准比较
reason: 有外部基准与基线对比的预印本，场景为证据评价，属值得一看档
abstract: Background: Researchers increasingly use large language models (LLMs) to assess risk of bias in randomized trials, but how task-specific fine-tuned models compare with frontier models remains uncertain. Objective: To develop RoB-BERT, a fine-tuned RoB 2 assessment system, and to compare its agreement with human assessments against that of three frontier LLMs. Methods: RoB 2 rates five bias domains and the trial overall as low risk, some concerns or high risk, based on answers to 22 signalling questions. RoB-BERT answers each question, quotes the supporting sentences from the trial report, and applies the official RoB 2 algorithm. We trained RoB-BERT on 5,304 reviewer-checked assessments, none from a test trial, and compared it with Claude Fable 5.1, GPT-6 Astra and Gemini 4 Argon, each given identical prompts and text, against 419 published human assessments (ROBoto2, LogiMed-RoB and Cochrane reviews) made without AI assistance. Each reference was the single published judgement for that trial, made by one assessor or agreed by two, rather than an expert reference standard, so we also report agreement between two human assessors of the same trial. Results: In ROBoto2, pairs of human assessors who rated the same trial agreed on 61.2% to 64.7% of domain judgements ({kappa} 0.15 to 0.35) and 46.2% to 50.0% of overall judgements ({kappa} 0.15 to 0.17); across the 185 ROBoto2 trials, RoB-BERT agreed with the human judgement on 67.4% ({kappa} 0.35) and 53.5% ({kappa} 0.20). Across all 419 assessments, domain agreement was 67.9% ({kappa} 0.29) for RoB-BERT, 65.0% ({kappa} 0.24) for Claude Fable 5.1, 52.7% ({kappa} 0.21) for GPT-6 Astra and 66.7% ({kappa} 0.26) for Gemini 4 Argon; overall agreement was 46.1% ({kappa} 0.16), 47.3% ({kappa} 0.17), 31.0% ({kappa} 0.03) and 46.5% ({kappa} 0.14), respectively. For domains the reference rated high risk, sensitivity was 22.2% for RoB-BERT, 23.1% for Claude Fable 5.1, 41.9% for GPT-6 Astra and 24.8% for Gemini 4 Argon, with specificity of 92.5%, 92.8%, 80.0% and 95.0%. On the 52 ROBoto2 trials rated by two assessors, the second assessor's sensitivity for the reference assessor's high-risk domains was 23.1% (specificity 90.3%) and RoB-BERT's was 30.8% (specificity 92.7%). RoB-BERT located 95.7% of its quotations verbatim in the report and cost US$0.005 per trial, 2% to 6% of the frontier models' cost. Conclusions: RoB-BERT agreed with single human assessors at least as closely as two human assessors agreed with each other,
zh_abstract:
【背景】研究者越来越多地使用大语言模型（LLM）评估随机试验的偏倚风险，但针对特定任务微调的模型与前沿模型相比如何，仍不确定。
【目的】开发 RoB-BERT（一种经微调的 RoB 2 评估系统），并比较其与人工评估的一致性和三种前沿 LLM 与人工评估的一致性。
【方法】RoB 2 根据对 22 个信号问题的回答，将五个偏倚领域及试验总体评定为低风险、存在一些担忧或高风险。RoB-BERT 回答每个问题，引用试验报告中的支持性语句，并应用官方 RoB 2 算法。我们使用 5,304 条经评审者核查的评估（均不来自任何测试试验）训练 RoB-BERT，并将其与 Claude Fable 5.1、GPT-6 Astra 和 Gemini 4 Argon（均给予相同的提示和文本）一起，与 419 条未借助 AI 完成的已发表人工评估（ROBoto2、LogiMed-RoB 和 Cochrane 综述）进行比较。每条参考标准是该试验已发表的单一判断，由一名评估者作出或两名评估者达成一致，而非专家参考标准，因此我们还报告了同一试验的两名人工评估者之间的一致性。
【结果】在 ROBoto2 中，对同一试验评分的成对人工评估者在领域判断上的一致率为 61.2% 至 64.7%（κ 0.15 至 0.35），总体判断一致率为 46.2% 至 50.0%（κ 0.15 至 0.17）；在 185 项 ROBoto2 试验中，RoB-BERT 与人工判断的一致率分别为 67.4%（κ 0.35）和 53.5%（κ 0.20）。在全部 419 条评估中，领域一致率 RoB-BERT 为 67.9%（κ 0.29），Claude Fable 5.1 为 65.0%（κ 0.24），GPT-6 Astra 为 52.7%（κ 0.21），Gemini 4 Argon 为 66.7%（κ 0.26）；总体一致率分别为 46.1%（κ 0.16）、47.3%（κ 0.17）、31.0%（κ 0.03）和 46.5%（κ 0.14）。对于参考标准评为高风险的领域，RoB-BERT 的敏感度为 22.2%，Claude Fable 5.1 为 23.1%，GPT-6 Astra 为 41.9%，Gemini 4 Argon 为 24.8%，特异度分别为 92.5%、92.8%、80.0% 和 95.0%。在由两名评估者评定的 52 项 ROBoto2 试验中，第二名评估者对参考评估者所评高风险领域的敏感度为 23.1%（特异度 90.3%），RoB-BERT 的敏感度为 30.8%（特异度 92.7%）。RoB-BERT 所引用语句中有 95.7% 可在报告中逐字找到，每项试验成本为 0.005 美元，为前沿模型成本的 2% 至 6%。
【结论】RoB-BERT 与单个人工评估者的一致程度至少与两名人工评估者之间的一致程度相当，

title: A2Holo: Dual-Stream Flow Matching of 3D Structure and a Protein Language Model for Conformational Transition Prediction
zh_title: A2Holo：用双流流匹配与蛋白语言模型预测构象转变
summary: 将apo到holo构象预测视为两个实验结构间的流匹配，在D3PM基准上取得中位Cα RMSD 0.809 Å，为现有方法最低。
key_points: 确定性单轨迹，无需配体条件或随机采样
TM-score在至少144/150对上超过随机基线最佳样本
残基级联合注意力可度量多模态机制
reason: 新方法预印本，基准对比充分但无外部验证
abstract: Modelling a ligand-bound holo conformation from a ligand-free apo conformation is essential in structure-based drug discovery. We present A2Holo, which casts apo-to-holo prediction as flow matching between two experimental structures rather than generation from noise. It transplants the dual-stream joint attention of in-context image generation to residue-aligned protein language model embeddings and structure. Without ligand conditioning or stochastic sampling, A2Holo's single deterministic trajectory reaches a median C RMSD of 0.809 [A] on the D3PM benchmark, the lowest among existing methods. Its TM-score exceeds even the best of 10 samples from every stochastic baseline on at least 144 of 150 pairs. Beyond performance, we directly measure the transplanted multimodal mechanism itself. Because sequence and structure are residue-aligned, its joint attention can be measured at residue resolution and tested for reproducibility across independently trained model variants. Within the structure stream, the attention a residue receives recovers moving residues better than the attention it emits, and this asymmetry is learned. A2Holo demonstrates a successful multimodal transplant from in-context image generation to protein conformational change, with strong deterministic apo-to-holo prediction. It also provides a quantitative account of how that mechanism organises residue-aligned sequence and structure around the residues that move.
zh_abstract: 根据无配体的apo构象来建模结合配体的holo构象，对基于结构的药物发现至关重要。我们提出A2Holo，它将apo到holo的预测视为两个实验结构之间的流匹配（flow matching），而非从噪声生成。它将上下文图像生成（in-context image generation）中的双流联合注意力移植到与残基对齐的蛋白质语言模型嵌入和结构上。在不使用配体条件、也无随机采样的情况下，A2Holo的单条确定性轨迹在D3PM基准上达到了0.809 [A]的中位C RMSD，为现有方法中最低。其TM-score在150对中至少144对上，甚至超过了每个随机基线10个样本中的最佳者。除性能之外，我们还直接度量了被移植的多模态机制本身。由于序列与结构在残基层面对齐，其联合注意力可以在残基分辨率上度量，并可在独立训练的模型变体之间检验其可重复性。在结构流内，一个残基所接收到的注意力比其所发出的注意力更能识别发生移动的残基，并且这种不对称性是习得的。A2Holo展示了将上下文图像生成成功地多模态移植到蛋白质构象变化上，具有强大的确定性apo到holo预测能力。它还对该机制如何围绕发生移动的残基来组织残基对齐的序列与结构提供了定量的说明。

title: deeprok: highly accurate prokaryotic gene prediction through deep learning and overlap-aware decoding
zh_title: deeprok：深度学习与重叠感知解码的原核基因预测
summary: deeprok结合碱基级神经网络与重叠感知解码器，在四个基因组上比Prodigal和GeneMarkS-2精确匹配错误少10-18%，起始位点错误少21-41%。
key_points: 碱基级网络加重叠感知解码器
四个远缘基因组上对比Prodigal等
2,925个实验验证起始位点错误降低21-41%
reason: 有基线对比的新方法预印本，偏基础基因组学
abstract: Prokaryotic gene prediction is often considered solved, yet widely used tools still disagree on many genes, chiefly short genes and translation starts. We present deeprok, an ab initio prokaryotic gene prediction method that combines a base-level neural network with an overlap-aware decoder, and refines start-site predictions with a self-trained neural ranker. On four curated genomes distant from its training data, deeprok made 10-18% fewer exact-match errors than Prodigal and GeneMarkS-2, and on 2,925 experimentally verified starts it made 21-41% fewer start errors. Furthermore, deeprok's base-level architecture reveals lineage-specific translation initiation signals. These results show that per-base deep learning combined with overlap-aware decoding can improve prokaryotic gene prediction, especially for resolving translation starts.
zh_abstract: 原核生物基因预测常被认为已经解决，但广泛使用的工具在许多基因上仍存在分歧，主要是短基因和翻译起始位点。我们提出 deeprok，一种从头（ab initio）原核基因预测方法，它将碱基水平神经网络与重叠感知解码器相结合，并通过自训练的神经排序器优化起始位点预测。在四个与其训练数据差异较大的已整理基因组上，deeprok 的完全匹配错误比 Prodigal 和 GeneMarkS-2 少 10%–18%；在 2,925 个经实验验证的起始位点上，其起始位点错误减少 21%–41%。此外，deeprok 的碱基水平架构揭示了谱系特异性的翻译起始信号。这些结果表明，逐碱基深度学习与重叠感知解码相结合可以改进原核基因预测，尤其有助于解析翻译起始位点。

title: Interpretable competing-risk prediction of hepatocellular carcinoma in cirrhosis from region-wide routine health data

summary: 预印本：利用安达卢西亚区域常规健康数据，训练可解释提升机模型，在区分竞争性死亡的同时预测肝硬化患者12个月内肝癌发生。

abstract: Background. Short-term prediction of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) in cirrhosis is complicated by the competing risk of death from liver disease. We aimed to develop an interpretable model on region-wide routine data that predicts HCC while separating competing mortality, and to compare it with established risk scores. Methods. From a region-wide cohort of adults with cirrhosis in the Andalusian Population Health Database, we trained the model on 17,177 patients with a prediction date set 12 months before their outcome, between 2020 and 2023. From one year of electronic health records before that date (demographics, liver and chronic disease codes, and eight routine laboratory tests), an Explainable Boosting Machine without interaction terms classified the following 12 months as HCC, death or liver transplantation without HCC, or event-free. We evaluated it in 20 repeats of 5-fold cross-validation against a binary model, a model with pair interactions and a model using the full health record, all on the same folds. We then applied the cross-validated models, without retraining, at the first routine encounter at which aMAP or the Toronto HCC Risk Index could be computed, and compared them with the scores in patients followed forward under competing risks, with and without a 6-month washout and with each province left out of training in turn. Findings. 771 patients (4.5%) developed HCC within 12 months and 3,314 (19.3%) died or underwent liver transplantation without HCC (3,061 deaths, 253 transplants). A binary formulation, pairwise interactions and the full health record (more than 3,000 features) did not improve it; the full record lowered it by 0.024. At equal group size, its high-risk group held as much HCC as the scores' high-risk categories, with 20-28% fewer competing deaths. zh_abstract: 【背景】肝硬化患者肝细胞癌（HCC）的短期预测因肝病死亡这一竞争风险而变得复杂。我们旨在基于全区域常规数据开发一个可解释模型，在预测HCC的同时分离竞争性死亡，并将其与已有风险评分进行比较。【方法】我们从安达卢西亚人群健康数据库中全区域的成人肝硬化队列出发，在2020年至2023年间，以结局发生前12个月为预测日期，用17,177例患者训练模型。利用该日期之前一年的电子健康记录（人口统计学、肝病和慢性病编码以及八项常规实验室检查），一个不含交互项的可解释提升机（Explainable Boosting Machine）将随后12个月分类为HCC、未发生HCC的死亡或肝移植，或无事件。我们通过20次重复的5折交叉验证，将其与二分类模型、含成对交互项的模型以及使用完整健康记录的模型进行评估，所有模型使用相同的折。随后，我们在可计算aMAP或多伦多HCC风险指数（Toronto HCC Risk Index）的首次常规就诊时，不经重新训练地应用经交叉验证的模型，并在存在竞争风险的前向随访患者中与这些评分比较，分别设置有无6个月洗脱期，并依次将每个省份排除在训练之外。【结果】771例患者（4.5%）在12个月内发生HCC，3,314例（19.3%）在未发生HCC的情况下死亡或接受肝移植（3,061例死亡，253例移植）。在交叉验证中，HCC的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）为0.734（SD 0.018）。二分类形式、成对交互项和完整健康记录（超过3,000个特征）均未提高该值；完整记录使其降低了0.024。在常规就诊时，该模型对12个月HCC的区分能力优于aMAP（时间依赖性AUC 0.790对0.688；差值+0.102，95% CI +0.071至+0.132）和多伦多HCC风险指数（0.761对0.703；+0.057，+0.032至+0.081），并且在排除6个月内诊断的HCC后（一致性差值分别为+0.055和+0.040）以及将八个省份逐一排除出训练时仍保持更优。在组规模相同的情况下，其高风险组所含HCC与各评分的高风险类别相当，而竞争性死亡减少20-28%。其形状函数区分了癌症特异性信号（AFP从2升至20 g/L，血小板低于150 x10^9/L）与肝衰竭（胆红素高于51 mol/L，白蛋白

title: STREAM: Sequential Transformer for Risk Estimation from Asynchronous Medical Events for Dynamic Postoperative AKI Prediction
zh_title: STREAM：基于异步事件序列Transformer的术后AKI动态预测
summary: 在16.7万例非心脏手术回顾性队列中，事件流Transformer的术后AKI预测AUROC为0.942，优于对比模型。
key_points: 事件流表示不规则EHR，支持逐事件预测
手术结束时AUROC/AUPRC为0.942/0.771
校准在术后各时间点更一致
reason: 大样本回顾性预印本，摘要未见外部验证，限于6分内
abstract: Postoperative acute kidney injury (PO-AKI) risk estimates evolve as clinical information accumulates, yet many electronic health record (EHR) models use static or fixed-window representations. We developed STREAM, a perioperative event-stream Transformer that represents irregular EHR data as chronological clinical events and supports surgery-index prediction at surgery completion and event-by-event postoperative AKI prediction. In a retrospective cohort of 167,078 noncardiac surgical episodes, STREAM achieved surgery-index AUROC/AUPRC of 0.942/0.771, the Time-series Transformer 0.933/0.729, and GRU-D 0.926/0.695. Postoperative macro-AUPRC across 6-hour evaluation intervals was 0.589, 0.525, and 0.547, respectively. STREAM showed more consistent calibration across postoperative time points than the comparators. Event-arrival attribution and within-window permutation analysis enabled event-level interpretation of how newly arrived information and fine-grained event ordering shaped evolving risk estimates. These findings support event-stream modeling as an interpretable framework for dynamic, temporally resolved prediction from longitudinal EHR data as well as a potential risk-estimation component for future perioperative digital twins.

title: Generative Deep Learning for Computational Destaining and Restaining of Unregistered Digital Pathology Images.
source: PubMed · Proceedings of the ... International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications. International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications
