summary: 评估cGAN在跨机构外部WSI上的H&E去染色与重染色泛化，采用染色归一化等预处理缓解域偏移而无需重训。
key_points: 原模型基于布莱根妇女医院102张前列腺活检WSI
在斯坦福3名患者82张未配准WSI上评估
预处理缓解域偏移，无需重新训练
reason: 跨机构外部评估但样本小，病理方向小幅上调
abstract: [Proceedings of the ... International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications. International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications] Conditional generative adversarial networks (cGANs) have enabled high-fidelity computational staining and destaining of hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) in digital pathology whole-slide images (WSI). However, their ability to generalize to out-of-distribution WSIs across institutions without retraining remains insufficiently characterized, limiting scalable clinical translation. Previously developed cGAN models trained on 102 registered prostate core biopsy WSIs from Brigham and Women's Hospital were evaluated on 82 spatially unregistered WSIs from three Stanford University patients. To mitigate domain shift without retraining, a preprocessing pipeline consisting of histogram-based stain normalization for H&E-stained WSIs and channel-wise intensity calibration for unstained WSIs was developed. Because image registration was intentionally omitted for real-world deployment conditions, the reported quantitative results are conservative lower bounds reflecting both model performance and limited spatial alignment. Under these conditions, virtual destaining achieved a Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC) of 0.854, structural similarity index measure (SSIM) of 0.699, and peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of 18.41 dB. H&E restaining from computationally destained outputs outperformed direct staining from ground-truth unstained inputs across all metrics (PCC: 0.798 vs. 0.715; SSIM: 0.756 vs. 0.718; PSNR: 20.08 vs. 18.51 dB), suggesting that preprocessing quality may be more limiting than model capacity. Qualitative pathological review indicated that benign glandular structures were more reliably preserved, and malignant glands were often rendered with vessel-like morphologies. These findings support the feasibility of applying cGAN-based computational H&E staining and destaining generative models to external WSI datasets using preprocessing-based adaptation alone, and identify malignant gland preservation for future domain adaptation.

title: Synthetic EHR Generators Should Be Audited Like LLMs
zh_title: 合成EHR生成器应像LLM一样接受记忆审计
summary: 立场类预印本，主张对自回归合成EHR生成模型开展患者级记忆审计，并比较四种生成器的成员推断评估做法。
key_points: 现有隐私评估依赖相似性启发式
比较四种自回归EHR生成器的成员推断
引入患者级canary区分记忆与泛化
reason: 隐私审计方法立场，预印本，有实验但规模小
abstract: Synthetic electronic health record (EHR) generation is increasingly adopting large autoregressive models, yet privacy evaluation has not kept pace, relying heavily on similarity-based heuristics and aggregate metrics that can obscure patient-specific memorisation. We argue that these models should additionally undergo LLM-style memorisation audits at the level of individual patient records. We support this position by comparing membership-inference evaluations across four prominent autoregressive EHR generators, highlighting inconsistent evaluation practices in patient representations and attack procedures. We evaluate trajectory reconstruction from partial context and introduce randomly assigned patient-level canaries to distinguish memorised associations from clinical generalisation. We examine these methods in a GPT-2-style model deliberately overfit to 1,000 MIMIC-IV patient trajectories, creating a controlled setting in which memorisation should be readily detectable. The model systematically recovers training patients' canaries, and their trajectory reconstruction approaches perfect accuracy with increasing context. Held-out patients show no systematic canary recovery, while reconstruction remains low and improves only marginally with additional context. These experiments establish a positive-control baseline for further evaluation of these methods in realistically trained models.
zh_abstract: 合成电子健康记录（EHR）生成越来越多地采用大型自回归模型，但隐私评估却未能同步发展，仍严重依赖基于相似度的启发式方法和汇总指标，而这些方法可能掩盖针对特定患者的记忆现象。我们主张，这些模型还应在个体患者记录层面接受LLM式的记忆审计。为支持这一立场，我们比较了四种主流自回归EHR生成器的成员推断评估，指出其在患者表示和攻击流程方面的评估做法并不一致。我们评估了基于部分上下文的轨迹重建，并引入随机分配的患者层面金丝雀（canary），以区分被记忆的关联与临床泛化。我们在一个刻意对1,000条MIMIC-IV患者轨迹过拟合的GPT-2风格模型上检验了这些方法，从而构建了一个记忆现象应当易于检测的受控环境。该模型系统性地恢复了训练患者的金丝雀，随着上下文增加，其轨迹重建准确率接近完美。留出患者则未显示出系统性的金丝雀恢复，其轨迹重建仍然较低，且随着上下文增加仅略有提升。这些实验为在实际训练的模型中进一步评估这些方法建立了阳性对照基线。

title: When Can an AI Agent Serve as a Model of Human Psychopathology?
zh_title: AI智能体何时可作为人类精神病理的模型？
summary: 探讨在何种条件下对AI智能体的实验可为人类精神病理过程提供证据，并将精神病学的证据标准转化为面向机器研究的准则。
key_points: 提出证据主张的三个组成部分
借鉴诊断手册、临床测验与动物模型标准
针对将语言模型描述为焦虑、抑郁等的趋势
reason: 精神健康LLM方向的概念性观点，上调但属观点类上限
abstract: Language models and AI agents are increasingly described in psychiatric terms, such as anxious, depressed, addicted or helpless. A recent study even proposed language models as experimental systems for psychiatry and as a platform for piloting psychological treatments. We ask when an experiment on an AI agent can provide evidence about a specified human psychiatric process. A claim to such evidence has three parts. Something changed in the agent, and the agent's history caused the change. Nothing other than a process shared with people explains that change. The change matches one theory of the human process and not that theory's rivals. Psychiatry and its neighbouring fields have an evidence standard for each part, from the diagnostic manuals' rule for induced states, from clinical test scores and from animal models. We translate each standard into a criterion that a machine study can meet. For a language model the most critical alternative to a shared process is extrapolation from its training text, which already contains descriptions of how people respond to trauma and how they answer questionnaires. We show how to probe that alternative. Further, we audited forty-three published studies that apply psychiatric terms to a machine or induce a comparable state in one. Most compared the machine with an identical copy that had not gone through the history that induced the state. None excluded extrapolation from training text. Three tested a psychiatric theory against its rivals, and none of the three tests was conclusive. Until better evidence exists, a treatment pilot on a language model is best read as the model's forecast of patient response, and not as an experiment on a model organism. Evidence for a model organism will come from states induced by what happens to the machine, from experiments on its internal workings, and from tests on which rival theories disagree.
zh_abstract: 语言模型和 AI 智能体越来越多地被用精神病学术语来描述，如焦虑、抑郁、成瘾或无助。最近一项研究甚至提出将语言模型作为精神病学的实验系统，以及试行心理治疗的平台。我们探讨：对 AI 智能体所做的实验在何种情况下能为特定的人类精神病理过程提供证据。这样的证据主张包含三个部分。其一，智能体发生了某种变化，且该变化由其经历所引起。其二，除与人类共有的某一过程外，没有其他因素能解释这种变化。其三，该变化与关于人类该过程的某一种理论相符，而与该理论的竞争理论不符。精神病学及其邻近领域对每一部分都有相应的证据标准，分别来自诊断手册中关于诱发状态的规则、临床测验得分和动物模型。我们将每一标准转化为机器研究可以满足的准则。对语言模型而言，共有过程的最关键替代解释是对其训练文本的外推，因为训练文本中已包含关于人们如何应对创伤以及如何回答问卷的描述。我们展示了如何检验这一替代解释。此外，我们审查了 43 项已发表的研究，这些研究将精神病学术语应用于机器，或在机器中诱发类似状态。大多数研究将机器与未经历诱发该状态之过程的相同副本进行比较。没有一项排除了对训练文本的外推。有三项针对竞争理论检验了某一精神病学理论，但这三项检验均无定论。在获得更好的证据之前，对语言模型进行的治疗试验最好被解读为模型对患者反应的预测，而不是在模型生物上的实验。支持模型生物的证据将来自由机器所经历之事诱发的状态、对其内部运作的实验，以及对竞争理论存在分歧之处的检验。

title: MedCoast: Semantic Abstraction of Reasoning Trajectories for Test-Time Biomedical Question Answering
zh_title: MedCoast：测试时生物医学问答推理轨迹的语义抽象
summary: 将采样的思维链轨迹聚类为抽象推理树，训练轻量过程奖励模型，用于测试时的生物医学问答推理搜索。
key_points: 离线递归聚类语义相近的推理步骤
由解题进展导出节点级监督
训练轻量PRM在推理时评估推理步骤
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，摘要未见充分结果
abstract: Biomedical question answering often requires multi-step reasoning under limited inference budgets. While test-time search methods such as Tree-of-Thought can improve reasoning performance, directly searching over free-form language is computationally expensive and highly redundant, as many reasoning trajectories contain semantically equivalent intermediate steps expressed in different surface forms. We introduce MedCoast, an offline-to-online reasoning framework that converts sampled chain-of-thought trajectories into a compact space for structured process supervision. Offline, we recursively cluster semantically similar reasoning steps under shared prefixes to construct an abstract reasoning tree that captures recurring clinical reasoning patterns. We then derive node-level supervision from progress toward correct solutions, and train a lightweight process reward model (PRM) to evaluate partial reasoning states. At inference time, the learned critic guides test-time exploration by prioritizing promising reasoning prefixes. Across seven biomedical QA benchmarks, MedCoast often improves over self-consistency under fixed inference budgets, with gains of up to 15 points. Despite using a reward model more than 50 times smaller, MedCoast achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art reward models in several settings, highlighting its potential for resource-constrained biomedical reasoning.

title: Simple Baselines for Fetal Brain Unsupervised Anomaly Detection
zh_title: 胎儿脑MRI无监督异常检测简单基线
summary: 提出基于体素级脑龄估计的FetalBUAD框架，在1317例内部胎儿脑MRI及外部基准上报告领先的异常检测与跨域泛化表现。
key_points: 联合预测全局脑龄、体素脑龄图与分割
利用不确定性感知脑龄差图定位异常
内部1317例并在外部基准验证
reason: 有外部基准验证的预印本方法，非前瞻
abstract: Unsupervised anomaly detection (UAD) offers a promising approach to fetal brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) analysis, where pathological data are scarce. Existing methods rely mainly on brain age prediction or image reconstruction, but are limited by noisy gestational age (GA) labels, lack of lesion localization, or poor cross-domain generalization. We propose FetalBUAD, a UAD framework based on voxel-level brain age estimation. A joint multi-task network predicts global brain age, voxel-level brain age maps, and brain segmentation to establish an internal biological brain age reference, reducing reliance on clinically recorded GA. Uncertainty-aware voxel-level brain age gap maps are then used for anomaly localization. Experiments on 1,317 internal fetal brain MRI volumes and an external benchmark demonstrate state-of-the-art anomaly detection performance and improved cross-domain generalization. FetalBUAD also generates anatomically interpretable maps that localize diverse fetal brain abnormalities. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/birthlab/FetalBUAD.

title: MedicalRSI: Medical Recursive Self-Improving Agents via Clinical Model-Harness Co-Evolution
zh_title: MedicalRSI：基于临床模型-框架协同进化的医学递归自改进智能体
summary: 提出MedicalRSI框架，通过临床模型-Harness协同进化，使医学LLM智能体同时改进自身与改进策略。
key_points: 针对部署后不再改进的医学智能体
同时改进智能体与其改进策略
摘要未提供具体评测结果
reason: 新颖智能体方法预印本，摘要无结果细节，读者偏好上调
abstract: Medical agents built on large language models (LLMs) have advanced rapidly, yet most stay fixed once deployed and do not keep using their experience to improve later attempts. As a result, the same kind of error can recur across patients. To address this, existing self-improvement methods update an agent's weights or its medical harness from its own experience, but their improving strategy stays fixed and never learns which changes actually help, which caps how much the agent can improve. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) instead improves both the agent and its improving strategy. However, achieving RSI for medical agents is challenging, because clinical workflows rarely come with a reference harness, and a change that fixes early errors may not fix the problems the agent meets later. We propose MedicalRSI, an RSI framework built on Clinical Model-Harness Co-Evolution, in which one model plays two roles. The Solver is the medical agent itself, and the Improver is its learnable improving strategy, which writes a medical harness from the agent's failures. Each harness is rewarded by its gain over acting without it, and both roles are trained together, so the Improver keeps adapting to the problems the Solver has not yet solved. On multiple benchmarks and LLM backbones, MedicalRSI outperforms existing context-level and weight-level self-improvement methods and transfers well to unseen workflows, new LLMs and new databases, a step toward medical agents that keep improving.
zh_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的医疗智能体发展迅速，但大多数在部署后即保持不变，不会持续利用自身经验改进后续尝试。因此，同一类错误可能在不同患者身上反复出现。针对这一问题，现有自我改进方法会根据智能体自身经验更新其权重或医疗框架（harness），但其改进策略是固定的，从不学习哪些改动真正有效，这限制了智能体的改进幅度。递归自我改进（RSI）则同时改进智能体及其改进策略。然而，实现医疗智能体的 RSI 具有挑战性，因为临床工作流程很少附带参考框架，而且修复早期错误的改动未必能解决智能体之后遇到的问题。我们提出 MedicalRSI，这是一个建立在临床模型-框架协同进化（Clinical Model-Harness Co-Evolution）之上的 RSI 框架，其中同一个模型扮演两种角色。求解器（Solver）即医疗智能体本身，改进器（Improver）是其可学习的改进策略，根据智能体的失败案例编写医疗框架。每个框架以其相对于不使用该框架时的增益作为奖励，两种角色联合训练，使改进器不断适应求解器尚未解决的问题。在多个基准和多种 LLM 骨干模型上，MedicalRSI 优于现有的上下文层面和权重层面的自我改进方法，并能很好地迁移到未见过的工作流程、新的 LLM 和新的数据库，朝着能够持续改进的医疗智能体迈出了一步。

title: A High-Compression Transformer VAE for Efficient and Controllable 3D Medical Image Generation with Diffusion Transformers
zh_title: 面向3D医学图像生成的高压缩Transformer VAE与扩散Transformer
summary: 提出高压缩Transformer VAE结合多模态扩散Transformer用于3D医学体数据生成，在BrainTumor-256K上训练，编解码256³体数据比同规模CNN快7.6倍。
key_points: 249M Transformer VAE，速度提升7.6倍
全体积输入下PSNR较CNN高0.749 dB
面向缺失区域补全与伪影校正等条件生成
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，有基线对比但证据有限
abstract: Many medical image processing tasks, such as completing missing regions or correcting acquisition artifacts, can be cast as volumetric generation conditioned on observations of the same patient. Diffusion Transformers offer scalable capacity and flexible conditioning for this setting, but they operate on a learned image representation that must preserve fine anatomical and pathological detail while keeping complete three-dimensional volumes tractable. We bring Transformer variational autoencoding and multimodal diffusion together to address this challenge. Trained on BrainTumor-256K, a 249M Transformer VAE encodes and decodes $256^3$ volumes 7.6x faster than a comparably sized CNN trained on the same collection. Their PSNR difference is near zero with training-sized crop inputs, but the Transformer leads by 0.749 dB with full-volume inputs and an unchanged scoring region. Increasing Transformer capacity to 499M improves PSNR across all four brain MRI evaluation sets while retaining 3.8x lower encoding-decoding latency than the CNN. Fast encoding also allows conditions to be constructed dynamically in image space during latent diffusion training. Within the compressed representation, a shared Diffusion Transformer integrates text and spatial references for volumetric synthesis, completion and restoration. The brain-trained autoencoder further transfers to non-brain MRI and CT without target-domain fine-tuning, extending its use beyond the anatomy and modality on which it was learned. The framework provides a reusable representation and conditioning interface for efficient, controllable medical image generation. Code is available at https://github.com/OncoMMAI/brainmri-vit-vae3d.
zh_abstract: 许多医学图像处理任务，例如补全缺失区域或校正采集伪影，都可以视为以同一患者的观测为条件的三维体数据生成。扩散Transformer（Diffusion Transformer）在这一场景下具有可扩展的容量和灵活的条件输入方式，但它们作用于一种学习得到的图像表示，该表示既要保留精细的解剖和病理细节，又要使完整三维体数据的处理保持可行。我们将Transformer变分自编码与多模态扩散结合起来应对这一挑战。在BrainTumor-256K上训练的2.49亿参数Transformer VAE，对$256^3$体数据进行编码和解码的速度，比在同一数据集上训练的、规模相当的CNN快7.6倍。在训练尺寸的裁剪块输入下，二者的PSNR差异接近于零；但在全体数据输入且评分区域不变时，Transformer领先0.749 dB。将Transformer容量增至4.99亿参数后，在全部四个脑MRI评估集上PSNR均有提升，同时编码-解码延迟仍比CNN低3.8倍。快速编码还使得在潜在扩散训练过程中可以在图像空间中动态构建条件。在压缩表示内，一个共享的扩散Transformer整合文本与空间参考，用于体数据的合成、补全和修复。该以脑部数据训练的自编码器还能在不做目标域微调的情况下迁移到非脑部MRI和CT，使其用途扩展到其学习所用解剖部位和模态之外。该框架为高效、可控的医学图像生成提供了可复用的表示和条件接口。代码见 https://github.com/OncoMMAI/brainmri-vit-vae3d。

title: Surface Cues Over Structure: Probing LLM Behavior on Brain Connectivity Graphs

abstract: Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) provides a noninvasive view of functional interactions across the brain, which can be represented as connectivity graphs for neurological disease analysis. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being paired with such representations, yet it remains unclear whether they genuinely reason over the underlying connectivity or simply respond to surface-level cues that may trigger learned priors. We probe this question through a controlled study of Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) diagnosis from resting-state functional connectivity, isolating one factor at a time to determine what drives an LLM's predictions on brain connectivity graphs. Across six models, from small open-weight LLMs to a proprietary one, the same pattern holds: the results provide little evidence that predictions are consistently grounded in subject-specific connectivity. Brain region names, numeric formatting, and prompt framing shift what a model predicts without improving how well it separates ADHD subjects from Controls; perturbing the graph changes predictions no more for clinically meaningful regions than for random ones; and the models' own justifications contradict the values they cite, inconsistently interpreting the connectivity evidence provided to them. Across every probe, predictions follow the model's built-in class bias and the surface form of the prompt rather than the subject's connectivity, calling into question a premise underlying current LLM brain integration work. Our code is available at https://github.com/Roy025/ADHD-code.
zh_abstract: 静息态功能磁共振成像（rs-fMRI）为观察全脑功能交互提供了一种无创视角，这些交互可表示为连接图，用于神经系统疾病分析。大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地与此类表示结合使用，但目前尚不清楚它们是真正基于底层连接进行推理，还是仅仅对可能触发已习得先验的表层线索作出反应。我们通过一项受控研究来探讨这一问题，该研究基于静息态功能连接对注意缺陷/多动障碍（ADHD）进行诊断，每次分离一个因素，以确定是什么驱动了 LLM 对脑连接图的预测。在从小型开源权重 LLM 到一个专有模型的六个模型中，呈现出相同的模式：结果几乎没有证据表明预测始终以受试者特异的连接为依据。脑区名称、数值格式和提示框架会改变模型的预测，却不会提高其区分 ADHD 受试者与对照的能力；对连接图施加扰动，对具有临床意义的脑区所引起的预测变化并不比对随机脑区更大；并且模型自身给出的理由与其引用的数值相矛盾，对所提供的连接证据的解读前后不一致。在每一项探测中，预测都遵循模型内置的类别偏倚和提示的表面形式，而不是受试者的连接，这对当前 LLM 与脑整合工作所依据的一个前提提出了质疑。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/Roy025/ADHD-code 获取。

abstract: [Academic medicine : journal of the Association of American Medical Colleges] The rapid adoption of large language models (LLMs) by medical students has created two significant concerns: that students will use artificial intelligence (AI) for quick answers, short-circuiting the cognitive effort essential for deep learning, and that the satisfaction of discovery will be lost to algorithmic efficiency. This Scholarly Perspective reframes LLMs not as information retrieval systems, but as "Socratic Mirrors": interactive tutors grounded in established learning science (such as the desirable level of difficulty, social constructivism and zone of proximal development, the illusion of explanatory depth, and dual coding theory) that can restore the productive struggle that traditional LLMs often constrain. Drawing on the three functions of education framework, the authors argue that by handling qualification (the foundational work of content mastery), Socratic tutors free faculty to focus on what AI cannot provide: socialization (initiation into the norms and values of the profession) and subjectification (the formation of physicians as autonomous, ethical, and reflective practitioners). This potential is not merely theoretical. Empirical evidence from randomized controlled trials suggests that pedagogically engineered AI tutors, those designed to scaffold discovery rather than deliver answers, can significantly outperform traditional instruction. The studies demonstrate how LLMs configured as Socratic tutors can address the "2-Sigma" problem, offering personalized one-on-one tutoring at scale and moving medical education closer to the ideal of precision education. However, these studies are drawn from outside medical education, and the inferential leap to medical training, while theoretically grounded, remains empirically undemonstrated. The PICRAT (passive, interactive, creative, replacement, amplification, transformation) model is presented as a technology integration framework to ensure intentional rather than reactive AI integration. Together, these principles suggest a promising pathway toward scalable precision medical education that warrants formal evaluation in medical education contexts.
zh_abstract: [Academic medicine : journal of the Association of American Medical Colleges] 医学生对大语言模型（LLMs）的迅速采用引发了两方面的重大担忧：学生可能使用人工智能（AI）快速获取答案，从而绕过深度学习所必需的认知努力；以及发现的满足感将因算法效率而丧失。这篇学术观点文章将 LLMs 重新定位为“苏格拉底之镜”（Socratic Mirrors），而非信息检索系统：这是一种以既有学习科学（如适度困难、社会建构主义与最近发展区、解释深度错觉以及双重编码理论）为基础的交互式导师，能够恢复传统 LLMs 常常限制的“有成效的挣扎”。作者借鉴教育三功能框架，提出：通过承担资格化（qualification，即内容掌握的基础性工作），苏格拉底式导师可使教师专注于 AI 无法提供的部分：社会化（socialization，即引入职业规范与价值观）和主体化（subjectification，即将医生塑造为自主、有伦理且具反思能力的从业者）。这一潜力并非仅停留在理论层面。随机对照试验的实证证据表明，经教学工程设计的 AI 导师（即旨在搭建发现过程的支架而非直接给出答案者）可显著优于传统教学。这些研究展示了配置为苏格拉底式导师的 LLMs 如何应对“2-Sigma”问题，大规模提供个性化的一对一辅导，并使医学教育更接近精准教育的理想。然而，这些研究均来自医学教育之外，向医学培训的推论虽有理论依据，但在实证上仍未得到证明。文中提出 PICRAT（被动、互动、创造、替代、增强、转化）模型作为技术整合框架，以确保有意图而非被动反应式地整合 AI。综上，这些原则提示了一条通往可扩展精准医学教育的有前景路径，值得在医学教育情境中进行正式评估。

title: From detection to clinical comprehension: a cognitive hierarchy for the epistemic and ethical limits of artificial intelligence in radiology.
zh_title: 从检测到临床理解：放射学AI认知层级与伦理限度

abstract: [La Radiologia medica] Artificial intelligence (AI) detects findings in medical images at a level that, for specific tasks, matches or exceeds that of an expert radiologist. Detecting a finding, however, is not the same as understanding a disease. AI radiology literature rarely distinguishes between these two processes. This article proposes a four-level cognitive hierarchy, inspired by Ackoff's [1] model of data, information, knowledge, and wisdom, to analyze at which level current AI operates and its epistemic and ethical consequences. The four levels, detection, classification, diagnosis, and clinical comprehension, form a gradient of increasing cognitive demand. The last of these corresponds to the tacit knowledge described by Polanyi [2] and is consistent with classic studies of radiological perception. Recent literature on epistemic authority in medicine suggests that the gap between this level and AI reflects, at least in part, a difference in the type of justification underpinning clinical judgment. AI reliably automates the first two levels, makes partial progress on the third when structured clinical data are available, and currently lacks an operational counterpart for the fourth. This distinction has implications for the training of specialists and for clinical responsibility, which remains with the radiologist in AI-assisted diagnosis.
zh_abstract: [La Radiologia medica] 在特定任务上，人工智能（AI）检测医学影像中征象的水平已与放射科专家相当甚至更高。然而，检测到某一征象并不等同于理解一种疾病。AI 放射学文献很少区分这两种过程。本文受 Ackoff [1] 的数据、信息、知识和智慧模型启发，提出一个四层认知层级，用以分析当前 AI 处于哪一层级及其认识论和伦理后果。这四个层级——检测、分类、诊断和临床理解——构成认知要求逐级递增的梯度。其中最后一级对应 Polanyi [2] 所描述的默会知识，并与放射学感知的经典研究相一致。近期关于医学认识论权威的文献表明，这一层级与 AI 之间的差距，至少部分反映了支撑临床判断的论证类型的差异。AI 能够可靠地实现前两个层级的自动化；在有结构化临床数据时，在第三层级取得部分进展；而对第四层级目前尚无可操作的对应物。这一区分对专科医师的培养以及临床责任具有重要意义，在 AI 辅助诊断中，临床责任仍由放射科医师承担。

abstract: [Facial plastic surgery & aesthetic medicine] Rhinoplasty requires individualized decisions that balance nasal appearance, airway function, structural support, and patient expectations. This narrative review examines artificial intelligence (AI) applications across the data modalities encountered in rhinoplasty care, emphasizing their potential roles in assessment, counseling, surgical planning, and outcome evaluation. Relevant modalities include clinical text, structured clinical data, facial photographs, anatomical imaging and three-dimensional surface geometry, and specialized measurements of surgical technique, nasal function, and visual perception. Clinical applications include patient counseling, organization of clinical records, risk and outcome prediction, quantitative nasal assessment, visualization of proposed changes, and postoperative evaluation. Multimodal and agentic systems may integrate these sources and tasks. Limitations include measurement errors, uncertain prediction of surgical outcomes, and limited evidence of improved clinical decisions or patient outcomes. Matching clinical questions to available data provides a practical framework for AI research and application in rhinoplasty. Standardized acquisition, secure linkage of longitudinal records, and independent validation are needed to support reproducible assessment and outcomes research. Surgeon oversight remains essential, with clinical value judged by functional and aesthetic outcomes and alignment with patient goals.
zh_abstract: [面部整形外科与美容医学] 鼻整形术需要在鼻部外观、气道功能、结构支撑和患者期望之间进行权衡，做出个体化决策。本叙述性综述考察了人工智能（AI）在鼻整形护理中所涉及各类数据模态上的应用，重点阐述其在评估、咨询、手术规划和结果评价中的潜在作用。相关模态包括临床文本、结构化临床数据、面部照片、解剖影像与三维表面几何形态，以及针对手术技术、鼻功能和视觉感知的专项测量。临床应用包括患者咨询、临床记录的整理、风险与结果预测、鼻部定量评估、拟行改变的可视化以及术后评价。多模态系统和智能体（agentic）系统可能整合这些数据来源和任务。其局限性包括测量误差、手术结果预测的不确定性，以及改善临床决策或患者结局的证据有限。将临床问题与可用数据相匹配，为鼻整形领域的AI研究与应用提供了一个实用框架。需要标准化的数据采集、纵向记录的安全关联和独立验证，以支持可重复的评估和结局研究。外科医生的监督仍然不可或缺，临床价值应以功能和美学结局以及是否符合患者目标来评判。

abstract: [European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society] Accurate scoliosis screening is essential for early intervention and to minimize unnecessary exposure to radiographic imaging. This study presents a landmark-based approach using Geometric Morphometric Methods combined with Elastic Net regression for the automated, non-invasive detection of adolescent idiopathic scoliosis from 3D torso surface scans. A retrospective cross-sectional study was performed on 168 individuals (135 with adolescent idiopathic scoliosis and 33 controls) using automatic landmark extraction on surface meshes from previous studies. After dimensionality reduction via principal component analysis, the resulting shape variables were used to train a logistic regression model with regularization. The main outcome measures were Area Under the Curve, sensitivity, specificity and balanced accuracy to estimate the performance metrics of the Artificial Intelligence screening model. The model showed high discriminative ability on an unseen test dataset (Area Under the Curve = 0.926; 95% CI: 0.816-1.000). When a classification threshold derived exclusively from the training set was applied to the test set, sensitivity was 100%, specificity was 14.3%, and balanced accuracy was 57.1%. In contrast to deep learning models, this approach offers an interpretable framework based on anatomical landmarks and does not require large datasets or extensive computational resources. The findings support further investigation of surface trunk morphology as a source of discriminative information for AIS detection. External validation in larger and more representative populations is required before clinical screening application.
zh_abstract: [欧洲脊柱杂志：欧洲脊柱学会、欧洲脊柱畸形学会和欧洲颈椎研究学会欧洲分会官方出版物] 准确的脊柱侧凸筛查对于早期干预以及尽量减少不必要的影像学辐射暴露至关重要。本研究提出一种基于解剖标志点的方法，将几何形态测量方法（Geometric Morphometric Methods）与弹性网络（Elastic Net）回归相结合，用于基于三维躯干表面扫描对青少年特发性脊柱侧凸进行自动化、无创检测。本回顾性横断面研究纳入168名个体（135名青少年特发性脊柱侧凸患者和33名对照），利用既往研究的表面网格自动提取标志点。经主成分分析降维后，将所得形态变量用于训练带正则化的逻辑回归模型。主要结局指标为曲线下面积（AUC）、敏感度、特异度和平衡准确率，用以评估该人工智能筛查模型的性能指标。该模型在未见过的测试数据集上表现出较高的判别能力（AUC = 0.926；95% CI：0.816-1.000）。当将仅由训练集得出的分类阈值应用于测试集时，敏感度为100%，特异度为14.3%，平衡准确率为57.1%。与深度学习模型相比，该方法提供了基于解剖标志点的可解释框架，且不需要大型数据集或大量计算资源。研究结果支持进一步探究躯干表面形态作为青少年特发性脊柱侧凸检测判别信息来源的价值。在应用于临床筛查之前，需要在更大、更具代表性的人群中进行外部验证。
