title: Wearable automated cough detection in horses with chronic cough: model development, validation, and exploratory associations in asthma.
source: PubMed · Journal of veterinary internal medicine
zh_title: 慢性咳嗽马的可穿戴自动咳嗽检测：模型开发与验证
summary: 为马开发可穿戴录音设备并训练机器学习咳嗽检测模型，纳入70匹马，探索其与哮喘的关联。
key_points: 前瞻性观察研究，70匹马
单一观察者标注咳嗽
探索咳嗽模式与哮喘相关性
reason: 兽医领域，小样本单标注者，属增量档
abstract: [Journal of veterinary internal medicine] Coughing is a nonspecific respiratory sign that is common in horses with asthma. Cough quantification is currently subjective and labor-intensive, leaving its diagnostic and monitoring potential underexplored. (1) Develop a wearable audio recorder for horses; (2) collect recordings of coughing horses and annotate coughs; (3) train a machine learning model to automate cough detection; and (4) describe temporal patterns of coughing and determine pathophysiologic correlations in horses with asthma. Seventy horses were recruited from a teaching herd, clinical cases, and via social media. Sixty had coughing for ≥3 weeks and valid recordings. In our prospective observational and analytical study, coughs were recorded using a digital device, annotated by a single observer, and used to develop a machine-learning-based cough-detection pipeline. Machine learning output was analyzed using generalized linear mixed models to determine circadian patterns and pathophysiologic associations of coughing. We annotated 252 of 1260 recorded hours. We labeled 8555 sound events, 2780 of which were coughs of the instrumented horse. Our machine learning model detected coughs with a sensitivity of 0.95 and a specificity of 0.9993. In horses with asthma, coughing frequency was associated with neutrophilic lung inflammation and showed a diurnal pattern with peak rates around 3 am. The combination of robust hardware for long-term recordings and high-performance machine learning algorithms has the potential to transform coughing from a relatively crude clinical sign to a quantifiable endpoint in research and clinical practice.
zh_abstract: [Journal of veterinary internal medicine] 咳嗽是一种非特异性呼吸道症状，在患哮喘的马中很常见。目前咳嗽的量化是主观且费力的，其诊断和监测潜力尚未得到充分探索。研究目的：(1) 开发一种用于马的可穿戴音频记录仪；(2) 收集咳嗽马的录音并标注咳嗽；(3) 训练机器学习模型以实现咳嗽自动检测；(4) 描述咳嗽的时间模式，并确定患哮喘马中咳嗽与病理生理的相关性。从教学马群、临床病例及社交媒体招募了70匹马，其中60匹咳嗽持续≥3周且有有效录音。在我们的前瞻性观察性和分析性研究中，使用数字设备记录咳嗽，由单一观察者标注，并用于开发基于机器学习的咳嗽检测流程。采用广义线性混合模型分析机器学习输出，以确定咳嗽的昼夜节律模式和病理生理关联。我们在1260小时录音中标注了252小时，标记了8555个声音事件，其中2780个为佩戴设备的马的咳嗽。我们的机器学习模型检测咳嗽的敏感性为0.95，特异性为0.9993。在患哮喘的马中，咳嗽频率与中性粒细胞性肺部炎症相关，并呈现昼夜模式，峰值出现在凌晨3点左右。适用于长期录音的稳健硬件与高性能机器学习算法相结合，有可能使咳嗽从一种相对粗略的临床体征转变为研究和临床实践中可量化的终点指标。

title: Lung cancer multi-subtype classification via soft-voting ensemble architecture.
zh_title: 基于软投票集成的肺癌多亚型分类
summary: 用EfficientNet-B3、ConvNeXt-Tiny与DenseNet-121软投票集成，在含18,500张CT-PET图像的公开数据集上报告准确率0.9865。
key_points: 三个骨干网络独立优化并平均概率输出
公开数据集共18,500张CT-PET图像
准确率与F1均为0.9865
reason: 常规集成方法，公开数据集内部评估，无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: [Network (Bristol, England)] Lung cancer is a highly heterogeneous malignant tumour, and accurate classification of its subtypes is relevant to personalized treatment planning. However, overlapping imaging appearances and severe class imbalance make multi-subtype classification challenging. To address this problem, we propose a soft-voting ensemble of EfficientNet-B3, ConvNeXt-Tiny, and DenseNet-121. The three independently optimized backbones were selected for their complementary architectural characteristics and the framework does not explicitly disentangle or fuse their feature representations. Instead, it averages their class-probability outputs at inference. Experiments on a public dataset containing 18,500 CT-PET images show that the ensemble achieves an accuracy of 0.9865 and an F1 score of 0.9865. The class-wise recalls for adenocarcinoma, large cell carcinoma, small cell carcinoma, and squamous cell carcinoma are 99.55%, 100.00%, 96.17%, and 98.20%, respectively. These retrospective image-level results support further investigation of the framework as a potential radiologist-assistance tool.
zh_abstract: [Network (Bristol, England)] 肺癌是一种高度异质性的恶性肿瘤，其亚型的准确分类与个体化治疗方案的制定相关。然而，影像学表现重叠以及严重的类别不平衡使得多亚型分类具有挑战性。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种由 EfficientNet-B3、ConvNeXt-Tiny 和 DenseNet-121 组成的软投票集成模型。这三个独立优化的骨干网络因其互补的架构特点而被选用，该框架并不显式地解耦或融合它们的特征表示，而是在推理时对其类别概率输出取平均。在一个包含 18,500 幅 CT-PET 图像的公开数据集上的实验显示，该集成模型的准确率为 0.9865，F1 分数为 0.9865。腺癌、大细胞癌、小细胞癌和鳞状细胞癌的各类别召回率分别为 99.55%、100.00%、96.17% 和 98.20%。这些回顾性的图像层面结果支持将该框架作为潜在的放射科医师辅助工具进行进一步研究。

title: CrownFusion: 3D Dental Crown Generation Using Geometry Images and Latent Diffusion
zh_title: CrownFusion：基于几何图像与潜在扩散的3D牙冠生成
summary: 提出以几何图像表示牙冠、用潜在扩散模型生成3D牙冠设计，并以咬合贴合度指标评估，含定量与定性研究。
key_points: 用CrownImage二维网格编码表面坐标
以周围牙列嵌入为条件生成多样牙冠
提出基于对颌牙接近度的咬合贴合指标
reason: 新颖生成方法，但证据有限、偏牙科设计
abstract: We introduce CrownFusion, a latent diffusion model to generate 3D dental crown designs from geometry images, a 2D-grid encoding of surface coordinates. Departing from traditional approaches that use point clouds, our "CrownImage" representation not only unlocks the full power of image-based generative architectures, but also preserves fine geometric detail by operating at far higher spatial resolutions than point clouds to alleviate smoothing artifacts in the 3D generation. Conditioned on jointly learned embeddings of the surrounding dentition, our probabilistic diffusion model produces anatomically plausible crowns with morphological variations tailored to individual patient cases. To accommodate multiple valid designs, we propose an occlusal fit metric based on proximity to the antagonist teeth. We evaluate our method through quantitative experiments and qualitative studies involving expert testimonials. We also release the FDI 16 Crown Dataset, comprising 11,513 annotated intra-oral scans, to support future research in dental CAD.

title: Do Waste Classifiers Recognise Items They Have Never Seen? Object-Disjoint Evaluation on Household and Medical Waste
zh_title: 废弃物分类器能识别未见物品吗？家庭与医疗废物的物品互斥评估
summary: 构建含172种物品、4160张图像、23类的孟加拉家庭与医疗废物数据集，采用物品互斥交叉验证评估13个模型；最佳预训练模型宏F1为98.8%。
key_points: BanglaWaste-23数据集，每张图标注物理物品
物品互斥划分下6个模型统计持平
随机划分高估了从零训练模型的表现
reason: 小规模数据集，医疗关联较弱，预印本，增量档
abstract: Automatic waste classification supports source separation, which enables recycling and keeps hazardous medical items out of household waste. Waste classification studies often report near-perfect accuracy on random image splits, which put photographs of one item in both training and test sets. To measure how well classifiers recognise items they have never seen, we built BanglaWaste-23, with 4,160 images of 172 objects in 23 household and medical waste classes from Bangladesh. Every image also records which physical item it shows. We evaluated 11 ImageNet-pretrained models and two models trained from scratch (a compact custom network and MobileNetV3-L) using object-disjoint five-fold cross-validation and a random split. On unseen objects, the best pretrained model reached a macro-averaged F1 score of 98.8%, and six models were statistically tied. The random split overstated from-scratch accuracy by 15 to 19 percentage points. The from-scratch models also missed 11 to 13% of medical items, against under 1% for pretrained models. On a second dataset from Dhaka, pretrained accuracy fell by 15 to 22 points. Classifiers should therefore be evaluated on unseen objects, with random-split results read as an upper bound. The data are on Zenodo and the code at https://github.com/saadbaust/BanglaWaste-23.
zh_abstract: 自动废弃物分类有助于源头分类，从而促进回收利用，并避免将危险的医疗物品混入生活垃圾。废弃物分类研究常常在随机划分的图像数据上报告近乎完美的准确率，而这种划分会使同一物品的照片同时出现在训练集和测试集中。为衡量分类器识别从未见过的物品的能力，我们构建了 BanglaWaste-23，其中包含来自孟加拉国的 23 类家庭和医疗废弃物、共 172 个物体的 4,160 张图像。每张图像还记录了其所拍摄的具体实物。我们评估了 11 个 ImageNet 预训练模型和两个从头训练的模型（一个紧凑的自定义网络和 MobileNetV3-L），采用按物体互不相交的五折交叉验证和随机划分两种方式。在未见过的物体上，最佳预训练模型的宏平均 F1 分数达到 98.8%，且有六个模型在统计上无显著差异。随机划分使从头训练模型的准确率被高估了 15 至 19 个百分点。从头训练的模型还漏检了 11% 至 13% 的医疗物品，而预训练模型不足 1%。在来自达卡的第二个数据集上，预训练模型的准确率下降了 15 至 22 个百分点。因此，分类器应在未见过的物体上进行评估，随机划分的结果应被视为上限。数据发布于 Zenodo，代码见 https://github.com/saadbaust/BanglaWaste-23。

title: Leakage-Safe Auditing of Attribution-Driven Data Curation in Medical Imaging
zh_title: 医学影像归因驱动数据整理的防泄漏审计
summary: 预印本以患者互斥、保留标识符的方式审计CTA动脉瘤3D卷积分类器，发现232个全零数组，并推翻了此前基于位置拼接的注意力失效亚组结论。
key_points: 1201个阳性补丁中发现232个全零数组，含170个训练阳性
历史321补丁注意力失效亚组因按位置拼接而无效
GradCAM++与积分梯度在阳性样本上呈负秩相关
reason: 单任务审计、预印本，方法学价值有限，属增量档
abstract: When can an attribution-derived anomaly justify changing a medical-imaging training set? We formulate attribution-driven curation as three separately testable claims: anomaly detection, harmfulness estimation, and intervention utility. We test the first and third using a patient-disjoint, identifier-preserving audit of a 3D convolutional classifier for computed tomography angiography aneurysm candidates. We identify 232 exactly zero-valued arrays among 1,201 positive patches, including 170 training positives, and invalidate a historical 321-patch attention-failure subgroup whose identifier-free records were joined to files by position. On the held-out test set, GradCAM++ spatial concentration is central for every candidate class, reversing the historical pattern. GradCAM++ and Integrated Gradients show negative rank-order agreement for positives, limiting method-independent anatomical interpretation. Across five paired training seeds, removing the 170 corrupted training positives yields AUC 0.9617 +/- 0.0044 versus 0.9652 +/- 0.0039 for full-data training (difference -0.0035; 95% CI -0.0082 to 0.0007). Excluding 34 raw-zero test positives widens rather than closes the gap, countering a blank-memorization explanation. Budget-matched random-removal controls suggest the result is not simply an effect of reducing training size. Input corruption does not necessarily imply that deletion improves generalization. Our framework makes leakage control, sample identity, and intervention testing explicit in attribution-driven medical-imaging data curation.
zh_abstract: 基于归因得到的异常在何种情况下可以作为修改医学影像训练集的依据？我们将归因驱动的数据整理表述为三个可分别检验的主张：异常检测、危害性估计和干预效用。我们通过对计算机断层扫描血管造影动脉瘤候选病灶的三维卷积分类器进行患者互不重叠、保留标识符的审计，检验了第一项和第三项主张。我们在1,201个阳性图像块中发现232个数值完全为零的数组，其中包括170个训练阳性样本，并使一个历史上的321个图像块的注意力失效亚组失效，该亚组的无标识符记录是按位置与文件对应的。在留出的测试集上，GradCAM++的空间集中度对每个候选类别均位于中心，与历史模式相反。GradCAM++与Integrated Gradients对阳性样本的秩次一致性为负，限制了与方法无关的解剖学解释。在五个配对训练随机种子中，剔除170个受损训练阳性样本后AUC为0.9617 ± 0.0044，而全量数据训练为0.9652 ± 0.0039（差值 -0.0035；95% CI -0.0082至0.0007）。排除34个原始值为零的测试阳性样本后，差距反而扩大而非缩小，这与空白图像记忆化的解释相悖。预算匹配的随机剔除对照提示，该结果并非单纯由训练集规模减小所致。输入损坏并不必然意味着删除可改善泛化。我们的框架使归因驱动的医学影像数据整理中的泄漏控制、样本身份和干预检验得以明确化。

title: When Should We Trust Medical Image Models? Evaluating Confidence Reliability under Cross-Dataset Shift
zh_title: 医学影像模型何时可信？跨数据集偏移下的置信度可靠性评估
summary: 在CheXpert训练、MIMIC-CXR测试，评估ResNet-50与DenseNet-121在跨数据集偏移下的置信度校准可靠性。
key_points: 聚焦气胸与胸腔积液两个任务
指标含AUC、ECE、Brier及错误预测置信度
评估事后温度缩放的作用
reason: 受控实证研究但模型较常规，属增量到值得一看之间
abstract: Deep learning models for chest X-ray analysis often achieve strong performance on benchmark datasets, but their reliability under cross-dataset deployment remains unclear. In clinical practice, models trained in one hospital system may be applied to data from another, where distributional and labeling differences can affect both prediction accuracy and model confidence. We conduct a controlled empirical study of model confidence under cross-dataset transfer. We train ResNet-50 and DenseNet-121 on CheXpert and evaluate them on MIMIC-CXR across five experimental settings, focusing on Pneumothorax and Pleural Effusion. We measure predictive performance using AUC and confidence reliability using Expected Calibration Error (ECE), Brier score, and average confidence on incorrect predictions, all reported with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. We further evaluate post-hoc temperature scaling fit on the source validation set and use Grad-CAM to examine the mechanism behind cross-domain performance differences. Cross-domain AUC drops 7-13 percentage points, and the best in-domain model is not the best cross-domain model. Source-domain temperature scaling produces marginal ECE changes but systematically increases confidence on incorrect predictions across all four model-pathology combinations. Grad-CAM reveals that DenseNet relies on a concentrated spatial prior that fails to transfer, while ResNet's more distributed attention generalizes better. These findings argue for cross-site validation and safety-specific calibration metrics in medical AI evaluation.
zh_abstract: 用于胸部 X 线分析的深度学习模型常在基准数据集上取得很好的性能，但其在跨数据集部署下的可靠性仍不明确。在临床实践中，在一家医院系统训练的模型可能被应用于另一家的数据，而分布和标注上的差异可能同时影响预测准确性和模型置信度。我们开展了一项关于跨数据集迁移下模型置信度的对照实证研究。我们在 CheXpert 上训练 ResNet-50 和 DenseNet-121，并在五种实验设置下于 MIMIC-CXR 上进行评估，重点关注气胸和胸腔积液。我们用 AUC 衡量预测性能，用期望校准误差（ECE）、Brier 评分以及错误预测上的平均置信度衡量置信度可靠性，均报告 95% bootstrap 置信区间。我们还评估了在源域验证集上拟合的事后温度缩放，并使用 Grad-CAM 考察跨域性能差异背后的机制。跨域 AUC 下降 7–13 个百分点，且域内最佳模型并非跨域最佳模型。源域温度缩放使 ECE 仅有微小变化，但在全部四种模型-病理组合中系统性地提高了错误预测上的置信度。Grad-CAM 显示，DenseNet 依赖于无法迁移的集中空间先验，而 ResNet 更分散的注意力泛化更好。这些发现支持在医学 AI 评估中采用跨机构验证和针对安全性的校准指标。

title: SalivaryHSI-Seg: A New Challenging Benchmark for Ex Vivo Salivary Gland Hyperspectral Tissue Segmentation
zh_title: SalivaryHSI-Seg：离体涎腺高光谱组织分割基准
summary: 提出含31例患者119个离体涎腺高光谱样本、带像素级多类标注的分割基准，并建立患者级五折评估。
key_points: 119个HSI样本，来自31例患者
多类像素级标注
患者级五折统一评估协议
reason: 小规模新基准，单来源离体样本，预印本，属增量档
abstract: Salivary gland tumors are common lesions in oral and maxillofacial practice, and accurate identification of tumor regions and surrounding salivary gland tissues is important for tissue assessment, pathological sampling, and clinical decision support. Hyperspectral imaging (HSI) records continuous spectral responses together with spatial imaging information, providing a promising way to capture fine-grained tissue-discriminative information. Nevertheless, the development of salivary gland HSI tissue segmentation remains limited due to the lack of standardized benchmarks with pixel-level annotations and unified evaluation protocols. To address this issue, we introduce SalivaryHSI-Seg, a hyperspectral tissue segmentation benchmark for ex vivo salivary gland specimens, containing 119 HSI samples from 31 patients with multi-class pixel-level annotations. We establish a patient-level five-fold cross-validation protocol and evaluate different input representations, model architectures, and challenging subsets with small tumor and complex boundary. Based on this benchmark, we further propose HyBSD, a hyperspectral boundary-guided spectral-difference network for full-HSI salivary gland tissue segmentation. HyBSD exploits boundary-guided spectral-difference cues to improve tissue delineation in ambiguous transition regions. Extensive experiments show that full-HSI input provides more discriminative information than sampled spectrums, and that HyBSD achieves 74.97% mDice and 87.76% Tumor Dice, with further advantages on the challenging subsets. Dataset and code will be released.
zh_abstract: 涎腺肿瘤是口腔颌面外科实践中的常见病变，准确识别肿瘤区域及周围涎腺组织对于组织评估、病理取样和临床决策支持具有重要意义。高光谱成像（HSI）可同时记录连续光谱响应和空间成像信息，为获取细粒度的组织判别信息提供了一种有前景的途径。然而，由于缺乏带有像素级标注的标准化基准和统一的评估方案，涎腺HSI组织分割的发展仍然受限。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SalivaryHSI-Seg，这是一个面向离体涎腺标本的高光谱组织分割基准，包含来自31例患者的119个HSI样本，并带有多类别像素级标注。我们建立了患者层面的五折交叉验证方案，并评估了不同的输入表示、模型架构，以及包含小肿瘤和复杂边界的挑战性子集。基于该基准，我们进一步提出了HyBSD，一种用于全HSI涎腺组织分割的高光谱边界引导光谱差异网络。HyBSD利用边界引导的光谱差异线索，改善模糊过渡区域的组织勾画。大量实验表明，全HSI输入比采样光谱提供更具判别力的信息，并且HyBSD取得了74.97%的mDice和87.76%的肿瘤Dice（Tumor Dice），在挑战性子集上优势更为明显。数据集和代码将予以公开。

title: Differential Proteomics to XAI Rules: A SHAP-FOL-ILP Modeling for Lung Adenocarcinoma
zh_title: 肺腺癌差异蛋白质组到可解释规则：SHAP-FOL-ILP建模
summary: 基于CPTAC-LUAD的213份组织样本，结合稀疏逻辑回归、SHAP与一阶逻辑规则学习构建可解释流程。
key_points: 111例患者，102对配对样本
患者分组嵌套交叉验证
SHAP引导的FOL/ILP规则学习
reason: 单队列内部验证，样本小，预印本，属增量档
abstract: Background: We developed an interpretable workflow linking paired differential proteomics, sparse logistic regression, SHAP attribution, and first-order logic (FOL) rule learning in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD). Methods: We analysed 213 CPTAC-LUAD tissue samples (111 tumour, 102 adjacent-normal) from 111 patients, including 102 matched pairs. Protein effect estimation and testing used the same complete pairs, with Benjamini-Hochberg correction. Sparse logistic regression used five-fold stratified patient-grouped nested cross-validation. Preprocessing and model selection were confined to training data, with feature selection repeated within inner folds. A separate five-fold patient-grouped evaluation tested SHAP-guided inductive logic programming (FOL/ILP) using training-derived evidence and discretisation. Results: Quality control retained 9,518 proteins. At FDR below 0.05 and an absolute mean paired log-ratio difference of at least 1, 378 were differentially abundant (40 increased, 338 decreased). The sparse classifier yielded ROC-AUC 0.9997, average precision 0.9998, accuracy 0.9906, and balanced accuracy 0.9906. FOL/ILP yielded held-out accuracy 0.9765, balanced accuracy 0.9767, precision 0.9818, recall 0.9730, and F1 0.9774. HSPA12B, PALM2-AKAP2, STARD13, and PPM1F had non-zero coefficients in all five classifier folds. The most frequent Horn clause occurred in two of five folds. All others occurred once. Conclusions: The workflow connects proteomic classification, attribution, and symbolic rules. Performance reflects tumour-versus-adjacent-normal discrimination within one cohort. Biomarker and clinical claims require independent validation, repeated assessment of rule stability, and further biological annotation.
zh_abstract: 【背景】我们在肺腺癌（LUAD）中开发了一种可解释的工作流程，将配对差异蛋白质组学、稀疏逻辑回归、SHAP归因和一阶逻辑（FOL）规则学习联系起来。【方法】我们分析了来自111例患者的213份CPTAC-LUAD组织样本（111份肿瘤，102份癌旁正常组织），其中包括102个匹配对。蛋白质效应估计和检验使用相同的完整配对，并采用Benjamini-Hochberg校正。稀疏逻辑回归采用五折分层、按患者分组的嵌套交叉验证。预处理和模型选择仅限于训练数据，特征选择在内层折中重复进行。另行采用五折按患者分组的评估，检验以SHAP引导的归纳逻辑编程（FOL/ILP），其使用源自训练集的证据和离散化。【结果】质量控制后保留9,518个蛋白。在FDR低于0.05且配对对数比均值差绝对值至少为1的条件下，有378个蛋白存在差异丰度（40个升高，338个降低）。稀疏分类器的ROC-AUC为0.9997，平均精确率为0.9998，准确率为0.9906，平衡准确率为0.9906。FOL/ILP的留出准确率为0.9765，平衡准确率为0.9767，精确率为0.9818，召回率为0.9730，F1为0.9774。HSPA12B、PALM2-AKAP2、STARD13和PPM1F在全部五个分类器折中均具有非零系数。最常出现的Horn子句在五折中出现了两次，其余均仅出现一次。【结论】该工作流程将蛋白质组分类、归因和符号规则联系起来。其性能反映的是单一队列内肿瘤与癌旁正常组织的区分。生物标志物和临床方面的结论需要独立验证、对规则稳定性的重复评估以及进一步的生物学注释。

title: Separating Genetic and Protein Evidence in Open Targets: An Auditable Re-ranking Study
zh_title: 分离Open Targets中的遗传与蛋白证据：可审计重排序研究
summary: 在阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病中，将遗传与蛋白证据分通道评分后晚期融合，以重排序靶点。
key_points: AD前20中遗传支持基因由7个增至15个
PD中去除5个症状性对照
遗传与蛋白证据分通道评分
reason: 靶点排序方法小改进，预印本，神经退行方向略加分
abstract: Biomedical target-ranking platforms combine genetics, literature, experimental evidence, tractability, and clinical precedent because each is useful for target discovery. A single integrated score, however, can be awkward to reuse for a narrower question such as which genes have direct evidence for disease risk or etiology. We examine this issue in Open Targets associations for Alzheimer disease (AD) and Parkinson disease (PD). Genetics-linked evidence and protein-oriented evidence are scored in separate channels and combined only at the end. In AD, the Open Targets overall top 20 contains 7 curated genetics-supported genes and 10 symptomatic pharmacology controls; the default late fusion contains 15 curated genes and no symptomatic controls. In PD, late fusion retains 13 curated genes and removes the 5 symptomatic controls present in the platform top 20. A genetics-only ranking reaches similar curated recall (14 genes in AD, 13 in PD), so most of the gain over the platform score comes from emphasizing genetic evidence; the protein channel mainly raises the number of tractable targets in the shortlist (from 9 to 12 in AD and from 8 to 10 in PD) without readmitting symptomatic controls. These results are stable across fusion weights from 0.35 to 0.75, perturbed protein-channel weights, and rule thresholds. An optional post-ranking rule further lowers high-clinical/low-genetic targets such as ACHE and GRIN1 without changing top-20 curated recall. The procedure is deterministic and uses public Open Targets fields. Because the component scores remain available, individual rank changes can be inspected and the ranking can be reproduced from the same data snapshot.
zh_abstract: 生物医学靶点排序平台整合遗传学、文献、实验证据、可成药性（tractability）和临床先例，因为每一类证据对靶点发现都有用。然而，单一的综合评分在回答更窄的问题时可能不便复用，例如哪些基因有疾病风险或病因方面的直接证据。我们以 Open Targets 中阿尔茨海默病（AD）和帕金森病（PD）的关联数据来考察这一问题。遗传学相关证据与蛋白质导向证据分别在独立通道中评分，仅在最后才合并。在 AD 中，Open Targets 总体前 20 位包含 7 个经人工整理的遗传学支持基因和 10 个对症药理学对照；默认的后期融合（late fusion）包含 15 个经整理的基因，且不含对症对照。在 PD 中，后期融合保留 13 个经整理的基因，并剔除了平台前 20 位中存在的 5 个对症对照。仅基于遗传学的排序可达到相近的经整理基因召回（AD 中 14 个基因，PD 中 13 个基因），因此相对于平台评分的大部分提升来自对遗传学证据的侧重；蛋白质通道主要增加候选清单中可成药靶点的数量（AD 中由 9 个增至 12 个，PD 中由 8 个增至 10 个），且不会重新纳入对症对照。这些结果在融合权重 0.35 至 0.75、扰动的蛋白质通道权重以及规则阈值范围内均保持稳定。一项可选的排序后规则可进一步降低 ACHE 和 GRIN1 等高临床证据/低遗传学证据靶点的排名，而不改变前 20 位的经整理基因召回。该流程是确定性的，使用公开的 Open Targets 字段。由于各组成评分均可获得，因此可以检查单个靶点的排名变化，并可基于同一数据快照复现该排序。

title: SignalCount: Approximate Counts with Structured and Semantic Predicates in Seconds
zh_title: SignalCount：秒级近似计数结构化与语义谓词查询
summary: 介绍生产系统SignalCount，可在查询时不调用oracle的情况下，对结构化与文本语义条件的记录进行近似COUNT。
key_points: 面向结构化列加文本的记录
查询时无需调用LLM oracle
以生产环境LLM judge为oracle
reason: 偏数据库系统工程，医疗场景仅为示例，证据有限
abstract: Many applications store records with structured columns and a text document, and ask how many records in a filtered set meet a criterion that only a reader of the text can judge, such as "How many patients with type 2 diabetes, aged 40 to 70, stopped metformin because their blood sugar stayed high?" An interactive application needs this count in seconds, as the user types the criterion, to decide whether the matching set is worth materializing with a batch pipeline in which an LLM judges the records. Prior approximate query processing over such semantic predicates has an expensive model, the oracle, label a sample at query time, so every query waits for the oracle. We present SignalCount, a production system that answers COUNT queries with structured and semantic predicates and calls no oracle at query time, even for ad-hoc criteria. Its oracle is the production LLM judge, and the judge's logged verdicts calibrate, offline, the fast classifier that already runs in front of the judge. At query time, SignalCount counts the filtered set exactly and draws a uniform sample of at most 1,000 records in one columnar scan, scores the sample with the classifier, and multiplies the average calibrated probability by the exact count. Its 90% interval combines a sampling term with one-sided, rate-dependent margins for calibration error, fitted by split conformal prediction across tenants. In a multi-tenant production deployment, latency has a p99 of 3.8 s and stays flat as the filtered set grows beyond the sample. On tenants held out from fitting, the interval covers the count that the production pipeline returns in 92% of estimates, although estimates run about 15% high in aggregate, because a calibration nearly unbiased per record is still biased per criterion.
zh_abstract: 许多应用会存储带有结构化列和文本文档的记录，并询问在经过筛选的集合中有多少条记录符合只有阅读文本才能判断的标准，例如“有多少 40 至 70 岁的 2 型糖尿病患者因血糖持续偏高而停用二甲双胍？”交互式应用需要在用户输入标准时于数秒内得到该计数，以决定是否值得通过由 LLM 判断记录的批处理流水线来具体化匹配集合。以往针对此类语义谓词的近似查询处理，需要在查询时由昂贵的模型（即 oracle）对样本进行标注，因此每次查询都要等待 oracle。我们提出 SignalCount，一个生产系统，可回答带有结构化谓词和语义谓词的 COUNT 查询，且在查询时不调用 oracle，即使对于临时（ad-hoc）标准也是如此。其 oracle 是生产环境中的 LLM 判断器，判断器记录的裁决用于离线校准已运行在判断器之前的快速分类器。在查询时，SignalCount 精确统计筛选集合的数量，并在一次列式扫描中抽取至多 1,000 条记录的均匀样本，用分类器对样本打分，再将平均校准概率乘以精确计数。其 90% 区间将抽样项与针对校准误差的、依赖比率的单侧边际相结合，这些边际通过跨租户的分裂共形预测（split conformal prediction）拟合。在多租户生产部署中，延迟的 p99 为 3.8 秒，且在筛选集合超过样本规模后增大时保持平稳。在未参与拟合的租户上，该区间覆盖生产流水线所返回计数的比例为 92%，但总体估计值偏高约 15%，因为对每条记录几乎无偏的校准，在每个标准层面上仍然是有偏的。

title: WaDiS: Boundary-Preserving Diffusion Segmentation via Multi-Scale Wavelet Conditioning and Frequency-Aware Gating
zh_title: WaDiS：多尺度小波条件与频率感知门控的边界保持扩散分割
summary: 提出小波条件潜空间扩散框架，通过多尺度小波编码和频率感知门控块，改善医学图像分割中的边界保持。
key_points: 多尺度小波条件编码器保留结构特征
引入频率感知门控块FAGB
针对复杂临床成像条件
reason: 分割架构增量改进，摘要未见外部验证
abstract: Diffusion models have shown strong potential in medical image segmentation due to their generative capabilities and robustness. However, existing methods often struggle to preserve fine anatomical boundaries and to retain multi-scale structural information due to the loss of spatial and frequency details during feature encoding, particularly in complex clinical imaging conditions. This work presents WaDiS, a wavelet-powered conditional latent diffusion framework for medical image segmentation that addresses these limitations through multi-scale wavelet conditioning and frequency-aware information filtering for boundary preservation. The model adopts a multi-scale wavelet conditioning encoder to retain rich structural features, leveraging its lossless nature to better preserve semantic priors critical to the diffusion process. In addition, a Frequency-Aware Gating Block (FAGB) is introduced into the skip connections of the diffusion U-Net, enabling adaptive spectral filtering and residual fusion to better emphasize boundary structures while reducing irrelevant content. To improve generalization across clinical domains, we adopt a structure-preserving color augmentation strategy during training. Specifically, global color statistics are transferred between samples in the LAB color space, allowing the model to decouple appearance from structure and focus more on anatomical shape rather than color bias. Experiments on five benchmark datasets demonstrate that WaDiS consistently outperforms existing diffusion-based and conventional segmentation methods, with notable improvements in boundary accuracy, robustness to noise, and generalization under color variation. The code for this work will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
zh_abstract: 扩散模型凭借其生成能力和鲁棒性，在医学图像分割中展现出强大潜力。然而，现有方法在特征编码过程中往往会丢失空间和频率细节，因而难以保留精细的解剖边界和多尺度结构信息，在复杂的临床成像条件下尤为如此。本文提出 WaDiS，一种基于小波的条件潜在扩散框架，用于医学图像分割，通过多尺度小波条件化和用于边界保持的频率感知信息过滤来解决上述局限。该模型采用多尺度小波条件编码器以保留丰富的结构特征，并利用其无损特性更好地保留对扩散过程至关重要的语义先验。此外，在扩散 U-Net 的跳跃连接中引入了频率感知门控模块（Frequency-Aware Gating Block, FAGB），实现自适应频谱滤波和残差融合，从而更好地突出边界结构并减少无关内容。为提高跨临床域的泛化能力，我们在训练中采用了保持结构的颜色增强策略。具体而言，在 LAB 色彩空间中在样本之间迁移全局颜色统计量，使模型能够将外观与结构解耦，更多地关注解剖形状而非颜色偏差。在五个基准数据集上的实验表明，WaDiS 持续优于现有基于扩散的方法和传统分割方法，在边界精度、噪声鲁棒性以及颜色变化下的泛化能力方面均有显著提升。本工作的代码将在论文被接收后公开。

title: Trustworthy Speech-Based Autism Screening under Class Imbalance with Uncertainty-Aware HuBERT Ensembles
zh_title: 基于不确定性感知HuBERT集成的可信语音自闭症筛查
summary: 结合HuBERT微调、留一受试者交叉验证、均衡k-bagging与MC Dropout，在CPSD上受试者级平衡准确率95.04%、ROC-AUC 96.30%。
key_points: 话语级平衡准确率86.30%，AUC 93.74%
受试者级准确率95.04%，AUC 96.30%
引入不确定性估计应对类别不平衡
reason: 单一数据集、无外部验证，预印本，增量档
abstract: Early screening of Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is critical for timely clinical intervention, although establishing reliable speech based screening systems remains problematic due to limited clinical data, class imbalance, and the need for reliable uncertainty estimation. We propose an uncertainty-aware ASD screening framework based on self-supervised HuBERT representations, combining Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) crossvalidation, balanced k-bagging, and Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout. Multiple HuBERT models are fine-tuned on balanced subsets, with predictions combined through probability-based ensemble averaging and aggregated at the subject level. Experiments on the Child Pathological Speech Database (CPSD) show strong performance, achieving 86.30% balanced accuracy and 93.74% ROC-AUC at the utterance level, and 95.04% and 96.30%, respectively, at the subject level. Furthermore, predictive entropy effectively reflects classification reliability: incorrectly classified segments show higher entropy than correctly classified ones (0.4605 $\pm$ 0.2314 vs. 0.1717 $\pm$ 0.1830), with a significant correlation with errors (r = 0.3981, p = 7.38 x 10 -170 ) and an error-detection ROC-AUC of 0.8359. These results demonstrate the potential of the proposed framework as a robust and uncertainty-aware computer-aided tool for ASD screening.
zh_abstract: 孤独症谱系障碍（ASD）的早期筛查对及时的临床干预至关重要，但由于临床数据有限、类别不平衡以及需要可靠的不确定性估计，建立可靠的基于语音的筛查系统仍然存在困难。我们提出了一种基于自监督 HuBERT 表征的不确定性感知 ASD 筛查框架，结合了留一受试者交叉验证（LOSO）、均衡 k-bagging 和蒙特卡洛（MC）Dropout。多个 HuBERT 模型在均衡子集上进行微调，预测结果通过基于概率的集成平均进行组合，并在受试者层面进行汇总。在儿童病理语音数据库（CPSD）上的实验显示出优异性能：话语层面的均衡准确率为 86.30%，ROC-AUC 为 93.74%；受试者层面分别为 95.04% 和 96.30%。此外，预测熵能够有效反映分类可靠性：被错误分类的片段熵高于被正确分类的片段（0.4605 ± 0.2314 对 0.1717 ± 0.1830），与错误显著相关（r = 0.3981，p = 7.38 x 10^-170），错误检测的 ROC-AUC 为 0.8359。这些结果表明，所提出的框架有潜力成为一种稳健且具备不确定性感知能力的 ASD 计算机辅助筛查工具。

title: Stable but Hidden: Identifiability and Experimental Design under Missing Compositional Support
zh_title: 稳定却隐匿：缺失组合支持下的可识别性与实验设计
summary: 研究AI引导科学发现中组分单独观测但从未联合观测时的可识别性问题，刻画不可见子空间并给出最优联合测量设计的极小极大风险。
key_points: 不同响应函数在观测组合上一致却在缺失组合上不同
额外同支持数据无法消除歧义
最优联合测量风险为Θ(σ²r/m)
reason: 理论性强，摘要未见医学实证，预印本
abstract: AI-guided scientific discovery often uses inexpensive predictors to allocate scarce verification measurements. We study a structural failure when relevant components have been observed separately but never jointly: distinct admissible response functions can agree on all observed compositions while disagreeing on the missing combinations. Additional same-support data cannot resolve this ambiguity, and agreement among fitted models need not expose it. We characterize the unresolved directions as an invisible subspace $\mathcal{N}_T(\mathcal{F}) = \ker \mathcal{R}_T$, whose geometry determines oracle zero-shot ambiguity and minimax risk under a symmetric, bounded ambiguity class. When the missing response lies in an $r$-dimensional, well-conditioned linear basis, optimally designed joint measurements achieve minimax integrated risk $Θ(σ^2 r/m)$, with classical $I$-optimality the fixed-design criterion. We validate on materials. In electrocatalysis, a six-dimensional support-derived structural basis (a prior on candidate directions, not an identified physical model) reduces held-out MSE against a dimension-matched generic basis (median paired ratio 0.75, improving 98% of 60 element pairs at $m = 15$), while $I$-optimal and same-basis posterior-variance acquisition show no detected difference. In Materials Project, removing joint property labels reduces $E_{\text{above hull}}$ ranking on 90% of 30 element pairs, more than matched data-removal controls, under a frozen pretrained representation. Pair difficulty is reproducible across learners but poorly predicted by zero-label ensemble disagreement; 20 joint measurements enable transferable pair-level rankings without reliable absolute calibration. In practice, experiment selection should ask which relationships the observed support leaves unidentified before asking where a fitted model is least certain.
zh_abstract: 人工智能引导的科学发现通常使用廉价的预测器来分配稀缺的验证性测量。我们研究了一种结构性失效：当相关成分曾被分别观测、却从未被联合观测时，不同的可容许响应函数可能在所有已观测组成上一致，而在缺失的组合上不一致。增加同支撑集的数据无法消除这种歧义，且已拟合模型之间的一致也未必能暴露这种歧义。我们将未解决的方向刻画为不可见子空间 $\mathcal{N}_T(\mathcal{F}) = \ker \mathcal{R}_T$，其几何结构决定了在对称、有界歧义类下的预言机零样本歧义和极小极大风险。当缺失的响应位于一个 $r$ 维、条件良好的线性基中时，经过最优设计的联合测量可达到极小极大积分风险 $Θ(σ^2 r/m)$，其中经典的 $I$-最优性是固定设计准则。我们在材料领域进行了验证。在电催化中，一个六维的、由支撑集导出的结构基（是对候选方向的先验，而非已识别的物理模型）相较于维度匹配的通用基降低了留出集 MSE（配对比值中位数为 0.75，在 $m = 15$ 时 60 个元素对中 98% 得到改善），而 $I$-最优采集与同基后验方差采集之间未检测到差异。在 Materials Project 中，在冻结的预训练表示下，去除联合性质标签会使 30 个元素对中 90% 的 $E_{\text{above hull}}$ 排序变差，其影响大于匹配的数据去除对照。元素对的难度在不同学习器之间可重复，但很难由零标签集成分歧预测；20 次联合测量即可获得可迁移的元素对层面排序，但无法获得可靠的绝对校准。在实践中，实验选择应当先问观测支撑集使哪些关系未被识别，然后再问已拟合模型在何处最不确定。

title: UniDR: Learning To Generate Anatomical Deformations From Images via Unified Diffusion Modeling and Registration
zh_title: UniDR：统一扩散建模与配准生成解剖形变
summary: 提出将条件扩散模型与图像配准联合优化的框架，从图像生成保持拓扑的任意解剖形变。
key_points: 在形变场上构建条件扩散模型
提出配准引导的得分匹配目标
连接生成与配准以减少误差传播
reason: 新方法预印本，摘要未见外部验证
abstract: This paper presents a novel framework, Unified Diffusion modeling and Registration (UniDR), which learns to generate arbitrary anatomical deformations from images with preserved topology. Existing approaches often model the generative process separately from registration-based deformation estimation; hence making them prone to propagated errors from the registration stage. To address this limitation, we propose a unified paradigm based on a conditional diffusion model over deformation fields that are jointly optimized from the registration process. A principled registration-guided score-matching objective function is then introduced to align the diffusion process with the deformation distribution induced by registration. As a result, our UniDR establishes an explicit connection between generation and registration: the diffusion model enables exploration of the space of plausible anatomical deformations, whereas registration provides structured supervision for learning transformations consistent with observed images. Once trained, UniDR is able to sample diverse, anatomically plausible transformations conditioned on any single input image. We evaluate UniDR across multiple real-world applications and demonstrate its effectiveness in generating high-fidelity image samples compared to the state-of-the-art. Additionally, we demonstrate that these generated samples improve performance in downstream medical image analysis and vision tasks.
zh_abstract: 本文提出了一种新颖的框架——统一扩散建模与配准（UniDR），可从图像中学习生成保持拓扑结构的任意解剖形变。现有方法通常将生成过程与基于配准的形变估计分开建模，因此容易受到配准阶段误差传播的影响。为解决这一局限，我们提出了一种统一范式：基于对形变场的条件扩散模型，并与配准过程联合优化。随后引入了一个有原则的配准引导得分匹配目标函数，使扩散过程与配准所诱导的形变分布对齐。因此，UniDR 在生成与配准之间建立了明确联系：扩散模型能够探索合理解剖形变的空间，而配准则为学习与观测图像一致的变换提供结构化监督。训练完成后，UniDR 能够以任意单幅输入图像为条件，采样出多样且解剖上合理的变换。我们在多个真实应用中评估了 UniDR，并证明与最先进方法相比，其在生成高保真图像样本方面具有有效性。此外，我们还证明这些生成的样本可提升下游医学图像分析和视觉任务的性能。

title: Deep learning-based CT segmentation of mandibular bone invasion in oral squamous cell carcinoma.
zh_title: 深度学习CT分割口腔鳞癌下颌骨侵犯
summary: 回顾性概念验证研究，50例CT，用nnU-Net内MedNeXt分割下颌骨与骨侵犯，并探索基于中心线的肿瘤范围评估用于CAD/CAM规划。
key_points: 50例患者，30例训练、20例独立测试
3D MedNeXt（nnU-Net框架）
面向虚拟手术规划
reason: 单中心小样本回顾性概念验证，属增量档
abstract: [BMC oral health] Accurate identification of mandibular invasion by oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) is important for virtual surgical planning, but manual delineation on CT is challenging and time-consuming. This retrospective proof-of-concept study evaluated automated segmentation of the mandible and radiologically apparent bone invasion and explored centerline-based assessment of longitudinal tumor extent for computer-aided design/computer-aided manufacturing (CAD/CAM) planning. Fifty preoperative CT examinations from 50 patients with histopathologically confirmed mandibular invasion were included. Thirty examinations were used for model development and 20 for independent testing. A three-dimensional MedNeXt architecture implemented within nnU-Net was trained applying expert-reviewed CT reference segmentations. Performance was assessed using Dice similarity coefficient (DSC), precision, recall, average symmetric surface distance and 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance. Spatial localization, longitudinal invasion-span differences and signed centerline-projected endpoint errors were assessed in the holdout cohort. Mean mandibular DSC was 0.965 (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.961-0.969; median 0.967). Mean invasion DSC was 0.553 (95% CI, 0.425-0.660; median 0.623), with mean precision of 0.742 and recall of 0.483. Predicted invasion overlapped the CT reference in 18/20 examinations (90%); 16/20 (80%) achieved DSC ≥ 0.20. Two cases were completely missed. Among the 18 evaluable cases, the median absolute invasion-span difference was 7.01 mm (interquartile range, 5.08-13.00 mm) and the median symmetric endpoint distance was 5.88 mm (3.19-9.16 mm). The present proof-of-concept study demonstrates the technical feasibility of automated CT segmentation of the mandible and radiologically apparent mandibular invasion by OSCC. The approach may support transmission of radiological tumor extent into virtual resection planning. Larger multicenter studies and prospective clinical validation are needed to establish its impact on planning accuracy and workflow efficiency.
zh_abstract: [BMC oral health] 准确识别口腔鳞状细胞癌（OSCC）对下颌骨的侵犯对虚拟手术规划十分重要，但在 CT 上手动勾画既困难又耗时。这项回顾性概念验证研究评估了下颌骨及影像学上可见的骨侵犯的自动分割，并探索了基于中心线的纵向肿瘤范围评估，用于计算机辅助设计/计算机辅助制造（CAD/CAM）规划。研究纳入了 50 例经组织病理学证实存在下颌骨侵犯的患者的 50 份术前 CT 检查。其中 30 份用于模型开发，20 份用于独立测试。在 nnU-Net 框架内实现的三维 MedNeXt 架构，使用经专家审核的 CT 参考分割进行训练。性能通过 Dice 相似系数（DSC）、精确率、召回率、平均对称表面距离和第 95 百分位 Hausdorff 距离进行评估。在留出队列中评估了空间定位、纵向侵犯跨度差异以及带符号的中心线投影端点误差。下颌骨的平均 DSC 为 0.965（95% 置信区间 [CI]，0.961-0.969；中位数 0.967）。侵犯的平均 DSC 为 0.553（95% CI，0.425-0.660；中位数 0.623），平均精确率为 0.742，召回率为 0.483。预测的侵犯区域在 18/20 份检查（90%）中与 CT 参考重叠；16/20（80%）的 DSC ≥ 0.20。有两例完全漏检。在 18 例可评估病例中，侵犯跨度差异绝对值的中位数为 7.01 mm（四分位距，5.08-13.00 mm），对称端点距离的中位数为 5.88 mm（3.19-9.16 mm）。本概念验证研究证明了在 CT 上自动分割下颌骨及 OSCC 所致影像学上可见的下颌骨侵犯在技术上是可行的。该方法可能有助于将影像学肿瘤范围传递到虚拟切除规划中。需要更大规模的多中心研究和前瞻性临床验证，以确定其对规划准确性和工作流程效率的影响。

title: Development of a fully AI-based three-dimensional workflow for personalized target set-ups in orthodontics: First results.
zh_title: 全AI三维流程生成正畸个性化目标排牙
summary: 提出全自动AI流程，由口内扫描生成可3D打印的排牙方案，并以ABO评分与技师手工方案对比，纳入20例。
key_points: 流程含牙齿分割、标志点检测、补全与排齐
20例非拔牙全颌病例
以ABO MGS对比AI与手工排牙
reason: 单中心20例小样本，首批结果，属增量档
abstract: [International orthodontics] To present a fully automated artificial intelligence (AI) workflow to generate personalized orthodontic target set-ups and compare the quality of the occlusal outcome with manual set-ups, using the American Board of Orthodontics Model Grading System (ABO MGS). The AI workflow takes an intraoral scan and performs tooth segmentation, landmark detection, tooth completion, and tooth alignment to generate a 3D-printable personalized set-up without human intervention. The occlusal outcome was evaluated on twenty non-extraction full jaw cases treated with customized fixed appliances by comparing the AI set-ups to manual set-ups made by experienced laboratory technicians. Both set-up series were scored with the ABO MGS for alignment and rotations, marginal ridges, buccolingual inclination, overjet, occlusal contacts, occlusal relationships, and interproximal contacts. The 'alignment and rotations' category was additionally analysed separately for the anterior (canine to canine) and posterior (premolars to second molars) segments. Paired comparisons used the two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test (α=0.05). Based on the total ABO MGS scores, the AI set-ups (mean: 14.95) and manual set-ups (mean: 12.20) showed high-quality occlusal outcomes, which were both far below the ABO passing score. AI set-ups showed significantly more penalty points for alignment and rotations (median: 8 vs. 5; P<0.001). This difference was confined to the posterior segments; anterior alignment was near-ideal for both methods. Other categories did not differ significantly (P=0.082-0.886). For the first time, a fully automated AI-based 3D workflow generated personalized orthodontic target set-ups for non-extraction cases with a clinically acceptable, high-quality occlusal outcome, in approximately four minutes. Posterior alignment remains the only shortcoming of the AI set-ups and is the obvious target for further algorithm refinement or brief manual correction.
zh_abstract: [International orthodontics] 本研究旨在提出一种全自动人工智能（AI）工作流程以生成个性化正畸目标排牙（set-up），并使用美国正畸委员会模型评分系统（ABO MGS）比较其咬合结果质量与手工排牙的差异。该AI工作流程以口内扫描为输入，执行牙齿分割、标志点检测、牙齿补全和牙齿排齐，无需人工干预即可生成可3D打印的个性化排牙。咬合结果在20例采用定制固定矫治器治疗的非拔牙全牙列病例上进行评估，将AI排牙与经验丰富的技师制作的手工排牙进行比较。两组排牙均按ABO MGS对排列与旋转、边缘嵴、颊舌向倾斜度、覆盖、咬合接触、咬合关系和邻接触进行评分。“排列与旋转”类别另外分别对前牙段（尖牙到尖牙）和后牙段（前磨牙到第二磨牙）进行分析。配对比较采用双侧Wilcoxon符号秩检验（α=0.05）。基于ABO MGS总分，AI排牙（均值：14.95）和手工排牙（均值：12.20）均显示出高质量的咬合结果，均远低于ABO合格分数。AI排牙在排列与旋转方面的扣分显著更多（中位数：8 vs. 5；P<0.001）。该差异局限于后牙段；两种方法的前牙排列均接近理想。其他类别无显著差异（P=0.082–0.886）。全自动的基于AI的3D工作流程首次在约四分钟内为非拔牙病例生成了个性化正畸目标排牙，咬合结果高质量且临床可接受。后牙排列仍是AI排牙唯一的不足，也是进一步改进算法或进行简短手工修正的明确目标。

title: Machine Learning-Assisted Nanozymes: From Design to Application.
zh_title: 机器学习辅助纳米酶：从设计到应用
summary: 综述机器学习原理与常用算法，及其在纳米酶设计、活性预测与生物医学应用中的作用，并讨论挑战与对策。
key_points: 介绍ML基本原理与常用算法
聚焦ML与纳米酶在生物医学的协同
分析应用挑战与对策
reason: 材料领域综述，与医疗AI关联较弱
abstract: [Advanced healthcare materials] Nanozymes are synthetic nanomaterials engineered to mimic the catalytic functions of natural enzymes, characterized by facile synthesis, ease of surface modification, low cost, and high stability, and they have been widely applied in various fields. However, the rational design and synthesis of nanozymes remain complex, and their activity is challenging to predict. In recent years, the advent of machine learning (ML) has shown great promise in addressing these issues. This review first systematically elucidates the fundamental principles and common algorithms of ML, followed by an exploration of its role in nanozyme research, with a focused discussion on the synergistic applications of ML and nanozymes in the biomedical field. Finally, this review analyzes the key challenges faced by researchers in applying ML to nanozyme studies as well as the corresponding solutions and provides an outlook on future development directions. Furthermore, given the relatively limited reports on ML-assisted nanozyme research to date, this study aims to deepen the understanding of nanozymes and more effectively advance nanozyme research toward the era of artificial intelligence.
zh_abstract: [Advanced healthcare materials] 纳米酶是经工程设计以模拟天然酶催化功能的合成纳米材料，具有合成简便、易于表面修饰、成本低和稳定性高等特点，已被广泛应用于各个领域。然而，纳米酶的合理设计与合成仍然复杂，其活性也难以预测。近年来，机器学习（ML）的出现在解决这些问题方面展现出巨大前景。本综述首先系统阐述了 ML 的基本原理和常用算法，随后探讨其在纳米酶研究中的作用，并重点讨论 ML 与纳米酶在生物医学领域的协同应用。最后，本综述分析了研究者在将 ML 应用于纳米酶研究时面临的关键挑战及相应解决方案，并展望了未来发展方向。此外，鉴于迄今关于 ML 辅助纳米酶研究的报道相对有限，本研究旨在加深对纳米酶的理解，并更有效地推动纳米酶研究迈向人工智能时代。

title: Machine learning-supported polytrauma triage decision support: A concept analysis for emergency nursing.
zh_title: 机器学习辅助多发伤分诊决策支持：急诊护理概念分析
summary: 采用Walker和Avant方法，对机器学习支持的多发伤分诊决策支持概念的属性、前因后果与边界进行分析。
key_points: 采用Walker与Avant概念分析法
梳理多发伤急诊分诊相关文献
界定概念属性、前提、后果及边界
reason: 概念分析类文章，无模型验证，属增量档
abstract: [International emergency nursing] Polytrauma triage requires rapid prioritization under conditions of incomplete information, physiological instability, crowding, and high consequences of error. Machine learning (ML) is increasingly discussed as a means of strengthening emergency triage; however, the concept of ML-supported polytrauma triage decision support remains insufficiently defined for emergency nursing, particularly regarding its temporal and clinical boundaries within the emergency department. This concept analysis clarifies the meaning, defining attributes, antecedents, consequences, empirical referents, and boundaries of machine learning-supported polytrauma triage decision support. Walker and Avant's concept analysis method guided the analysis. A structured and traceable literature identification process was used to examine literature on polytrauma, initial emergency department triage, clinical decision support, machine learning in emergency and trauma care, digital nursing decision-making, and artificial intelligence safety. Sources were mapped using a concept-analysis matrix to identify concept uses, candidate attributes, antecedents, consequences, cases, empirical referents, and conceptual boundaries. Machine learning-supported polytrauma triage decision support was defined as a human-in-the-loop clinical decision support process operating within the initial emergency department triage window, in which ML integrates polytrauma-relevant information available at or immediately before the first triage decision and generates time-critical acuity or near-term deterioration estimates to inform immediate prioritization without replacing clinician judgment. Three core defining attributes were identified: polytrauma-relevant initial-triage data integration, time-critical triage risk or acuity estimation, and human-in-the-loop clinical decision support. Model validation, workflow fit and interpretability, and performance governance were distinguished from defining attributes and positioned as antecedent or implementation conditions and empirical referents for safe clinical use. The concept is distinct from conventional triage, trauma scoring, post-triage prognostic modeling, generic clinical decision support, and automated decision-making. Clarifying both its defining attributes and its temporal boundary positions ML as a support for the initial emergency nursing triage decision rather than as a substitute for professional judgment or a broader trauma management system.
zh_abstract: [International emergency nursing] 多发伤分诊需要在信息不完整、生理状态不稳定、拥挤以及错误后果严重的条件下快速确定优先级。机器学习（ML）越来越多地被讨论为加强急诊分诊的手段；然而，对于急诊护理而言，ML支持的多发伤分诊决策支持这一概念仍然定义不足，尤其是其在急诊科内的时间和临床边界。本概念分析阐明了机器学习支持的多发伤分诊决策支持的含义、定义属性、前因、后果、经验参照物和边界。分析以Walker和Avant的概念分析方法为指导。采用结构化且可追溯的文献识别流程，检索了有关多发伤、急诊科初始分诊、临床决策支持、急诊与创伤救治中的机器学习、数字化护理决策以及人工智能安全的文献。使用概念分析矩阵对文献来源进行梳理，以识别概念用法、候选属性、前因、后果、案例、经验参照物和概念边界。机器学习支持的多发伤分诊决策支持被定义为一种人在回路的临床决策支持过程，运行于急诊科初始分诊时间窗内；其中ML整合在首次分诊决策时或之前即刻可获得的与多发伤相关的信息，并生成时间紧迫的危重程度或近期恶化估计，以为即时优先级确定提供信息，而不取代临床医生的判断。确定了三个核心定义属性：与多发伤相关的初始分诊数据整合、时间紧迫的分诊风险或危重程度估计，以及人在回路的临床决策支持。模型验证、工作流程适配性与可解释性、以及性能治理，被区分于定义属性，并被定位为安全临床使用的前因或实施条件及经验参照物。该概念不同于传统分诊、创伤评分、分诊后预后建模、通用临床决策支持和自动化决策。明确其定义属性及时间边界，可将ML定位为对急诊护理初始分诊决策的支持，而非专业判断或更广泛创伤管理系统的替代。

title: GAG-Net: Graph-Based Anatomical Guidance Network for Pharyngeal Area Segmentation in VFSS Images
zh_title: GAG-Net：VFSS图像咽部面积的图引导分割
summary: 针对吞咽造影图像静息咽部面积分割，提出基于解剖图引导的网络，并与康复科专家共建标注协议和首个相关数据集。
key_points: 将分割转化为临床定义的测量任务
与康复医学专家制定地标与标注协议
构建该任务首个数据集
reason: 预印本，新数据集与方法但规模与验证信息有限，增量档
abstract: Diagnosing sarcopenic dysphagia typically requires costly supplementary imaging such as CT or MRI to assess muscle atrophy, burdening elderly patients. The pharyngeal area at rest (PA_rest), measurable directly from videofluoroscopic swallowing study (VFSS) images, is a promising biomarker that could eliminate this dependency, but repeated manual measurement has limited its adoption. PA_rest segmentation is further complicated by indistinct soft-tissue boundaries and clinical rule-based delineation criteria that data-driven models capture only imprecisely. We formulate automated PA_rest segmentation as a clinically defined measurement task, translating an implicit clinical measurement into an explicit landmark specification and annotation protocol developed with a rehabilitation medicine specialist. Applying this protocol, we constructed, to our knowledge, the first dataset for this task: 2,255 single-center VFSS frames from 137 patients, with PA_rest contours and seven landmarks verified by a senior specialist. We then introduce GAG-Net, an automated rest-frame measurement pipeline combining deformable convolutions, for irregular pharyngeal boundaries, with a graph-based anatomical guidance module that models the geometric dependencies among landmarks prescribed by the delineation rules. On a patient-level held-out test set (237 frames, 67 patients), GAG-Net achieved the lowest area measurement error (mean absolute percentage error: 8.17% against specialist-verified references; patient-level ICC 0.97) and the highest Dice score (0.8862) among all evaluated methods, with 67.2% fewer parameters and 74% less training memory than the two-stage JOINED model. Integrating clinician-defined anatomical knowledge may enable automated PA_rest measurement from VFSS images alone, supporting quantitative assessment of sarcopenic dysphagia without supplementary imaging.
zh_abstract: 诊断肌少症性吞咽困难通常需要 CT 或 MRI 等昂贵的补充影像检查来评估肌肉萎缩，给老年患者带来负担。静息状态下的咽部面积（PA_rest）可直接从吞咽荧光造影检查（VFSS）图像中测量，是一种有望消除这种依赖的生物标志物，但反复的人工测量限制了其应用。PA_rest 分割还因软组织边界不清，以及数据驱动模型只能不精确地捕捉的基于临床规则的勾画标准而更加复杂。我们将自动化 PA_rest 分割表述为一项由临床定义的测量任务，把隐含的临床测量转化为与康复医学专科医师共同制定的明确的标志点规范和标注方案。应用该方案，我们构建了据我们所知该任务的首个数据集：来自 137 名患者的 2,255 帧单中心 VFSS 图像，其 PA_rest 轮廓和七个标志点均经资深专科医师核实。随后我们提出 GAG-Net，一种自动化静息帧测量流程，它将用于处理不规则咽部边界的可变形卷积，与基于图的解剖引导模块相结合，该模块对勾画规则所规定的标志点之间的几何依赖关系进行建模。在患者层面的留出测试集（237 帧，67 名患者）上，GAG-Net 在所有被评估方法中取得了最低的面积测量误差（相对于专科医师核实的参考值，平均绝对百分比误差：8.17%；患者层面 ICC 为 0.97）和最高的 Dice 分数（0.8862），且与两阶段的 JOINED 模型相比，参数量减少 67.2%，训练内存减少 74%。整合由临床医生定义的解剖学知识，可能使得仅凭 VFSS 图像即可实现自动化 PA_rest 测量，从而支持在无需补充影像检查的情况下对肌少症性吞咽困难进行定量评估。

title: ATLAS: Autoregressive Trajectories for Longitudinal Analysis of Survival
zh_title: ATLAS：自回归轨迹的动态生存分析
summary: 用序列模型自回归采样患者未来轨迹，生成合成队列以估计生存曲线，并在两个自动机基准上与八种生存模型比较。
key_points: 自回归采样条件于既往病史的未来轨迹
由合成队列估计KM与累积发生率曲线
在有精确参考曲线的模拟基准上评估
reason: 仅合成基准评估，无真实临床验证
abstract: Dynamic survival prediction requires estimates that reflect a patient's observed clinical history. We introduce ATLAS (Autoregressive Trajectories for Longitudinal Analysis of Survival), a framework that trains a sequence model on longitudinal data and autoregressively samples possible futures conditional on an individual's covariates and observed history. These trajectories form a patient-specific synthetic cohort from which Kaplan-Meier survival curves and Aalen-Johansen cumulative incidence curves are estimated. We evaluate ATLAS using two stochastic finite-state automaton benchmarks with exact conditional reference curves: a single-covariate process with duration dependence and a late rule change, and a three-covariate Markov process with recovery and competing causes of death. Comparisons include eight direct survival models, including validation-optimized DRSA and Dynamic-DeepHit and history-aware SurvTRACE adaptations, with each neural model trained nine times in the first experiment and five times in the second. After baseline, every ATLAS configuration had lower mean survival-curve error than every fitted direct comparator in both experiments. With a common Sobol sampler and 10,000 trajectories per patient, the best ATLAS model did so in every individual training run, and its mean error was 62% to 84% lower than that of the strongest direct comparator. Baseline advantages were smaller and less consistent in the duration-dependent experiment. ATLAS provides a generative framework for history-conditioned survival estimation, while the accompanying benchmarks enable direct assessment of individual survival and competing-risk predictions against known reference curves.
zh_abstract: 动态生存预测需要能够反映患者已观察到的临床病史的估计。我们提出 ATLAS（Autoregressive Trajectories for Longitudinal Analysis of Survival，用于生存纵向分析的自回归轨迹），这是一个在纵向数据上训练序列模型，并以个体的协变量和已观察到的病史为条件，自回归地采样可能的未来轨迹的框架。这些轨迹构成患者特异的合成队列，并据此估计 Kaplan-Meier 生存曲线和 Aalen-Johansen 累积发生率曲线。我们使用两个具有精确条件参考曲线的随机有限状态自动机基准来评估 ATLAS：一个是具有持续时间依赖性和后期规则变化的单协变量过程，另一个是具有恢复和竞争性死因的三协变量马尔可夫过程。比较对象包括八种直接生存模型，其中包括经验证集优化的 DRSA 和 Dynamic-DeepHit，以及适配了病史信息的 SurvTRACE；每个神经网络模型在第一个实验中训练九次，在第二个实验中训练五次。在基线之后，两个实验中每一种 ATLAS 配置的平均生存曲线误差均低于每一种已拟合的直接比较模型。采用共同的 Sobol 采样器并为每位患者生成 10,000 条轨迹时，最佳 ATLAS 模型在每一次单独的训练运行中均做到了这一点，其平均误差比最强的直接比较模型低 62% 至 84%。在持续时间依赖性实验中，相对于基线的优势较小且一致性较差。ATLAS 为以病史为条件的生存估计提供了一个生成式框架，同时配套的基准可用于对照已知的参考曲线，直接评估个体生存和竞争风险预测。

title: One-shot is Enough: Boosting SAM for Medical Image Segmentation through Structured Information Modeling
zh_title: OB-SAM：结构化信息建模的单样本医学分割
summary: 提出单样本增强框架OB-SAM，通过多频解耦等模块提升SAM在医学图像分割中的表现。
key_points: 面向单标注样本的医学分割
设计多频解耦（MFD）模块
从结构化建模角度利用SAM多粒度信息
reason: 方法改进型预印本，证据有限
abstract: In recent years, Foundation models such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM) have demonstrated strong generalization capabilities, but because they are primarily pre-trained on natural images, they perform poorly when faced with medical images. With sufficient labeled medical data, this challenge is somewhat alleviated. However, the difficulty and high cost of acquiring large amounts of labeled data make one-shot learning a highly attractive research paradigm. But within this paradigm, SAM struggles to fully extract its potential multi-granular information, leading to a sharp decline in performance. To address this, we propose OB-SAM, a one-shot enhancement framework for medical image segmentation. It aims to maximize the utilization of information from a single sample from the perspective of structured modeling. Specifically, we first designed a Multi-Frequency Decoupling (MFD) module, which divides features into different frequency domain components, allowing each branch to focus on information expression at different semantic levels, thereby alleviating overfitting and enhancing feature representation capabilities. Secondly, we introduce a Progressive Feature Integrator (PFI) module to promote complementary fusion among multi-level features, thereby avoiding the dominant effect of a certain level of feature in the fusion process. Furthermore, we propose an Selective Context Filtering (SCF) Module that adaptively selects key contextual information by modeling the contrast relationship between the foreground and background, thereby achieving precise localization of the lesion area. Extensive experiments across seven diverse datasets validate that OB-SAM achieves state-of-the-art performance.
zh_abstract: 近年来，Segment Anything Model（SAM）等基础模型展现出较强的泛化能力，但由于主要在自然图像上预训练，其在医学图像上表现不佳。在有充足标注医学数据的情况下，这一挑战可在一定程度上得到缓解。然而，获取大量标注数据困难且成本高，使得单样本学习成为极具吸引力的研究范式。但在该范式下，SAM 难以充分挖掘其潜在的多粒度信息，导致性能急剧下降。为此，我们提出 OB-SAM，一种用于医学图像分割的单样本增强框架，旨在从结构化建模的角度最大限度地利用单个样本的信息。具体而言，我们首先设计了多频解耦（MFD）模块，将特征划分为不同的频域分量，使各分支专注于不同语义层次的信息表达，从而缓解过拟合并增强特征表示能力。其次，我们引入渐进式特征整合器（PFI）模块，促进多层次特征之间的互补融合，从而避免融合过程中某一层次特征占主导。此外，我们提出选择性上下文过滤（SCF）模块，通过建模前景与背景之间的对比关系，自适应地选择关键上下文信息，从而实现对病灶区域的精确定位。在七个不同数据集上的大量实验验证了 OB-SAM 达到了最先进的性能。

title: Controlled One-Click Benchmarking and Post-Fusion Recalibration for Support-Conditioned Medical Segmentation
zh_title: 单点击医学分割基准与融合后重校准方法
summary: 提出受控单点击分割评测协议及SAR模块，在BUSI、神经超声和Kvasir-SEG上评估MultiverSeg基线改进。
key_points: 统一单点击提示、划分与无阈值调优协议
SAR结合大核空间门控与通道重校准
三个数据集上Dice-AUC/IoU-AUC优于基线
reason: 预印本，公开数据集小规模对比，增量方法
abstract: Sparse-prompt medical segmentation is hard to compare when prompts, supports, thresholds, and splits differ. This paper uses a controlled one-click protocol: each test image receives one positive foreground click, training-only support, validation-only checkpoint selection, and no test-time threshold tuning. We propose {Support-Aware Recalibration (SAR)}, a late post-fusion recalibration block for MultiverSeg that combines large-kernel spatial gating with squeeze-and-excitation channel recalibration after support--query fusion. BUSI, NerveUS-BP-present, and Kvasir-SEG are evaluated with matched 697 foreground-present sample budgets, shared splits/clicks, and threshold-free Dice-AUC/IoU-AUC. Compared with a protocol-matched raw-support MultiverSeg baseline, the main SAR configuration shows favorable mean Dice-AUC/IoU-AUC performance on BUSI, NerveUS-BP-present, and Kvasir-SEG, while reducing logged training time in this implementation. These controlled results indicate that late post-fusion recalibration is useful under a leakage-controlled one-click protocol.
zh_abstract: 当提示（prompt）、支持集（support）、阈值和数据划分各不相同时，稀疏提示医学图像分割方法难以进行比较。本文采用受控的单点击（one-click）协议：每幅测试图像仅获得一个前景正向点击，支持集仅来自训练集，检查点仅依据验证集选择，且测试时不进行阈值调整。我们提出了{支持感知重校准（Support-Aware Recalibration，SAR）}，这是一种用于 MultiverSeg 的后期融合后重校准模块，在支持—查询融合之后，将大核空间门控与 squeeze-and-excitation 通道重校准相结合。我们在 BUSI、NerveUS-BP-present 和 Kvasir-SEG 上进行评估，三者采用相匹配的 697 个含前景样本预算、共享的数据划分/点击，以及无需阈值的 Dice-AUC/IoU-AUC。与协议匹配的原始支持集（raw-support）MultiverSeg 基线相比，SAR 主配置在 BUSI、NerveUS-BP-present 和 Kvasir-SEG 上的平均 Dice-AUC/IoU-AUC 表现更优，同时在本实现中减少了记录的训练时间。这些受控结果表明，在防止信息泄漏的单点击协议下，后期融合后重校准是有用的。

title: What Does an Agent-Run Clinic Cost? Protocol for a Prospective Observational Study of the Compute Cost of Completed Work in a Clinical Agent Fleet
zh_title: 临床智能体集群完成工作的算力成本：前瞻观察研究方案
summary: 该研究方案拟在伦敦一家私立门诊，基于12周生产遥测数据估计LLM多智能体系统完成工作的算力成本，分析计划预先固定。
key_points: 前瞻性观察研究方案
连接算力成本、延迟、失败重试与完成工作
分析计划在数据提取前固定
reason: 仅为方案、无结果，但关注智能体部署成本
abstract: Background: Decisions about deploying large language model (LLM) agents in health care require the cost of completed work in production. Published evidence reports benchmark accuracy, benchmark-level cost, and time or financial outcomes for ambient documentation, and list prices alone do not determine the cost of completed work. To our knowledge, no deployed clinical agent fleet has published a measurement method that ties compute cost, latency, failures and retries to completed work. Objective: This study aims to estimate the compute cost of completed work by the orchestrated clinical agents of a deployed LLM agent fleet over a 12-week window of production telemetry, using estimators, data-quality gates and an analysis plan fixed before any window data are extracted for the study. Methods: The setting is a private outpatient clinic in London, United Kingdom, where wai, a multi-agent system supporting clinic operations, is deployed. The population is every run of the 20 orchestrated clinical documentation and decision-support agents starting between September 21 and December 13, 2026. The run store writes 2 records for every run, a non-terminal record before the model call and a terminal record after it, and has no attempt counter or parent-run link. Estimators defined on that structure cover cost per resolved execution and per completed intention, retry and failed-intention shares of compute, error and failure rates, latency, cost per draft offered for clinician review and a latency-cost frontier, by agent, task class and acceptance stratum. Cost is recorded in GBP pence, converted from provider-returned US dollar cost at a fixed rate and rounded per model call. The plan fixes weekly aggregation, small-cell suppression, bootstrap intervals over weeks, 2 prespecified comparisons, 5 sensitivity analyses and 4 data-quality gates whose failure converts an estimate into a bound or an unmeasured stratum. Two staff-level measures in an earlier version were dropped. Revenue, pricing, margin and staffing inference are excluded. Results: The measurement window opened on September 21, 2026, and closes on December 13, 2026, and telemetry is being recorded in routine operation. No window data had been extracted for this study at submission. Aggregate whole-table counts that include window records were extracted on November 19, 2026, for companion manuscripts and are disclosed. Extraction will begin no earlier than December 15, 2026, and the results are expected to be
zh_abstract: 【背景】关于在医疗保健中部署大语言模型（LLM）智能体的决策，需要了解生产环境中已完成工作的成本。已发表的证据报告了基准测试准确率、基准层面的成本，以及环境式文书记录的时间或财务结局，仅凭标价并不能确定已完成工作的成本。据我们所知，尚无已部署的临床智能体集群发表过将计算成本、延迟、失败和重试与已完成工作联系起来的测量方法。【目的】本研究旨在利用 12 周的生产遥测数据，估算已部署的 LLM 智能体集群中经编排的临床智能体完成工作的计算成本，所用的估计量、数据质量关卡和分析计划均在为本研究提取任何窗口期数据之前确定。【方法】研究场所是英国伦敦的一家私人门诊诊所，部署了支持诊所运营的多智能体系统 wai。研究人群为 2026 年 9 月 21 日至 12 月 13 日期间启动的 20 个经编排的临床文书和决策支持智能体的每一次运行。运行存储为每次运行写入 2 条记录：模型调用前的非终止记录和调用后的终止记录，且没有尝试计数器或父运行链接。基于该结构定义的估计量涵盖每次已解决执行和每项已完成意图的成本、重试和失败意图在计算中所占份额、错误和失败率、延迟、每份提供给临床医生审阅的草稿的成本，以及延迟-成本前沿，并按智能体、任务类别和接受度分层。成本以英镑便士记录，按固定汇率由服务商返回的美元成本换算，并按每次模型调用取整。该计划确定了按周汇总、小单元抑制、按周的自助法区间、2 项预先设定的比较、5 项敏感性分析和 4 个数据质量关卡，关卡未通过会使估计值变为界限值或未测量的分层。早期版本中的两项员工层面指标已被删除。收入、定价、利润率和人员配置推断不在研究范围内。【结果】测量窗口于 2026 年 9 月 21 日开启，将于 2026 年 12 月 13 日结束，遥测数据正在常规运行中记录。截至提交时，尚未为本研究提取任何窗口期数据。为配套稿件，已于 2026 年 11 月 19 日提取包含窗口期记录的整表汇总计数，特此披露。提取将不早于 2026 年 12 月 15 日开始，预计结果将于

title: The unedited acceptance rate: a review-fidelity metric for human-in-the-loop clinical AI
zh_title: 未编辑接受率：人在回路临床AI的审核保真度指标
summary: 为伦敦一家门诊诊所的多智能体临床系统定义可计算的审核保真度指标（如未编辑接受率），并预先设定12周前瞻分析。
key_points: 定义UAR、归一化编辑距离等指标
对照系统代码与数据库结构核查
预设12周前瞻分析，尚无结果
reason: 单诊所、指标定义为主，尚无实证结果，增量档
abstract: Objective. Guidance for large language model (LLM) drafting in clinical care relies on human review, yet review is rarely measured as a control. We aimed to define computable measures of review fidelity, establish which a deployed system can compute, and pre-specify their first analysis. Materials and Methods. For a multi-agent clinical system in routine use at one private London outpatient clinic, we defined acceptance coverage, attribution completeness, the unedited acceptance rate (UAR), a bounded normalized edit distance, availability latency and an unedited fast-approval rate (UFA). We checked each measure against the system's code and database structure at a fixed commit on four approval routes and pre-specified a prospective 12-week analysis. Results. The UAR equals the mass at zero of the edit-distance distribution, and availability latency bounds reading time from above only. Clinical documentation keeps draft and signed text with a recorded signer, so the core measures are computable there. Help-desk edit telemetry is written only when the agent's version has been stored. The WhatsApp agent route records no edit signal, and its approver need not be named. No route records when a draft is opened. Documentation accept events were not written before a change committed on November 16, 2026. Model-generated content, including live voice-agent speech, also reaches patients without approval. No measured values are reported. Discussion. Acceptance alone cannot separate accurate drafts from approval without reading, and three of four routes cannot yet support the family. Conclusion. Review fidelity can be specified as telemetry at the approval event. Validation against missed errors is required.
zh_abstract: 【目的】临床诊疗中关于大语言模型（LLM）起草内容的指导意见依赖人工审核，但审核很少作为一种控制措施被衡量。我们旨在定义可计算的审核保真度指标，确定已部署系统能够计算其中哪些指标，并预先设定其首次分析方案。【材料与方法】针对在伦敦一家私人门诊诊所常规使用的多智能体临床系统，我们定义了接受覆盖率（acceptance coverage）、归因完整性（attribution completeness）、未编辑接受率（UAR）、有界归一化编辑距离、可用延迟（availability latency）以及未编辑快速批准率（UFA）。我们在固定提交版本下，针对四条批准路径，对照系统代码和数据库结构逐项核查各指标，并预先设定了为期12周的前瞻性分析。【结果】UAR等于编辑距离分布在零处的质量，而可用延迟仅能从上界约束阅读时间。临床文书保留草稿与签署文本并记录签署人，因此核心指标在该处可计算。帮助台的编辑遥测数据仅在智能体版本已被存储时才会写入。WhatsApp智能体路径不记录编辑信号，且其批准人无需具名。没有任何路径记录草稿何时被打开。在2026年11月16日提交的变更之前，文书接受事件未被写入。包括实时语音智能体语音在内的模型生成内容也会在未经批准的情况下到达患者。未报告任何实测值。【讨论】仅凭接受与否无法区分准确的草稿与未经阅读的批准，且四条路径中有三条目前尚无法支持该指标体系。【结论】审核保真度可以被规定为批准事件处的遥测数据。仍需针对漏检错误进行验证。

title: Asking Conversational Artificial Intelligence about Health and Subsequent Actions among Adults in Japan: A Cross-sectional Web Survey
zh_title: 日本成人向对话式AI咨询健康问题及后续行为：横断面调查
summary: 两阶段网络问卷调查，估计日本成人向对话式AI询问健康问题的比例、目的、后续行动及信任度；约40.3%成人近6个月曾询问。
key_points: 筛查样本分析8,209人，主调查735名用户
近6个月40.3%成人曾向AI问健康
比较对AI与其他信息源的信任度
reason: 预印本横断面网络调查，样本尚可但为自报数据，属增量档
abstract: Introduction: People increasingly ask conversational artificial intelligence (AI) about health; however, how this relates to care seeking in Japan, where universal health coverage renders care accessible, remains unknown. This study described how many adults ask AI about health, why and when, what they do afterward, and how much they trust AI compared with other sources. Methods: This two-stage cross-sectional survey employed a commercial web panel (October-November 2026). A screening survey of adults aged [≥]20 years (10,000 responses; 8,209 analyzed) estimated prevalence. A main survey of users (1,000 responses; 735 analyzed) asked about purposes, the most recent use and subsequent actions, and trust in seven information sources. Responses were weighted by sex and age. Results: In the past 6 months, 40.3% of adults (95% confidence interval, 39.3-41.4) asked conversational AI about health. The most recent use occurred before a medical visit for 39.0%, after a visit for 23.4%, and when no visit was being considered for 37.6%. Subsequently, 35.4% visited a medical facility; 12.8% (10.3-15.3) decided not to visit or postponed a visit (5.1% of all adults). Forgoing or delaying was more frequent among users with high trust in AI (trusting it completely or a lot; 22.5% vs. 10.9% among others). Among pre-visit users, it was less frequent with high trust in health professionals (16.7% vs. 30.9%) and did not clearly differ by trust in AI. Of users, 61.4% had high trust in health professionals and 14.3% in AI. Conclusions: In Japan, approximately 4 in 10 adults asked AI about health, and 1 in 8 users forwent or delayed a visit. This was more common with high trust in AI; among pre-visit users, it was associated with low trust in health professionals. How trust in AI and health professionals relates to care seeking warrants further study.
zh_abstract: 【引言】人们越来越多地向对话式人工智能（AI）询问健康问题；然而，在全民健康保险使就医便利的日本，这与就医行为之间有何关系尚不清楚。本研究描述了有多少成年人就健康问题询问AI、原因和时机、之后采取了什么行动，以及与其他信息来源相比他们对AI的信任程度。【方法】这项两阶段横断面调查采用商业网络样本库（2026年10月至11月）。一项针对≥20岁成年人的筛查调查（10,000份回复；分析8,209份）用于估计使用率。一项针对使用者的主调查（1,000份回复；分析735份）询问了使用目的、最近一次使用及随后的行动，以及对七种信息来源的信任。回复按性别和年龄加权。【结果】在过去6个月内，40.3%的成年人（95%置信区间，39.3-41.4）就健康问题询问过对话式AI。最近一次使用发生在就诊前的占39.0%，就诊后的占23.4%，未考虑就诊时的占37.6%。随后，35.4%前往医疗机构就诊；12.8%（10.3-15.3）决定不就诊或推迟就诊（占全部成年人的5.1%）。在对AI高度信任（完全信任或非常信任）的使用者中，放弃或推迟就诊更为常见（22.5%，其他人为10.9%）。在就诊前使用者中，对医务人员高度信任者放弃或推迟就诊的情况较少（16.7% 对 30.9%），而是否对AI高度信任则无明显差异。在使用者中，61.4%对医务人员高度信任，14.3%对AI高度信任。【结论】在日本，约十分之四的成年人就健康问题询问过AI，八分之一的使用者放弃或推迟了就诊。这在对AI高度信任者中更常见；在就诊前使用者中，则与对医务人员的低信任相关。对AI和医务人员的信任与就医行为之间的关系值得进一步研究。

title: Integrating CRISPRi perturbation responses and transcription-factor binding priors for regulatory network inference in triple-negative breast cancer
zh_title: 整合CRISPRi扰动响应与TF结合先验的三阴性乳腺癌调控网络推断
summary: 提出干预式网络推断框架，整合Perturb-seq单细胞数据与ChIP-seq转录因子结合先验，用于TNBC增强子调控网络推断。
key_points: 使用95,678个细胞的Perturb-seq数据
整合ENCODE转录因子结合先验
覆盖819个体细胞突变相关增强子位点
reason: 预印本，基于公开数据的计算方法，证据有限，属增量档
abstract: Triple-Negative Breast Cancer (TNBC) represents an aggressive breast cancer subtype that lacks actionable cell-surface receptors, restricting frontline systemic management to cytotoxic chemotherapy. While recent functional epigenomics shows that TNBC progression is governed by non-coding regulatory remodeling at distal super-enhancers, conventional Gene Regulatory Network (GRN) inference methods rely on observational transcriptomic co-expression, which suffers from technical dropouts and confounding correlations that inflate false discoveries (>30%). Here, we present an interventional network inference framework that integrates large-scale single-cell CRISPR-interference perturbation sequencing (Perturb-seq; GSE224986, 95,678 cells across 11,975 sgRNAs) with ENCODE Factorbook ChIP-seq physical transcription factor binding priors across 819 somatic mutation-associated enhancer loci in human TNBC (MDA-MB-231). Our pipeline reconstructed a tripartite network yielding 5,935 physical TF-enhancer edges, 383,757 functional enhancer-gene edges, and 542,760 unique TF-target gene functional pairs across 372 active enhancers. Topological centrality prioritized master transcriptional drivers governing TNBC oncogenic signaling, including CTCF, POLR2A, EP300, JUND, MYC, and FOS, which regulate Hallmark programs for Epithelial-Mesenchymal Transition (p = 1.2 x 10-9) and cell cycle progression. Explainable machine learning (SHAP TreeExplainer) revealed non-linear, thresholded transactivation dynamics for AP-1 and MYC. Quantitative benchmarking against held-out CRISPRi ground truth demonstrated strong discriminatory accuracy (AUROC = 0.8999, AUPRC = 0.8745, Precision = 90.13%, FDR = 9.87%), substantially outperforming GENIE3 (AUPRC = 0.6323, FDR = 35.73%) and co-expression correlation (AUPRC = 0.6814). In silico-simulated driver feature silencing correlated with experimental responses (R2 = 0.473, p < 10-122), and master driver signatures significantly stratified overall survival in the METABRIC (n = 320) and TCGA-BRCA (n = 160; p [≤] 0.019) cohorts. Finally, in silico perturbation modeling indicated that multi-target epigenetic combinations achieved 93% topological disruption of oncogenic regulatory connectivity, nominating prioritized candidate circuits for experimental validation.
zh_abstract: 三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）是一种侵袭性乳腺癌亚型，缺乏可用于干预的细胞表面受体，因此一线全身治疗仅限于细胞毒性化疗。尽管近期功能表观基因组学研究表明，TNBC的进展受远端超级增强子处非编码调控重塑的支配，但传统的基因调控网络（GRN）推断方法依赖观察性转录组共表达，易受技术性缺失（dropout）和混杂相关性的影响，导致假发现增多（>30%）。在此，我们提出一种干预式网络推断框架，将大规模单细胞CRISPR干扰扰动测序（Perturb-seq；GSE224986，11,975个sgRNA、95,678个细胞）与ENCODE Factorbook ChIP-seq转录因子物理结合先验整合，涵盖人TNBC（MDA-MB-231）中819个与体细胞突变相关的增强子位点。我们的流程重建了一个三方网络，包含5,935条TF-增强子物理边、383,757条增强子-基因功能边，以及跨372个活跃增强子的542,760个独特TF-靶基因功能对。拓扑中心性分析优先筛选出调控TNBC致癌信号的主转录驱动因子，包括CTCF、POLR2A、EP300、JUND、MYC和FOS，它们调控上皮-间质转化（p = 1.2 x 10-9）和细胞周期进程的Hallmark程序。可解释机器学习（SHAP TreeExplainer）揭示了AP-1和MYC的非线性、阈值性转录激活动态。针对留出的CRISPRi真值进行的定量基准测试显示出很强的判别准确性（AUROC = 0.8999，AUPRC = 0.8745，精确度 = 90.13%，FDR = 9.87%），显著优于GENIE3（AUPRC = 0.6323，FDR = 35.73%）和共表达相关性方法（AUPRC = 0.6814）。计算机模拟的驱动因子特征沉默与实验响应相关（R2 = 0.473，p < 10-122），且主驱动因子特征可显著区分METABRIC（n = 320）和TCGA-BRCA（n = 160；p [≤] 0.019）队列的总生存期。最后，计算机扰动建模表明，多靶点表观遗传组合可使致癌调控连接性的拓扑破坏达到93%，从而提名了可供实验验证的优先候选回路。

title: How predictable is an individual's DNA methylation?
zh_title: 个体DNA甲基化的可预测性：差异位点预测新任务
summary: 提出在个体间差异位点预测目标个体DNA甲基化类别的新挑战，指出整体准确率无法反映个体差异预测能力。
key_points: 任务：预测未甲基化/中间/甲基化三类
输入含参考基因组与同类型他人数据，不含基因型
分别评估低变异与高变异位点
reason: 预印本，新任务设定有意义但证据信息有限，属增量档
abstract: DNA methylation is largely shared among individuals of the same cell type, yet at specific genomic sites it differs substantially between individuals. Methods that predict methylation are usually evaluated by their accuracy over all sites. Because methylation at most sites is shared, this accuracy cannot show whether a method predicts an individual's methylation where individuals differ. We present individual-level methylation prediction at sites where individuals differ as a new challenge. Given the reference genome sequence, the methylation of other individuals of the same cell type, and measurements at some sites of a target individual, but not the individual's genotype, the task is to predict the target individual's methylation class (unmethylated, intermediate, or methylated) at the remaining sites. We evaluate predictions separately at sites with low and high variation across individuals. We compare four approaches: the average of other individuals, a sequence model (the DNA language model Nucleotide Transformer) fine-tuned on other individuals' methylation, the same model further fine-tuned on the target individual's measurements, and a local class-average approach using the target individual's nearby training-site class labels. Across 32 individuals from six human cell types, the average of other individuals matched or slightly exceeded both sequence models at sites with low variation among individuals. At the most variable sites, the average of other individuals performed worse than a random predictor that assigns classes at the observed class frequencies, whereas both sequence models performed substantially better than the average. Both sequence models also achieved higher mean weighted F1 than the local class-average approach. Fine-tuning on the target individual's measurements improved predictions more inside regions where other individuals show bimodal methylation (a mix of methylated and unmethylated DNA molecules within one sample) than outside them. Among the most variable sites, it also improved predictions at CpG islands for 25 of the 32 individuals. We conclude that individual-level methylation prediction is a distinct problem that is particularly challenging at sites where individuals differ, and that the benefit of an individual's own measurements is concentrated in genomic contexts identifiable from other individuals' methylation and genomic annotations.
zh_abstract: 同一细胞类型的个体之间，DNA 甲基化在很大程度上是共有的，但在特定基因组位点上个体间差异显著。预测甲基化的方法通常以其在所有位点上的准确性来评估。由于大多数位点的甲基化是共有的，这种准确性无法说明某方法能否在个体间存在差异的位点预测个体的甲基化。我们提出一项新的挑战：在个体间存在差异的位点进行个体水平的甲基化预测。给定参考基因组序列、同一细胞类型其他个体的甲基化，以及目标个体在部分位点的测量值（但不含该个体的基因型），任务是预测目标个体在其余位点的甲基化类别（未甲基化、中间或甲基化）。我们分别在个体间变异低和高的位点评估预测。我们比较了四种方法：其他个体的平均值；基于其他个体甲基化微调的序列模型（DNA 语言模型 Nucleotide Transformer）；在目标个体测量值上进一步微调的同一模型；以及使用目标个体邻近训练位点类别标签的局部类别平均方法。在来自六种人类细胞类型的 32 名个体中，在个体间变异低的位点，其他个体的平均值与两种序列模型相当或略优。在变异最大的位点，其他个体的平均值表现比按观察到的类别频率分配类别的随机预测器更差，而两种序列模型均显著优于该平均值。两种序列模型的平均加权 F1 也均高于局部类别平均方法。在其他个体呈现双峰甲基化（同一样本中甲基化与未甲基化 DNA 分子混合）的区域内，基于目标个体测量值的微调对预测的改善大于区域外。在变异最大的位点中，该微调还改善了 32 名个体中 25 名个体在 CpG 岛的预测。我们得出结论：个体水平的甲基化预测是一个独特的问题，在个体间存在差异的位点尤其具有挑战性，且个体自身测量值的获益集中于可通过其他个体的甲基化和基因组注释识别的基因组背景中。

title: Dependence-Aware Conformal Prediction for 3D Uncertainty Quantification in Molecular Docking
zh_title: 分子对接3D不确定性量化的依赖感知共形预测
summary: 提出基于GNN与Copula联合校准的共形预测框架，为分子对接的3D结合构象构建紧凑且覆盖可靠的预测区域。
key_points: 共享GNN估计自适应非对称不确定性区间
Copula校准坐标间非一致性分数的依赖
面向对接误差异质性与分布偏移
reason: 预印本方法改进，摘要未见充分验证细节
abstract: Molecular docking plays a critical role in drug discovery by predicting three-dimensional (3D) binding poses of small molecules within proteins. However, docking predictions can contain substantial positional errors, making reliable uncertainty quantification essential. Conformal prediction (CP) provides a principled framework for uncertainty quantification, yet constructing compact 3D prediction regions with reliable joint coverage remains challenging due to heterogeneous atomic errors, dependence among spatial coordinates, and distribution shifts. We develop a dependence-aware CP framework for molecular docking that leverages a shared graph neural network (GNN) to estimate adaptive, asymmetric uncertainty intervals using local atomic and global molecular information. Copula-based joint calibration accounts for dependence among coordinate-wise nonconformity scores to construct compact 3D prediction boxes. We further introduce density ratio estimation (DRE) to adapt calibration under distribution shift. Experiments across three docking methods demonstrate that our approach reduces median prediction-box volumes by 37.40%, 95.00%, and 39.16% for AutoDock Vina, Protenix, and MedusaGraph, respectively, compared with a state-of-the-art CP baseline, while achieving empirical joint coverage close to the 90% target. Under the Molecular Group Split and controlled distribution shifts, DRE further reduces coverage deviations, highlighting the potential of dependence-aware and shift-adaptive calibration for reliable 3D molecular docking uncertainty quantification.
zh_abstract: 分子对接通过预测小分子在蛋白质内的三维（3D）结合构象，在药物发现中发挥关键作用。然而，对接预测可能含有较大的位置误差，因此可靠的不确定性量化至关重要。保形预测（conformal prediction，CP）为不确定性量化提供了有原则的框架，但由于原子误差的异质性、空间坐标之间的相关性以及分布偏移，构建具有可靠联合覆盖率的紧凑 3D 预测区域仍具挑战。我们为分子对接开发了一种考虑依赖性的 CP 框架，利用共享图神经网络（GNN），结合局部原子信息和全局分子信息估计自适应、非对称的不确定性区间。基于 Copula 的联合校准考虑了各坐标方向非一致性得分之间的依赖关系，以构建紧凑的 3D 预测盒。我们还引入密度比估计（DRE），使校准适应分布偏移。在三种对接方法上的实验表明，与最先进的 CP 基线相比，我们的方法使 AutoDock Vina、Protenix 和 MedusaGraph 的预测盒体积中位数分别减少 37.40%、95.00% 和 39.16%，同时经验联合覆盖率接近 90% 的目标。在分子分组划分（Molecular Group Split）和受控分布偏移下，DRE 进一步减小了覆盖率偏差，凸显了考虑依赖性且适应偏移的校准在可靠的 3D 分子对接不确定性量化中的潜力。

title: Machine learning prediction of antimicrobial resistance in respiratory metagenomes
zh_title: 呼吸道宏基因组中抗菌药物耐药性的机器学习预测
summary: 预印本：提出概念验证框架，利用机器学习从呼吸道宏基因组预测抗菌药物耐药，以期缩短ARDS患者靶向治疗等待时间。
key_points: 针对传统药敏检测最长约5天的延迟
免培养、AI驱动的宏基因组策略
定位为概念验证，证据有限
reason: 概念验证预印本，摘要无验证规模与对照信息，属增量档
abstract: Background: Targeted therapy for patients with suspected respiratory infections traditionally requires bacterial culture followed by phenotypic antimicrobial susceptibility testing (AST), a process that can take up to 5 days. In acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS), delays in identifying the causative pathogen and its resistance profile may be especially harmful because patients are critically ill and often receive broad-spectrum empiric antibiotics. The growing burden of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) further complicates clinical decision-making by reducing effective treatment options and increasing the risk of inadequate initial therapy. Culture-free, AI-driven computational metagenomic strategies have the potential to drastically shorten this window, enabling more rapid targeted therapy prescription. To show the feasibility of such approaches, we develop a proof-of-concept framework based on clinical metagenomics. Methods: We simulated respiratory metagenomes using real-world bacterial genomes with associated antimicrobial susceptibility phenotypes. Each simulated metagenome contained a fixed commensal background and one clinically important respiratory pathogen, Acinetobacter baumannii, Klebsiella pneumoniae, or Pseudomonas aeruginosa, at 5% or 10% bacterial read abundance. Realistic reads were simulated for Oxford Nanopore, PacBio, and Illumina sequencing platforms. Random Forest (RF) classifiers were trained and evaluated using five-fold, strain-grouped cross-validation with fold-specific {chi}2-ranked 13-mer features. ResFinder and KARGA were included as reference-based metagenomics benchmarks and evaluated using the same five held-out folds across the three sequencing platforms and two pathogen-abundance conditions. Results: RF performance varied substantially across species, antibiotics, and sequencing platforms. The strongest and most consistent results were observed for K. pneumoniae, with accuracy reaching approximately 0.96 for ceftazidime, 0.93 for amikacin, and 0.92 for ciprofloxacin. Performance for P. aeruginosa was more heterogeneous: long-read models performed well for amikacin, reaching 0.89 with PacBio and 0.88 with Nanopore, whereas Illumina performed substantially better for ciprofloxacin, ceftazidime, and levofloxacin, reaching accuracies of approximately 0.87, 0.77, and 0.70, respectively.
